title: Industrial Channel Sales
description:
**Channel Business Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Chennai, India
 



**Experience:** 
 5–10 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 







**Role Summary** 




 The Channel Business Manager will be responsible for developing and managing a network of distributors, system integrators, OEM partners and solution providers who can sell, implement and support our Industrial IoT solutions.
 



 The role requires a strong understanding of industrial automation products, channel business development, relationship management and consultative selling. The candidate should be comfortable working with both hardware and software solutions and be willing to travel extensively to develop and support partners.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Channel Development** 



* Identify, recruit and onboard distributors, value\-added resellers (VARs), system integrators and automation partners across India.
* Develop channel expansion plans for assigned regions and industry verticals.
* Identify and establish strategic channel partnerships in selected international markets.
* Evaluate prospective partners based on technical capability, market reach and business potential.



**Partner Management** 



* Build long\-term relationships with channel partners.
* Conduct regular business reviews and performance evaluations.
* Develop joint business plans and revenue targets with partners.
* Support partners in opportunity identification, customer engagement and solution positioning.
* Ensure partners remain engaged through regular communication and business support.



**Sales \& Business Development** 



* Achieve assigned channel sales targets.
* Generate new business through partner\-led opportunities.
* Work jointly with partners during customer presentations, demonstrations and solution discussions.
* Assist partners in preparing techno\-commercial proposals.
* Coordinate with internal technical and product teams to support customer requirements.



**Partner Enablement** 



* Conduct product training and certification programs for partners.
* Ensure partners are equipped to deploy and support our Pick\-to\-Light and Industrial IoT solutions.
* Develop sales enablement material and best practices for the channel ecosystem.
* Assist partners during pilot projects and initial deployments.



**Market Development** 



* Identify emerging market opportunities in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics and smart factory automation.
* Track competitor activities and market trends.
* Provide market feedback to product management for future product enhancements.
* Represent the company at exhibitions, seminars, industry events and partner conferences.



**International Business Support** 



* Identify potential distributors and system integration partners in overseas markets.
* Coordinate with international partners for product demonstrations, technical discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Support export\-oriented business development initiatives.
* Undertake overseas travel as required.



**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 5–10 years of experience in Channel Sales, Partner Management or Business Development.
* Prior experience in Industrial IoT, Factory Automation, Industrial Sensors, Machine Automation, PLC/SCADA, Industrial Networking or related industrial technology products.
* Experience working with distributors, automation system integrators or industrial solution providers.
* Exposure to software\-enabled industrial solutions will be an added advantage.



**Educational Qualification** 



* BSc, BE or B. Tech (Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Mechanical or related disciplines).



**Technical Knowledge** 




 Candidates should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* Industrial IoT Solutions
* Factory Automation
* Pick\-to\-Light Systems
* Industrial Sensors
* PLC/SCADA Systems
* MES / Manufacturing Software
* Industrial Communication Networks
* Barcode/RFID Solutions
* Smart Manufacturing Solutions
* Digital Factory Technologies



**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong relationship\-building and networking abilities.
* Commercial negotiation and business development skills.
* Ability to understand customer applications and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Self\-driven, energetic and highly organized.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Office.



**Travel Requirements** 



* Frequent travel across India to recruit, train and support channel partners.
* Periodic international travel for partner development, exhibitions and business meetings.

title: State Head

* Sales Leadership \& Team Management
* Sales strategy and execution
* Data\-driven decision making
* Customer lifecycle management \& Service Excellence
* Negotiation \& Revenue Growth
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and influencing skills

 Largest wedding services provider.

 Largest online wedding venues platform.

 Personalized \& curated wedding planning services.

* **Astro Free Chat:**

title: Associate Client Success Manager
description:
***You will build a success function for Saas Marketplace from scratch.***
 While this is exciting, we will be upfront: this role won't be easy. Zero to one is always difficult. There will be confusion and chaos. Of course, you will get help. We are in this together. But you have to decide if you are up for it, and that's what we'll test in our interactions.
   

  

 But do not apply if your primary motivation towards applying is a remote job. We are building a business here. So, we expect high ownership and proactiveness. And we mean it. Yes we are remote, but that should not be a criteria for application.
   

  

**Our platform:** 
 bizdeals.gonuclei.com (AWS drives our bulk of the business)
   

  

**Who are you?**
 We want to hear your story around the skills below.
   

  

* Extreme ownership: Do you know the book? Why are you interested in the retention part of the business? What drives you? How will you demonstrate ownership?
* Problem solving: As the first person on the retention team, there won't be set processes. You will co\-build with us. Observe the challenge, define the problem and probable solutions, and execute.
* Diligent and hard\-working: I mean it.
* Think you don't have a topic to discuss with the customer. Will they still spend 10 minutes on a call with you? If yes, you know how to transcend a professional relationship.
* Learnability: You will have to understand what AWS is and learn a few technical concepts. Think about what you've learnt in the last 6 months.
* Communication: Good energy, voice modulation, fluency in English and Hindi. We mean it.
* 1\-2 years of experience managing customers, any role would do. It's okay if you don't have relevant work experience, as long as you want to learn how to build something from scratch.


**Task**
 Bring a one\-pager before our first conversation, sharing your ideas on how to build a great success function. What should we do, what should we avoid? You're welcome to use AI to brainstorm ideas, but the write\-up itself
 ***should be in your own words***
 , not AI\-generated.

description:
**About Citco:**

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 80 offices worldwide. With more than $1 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end\-to\-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.


For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com .


**About the Team \& Business Line:**

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.  



  

As part of the Real Assets Operations Skills Development team, you will help build accounting, technical and operational capabilities across our Real Assets business through training, onboarding and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


  
**Your Role:**

* Develop, maintain and periodically update training materials, process guides and onboarding documentation in line with curriculum standards and guidance from the (Assistant) / Vice President and Subject Matter Experts.
* Translate operational procedures, process updates and system enhancements into practical training and knowledge\-sharing materials, ensuring alignment with approved policies and practices.
* Support the review and update of training content following process, system or regulatory changes, identifying and escalating content gaps where appropriate.
* Coordinate with Subject Matter Experts to arrange training sessions, gather content and follow up on agreed actions.
* Deliver onboarding, introductory and process\-level training covering operational procedures, recurring tasks, documentation standards and system navigation.
* Provide day\-to\-day onboarding support to new joiners, helping them navigate training materials, process documentation and operational resources.
* Maintain training records, attendance logs, feedback trackers, version control and completion monitoring, and support scheduling and invitations for training programmes.
* Maintain approved training and process documentation within designated knowledge management repositories, ensuring information remains accurate and accessible.
* Monitor recurring operational errors, training challenges and documentation gaps, and escalate recurring training needs, quality concerns and recommendations to the (Assistant) / Vice President.
* Maintain a proactive internal customer focus, provide practical support to trainees, reviewers and managers.

**About You:**

* Degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline desirable; part\-qualified or working towards an ACA, CA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent professional designation an advantage.
* Minimum 6 years of private and/or public accounting experience, ideally including exposure to Real Assets and Fund Accounting.
* Working understanding of SPV accounting, real estate structures, operational processes, reporting cycles and review expectations.
* Experience delivering onboarding and process\-level training and supporting structured knowledge transfer, with the ability to explain operational and system processes clearly.
* Experience developing, updating and maintaining training materials, process documentation and knowledge\-sharing resources to established standards.
* Well\-organised, with strong attention to detail in maintaining training records, version control, attendance and completion tracking.
* Ability to identify content gaps, recurring training needs and process inconsistencies and escalate them appropriately.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, facilitation and business writing skills, with the ability to collaborate with Subject Matter Experts, Operations teams and Learning \& Development; solid Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills, and exposure to fund accounting systems (Yardi and/or Investran an advantage).
A motivated, proactive self\-starter with a passion for supporting others, able to work independently, manage multiple priorities and collaborate across locations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

title: Manager, Supply Chain Learning & Organizational Excellence
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-254233 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 08, 2026 CATEGORY: Supply Chain
**Manager, Supply Chain Learning \& Organizational Excellence**
===============================================================

**Location:** Amgen India  

**Career Framework:** GCF 5 – Manager

**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Manager, Supply Chain Learning \& Organizational Excellence will play a key role in enabling the growth, effectiveness and long\-term capability of the Supply Chain organization at Amgen India. The role will work closely with site and global Supply Chain leadership to translate organizational priorities into coordinated execution, strengthen operating rhythms, support cross\-functional initiatives, and build the learning capabilities required for a high\-performing and compliant organization.


A significant focus of the role will be to establish, sustain and continuously mature the Supply Chain Learning \& Development program at Amgen India. The successful candidate will help evolve this capability toward a comprehensive Supply Chain Academy that enables structured onboarding, knowledge transfer, technical and functional capability development, and continuous learning across the organization.


This role requires a combination of strong program leadership, organizational effectiveness, learning operations, GxP knowledge and the ability to work across a complex global and cross\-functional environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Organizational Enablement \& Strategic Execution**

* Partner with Supply Chain leadership to translate strategic priorities into coordinated plans, actions, milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Establish and maintain effective operating rhythms across key organizational priorities, including leadership reviews, initiative tracking, decision follow\-up, risk management and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Provide structure and visibility across strategic initiatives by consolidating progress, identifying risks and interdependencies, and enabling timely escalation and decision\-making.
* Coordinate across Planning, Distribution, Enablement, Customer Service, Clinical Supply Chain and other in\-scope functions to connect priorities, process knowledge, capability requirements and organizational needs.
* Develop leadership\-ready materials, insights and progress updates that enable effective governance and informed decision\-making.
* Support organizational change, capability\-building and continuous\-improvement initiatives as the Amgen India Supply Chain organization grows and matures.

### **Learning \& Capability Development**

* Execute global GxP learning strategies, standards and frameworks for in\-scope global Supply Chain functions, adapting implementation to meet Amgen India organizational and site needs.
* Build, sustain and continuously improve the Supply Chain Learning \& Development program, establishing the foundations for an integrated Supply Chain Academy.
* Develop a structured capability\-development approach spanning onboarding, role\-based learning, technical and functional knowledge, leadership development, continuous learning and knowledge retention.
* Support the Supply Chain knowledge\-transfer plan for Amgen India onboarding, including transfer cadence, readiness assessments, risk identification, progress tracking and stakeholder coordination.
* Partner with functional leaders and subject matter experts to identify current and future capability requirements and translate them into scalable learning solutions and development pathways.
* Lead implementation and execution of Supply Chain training programs at the site level, ensuring alignment with GMP/GxP/GDP requirements, Amgen quality standards and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Establish measures to assess learning effectiveness, organizational capability and program maturity, using insights to continuously strengthen the learning strategy.

### **GxP Learning Operations \& Governance**

* Create, revise and maintain Training Assignment Profiles (TAPs), associated learning and assessment materials, SOPs, work instructions, job aids and other learning documentation using approved templates, systems and workflows.
* Ensure appropriate document ownership, version control, traceability, approvals and inspection readiness across learning materials.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Supply Chain learning operations, including training intake, LMS processes, training assignments, completion tracking and day\-to\-day training activities.
* Support audits and regulatory inspections by preparing training reports, responding to training\-record requests and supporting direct interface with auditors or inspectors as assigned.
* Participate in the GxP Learning Community of Practice and collaborate with global learning partners to advance continuous improvement, change management, standardization and learning governance.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and scale learning processes while maintaining compliance and quality.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Master’s degree and 8\-12 and relevant professional experience; OR
* Bachelor’s degree and significant relevant professional experience in Supply Chain, Learning \& Development, Quality, Operations, Organizational Effectiveness or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience working in a regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or similarly controlled environment.
* Experience supporting or leading cross\-functional programs involving multiple stakeholders, priorities and dependencies.
* Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple interconnected workstreams and provide clear visibility to leadership.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into concise, leadership\-ready communications.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and influencing skills with demonstrated effectiveness working across functions, organizational levels and geographies.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Ability to operate effectively in an evolving environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset with an interest in building scalable, sustainable organizational capabilities.
* Experience within pharmaceutical or biotechnology Supply Chain
* Strong understanding of GxP/GMP/GDP requirements and their application to training, qualification and learning operations.
* Experience designing, implementing or scaling learning and capability\-development programs in a complex organization.
* Experience with LMS platforms, controlled documentation, training assignment processes and learning governance.
* Experience supporting knowledge transfer, organizational onboarding or establishment of new teams or capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to convert broad organizational priorities into structured execution plans and operating mechanisms.

**Working Expectations**
------------------------

* Collaborate extensively with colleagues and stakeholders across Amgen India and the global organization.
* Work across global time zones as required to support international teams and initiatives.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Success in this role will be reflected in a well\-connected and effectively operating Supply Chain organization, strong visibility and execution against key organizational priorities, and a sustainable learning ecosystem that enables employees to become proficient in their roles and continue developing throughout their careers.


Over time, the role will help establish an integrated Supply Chain Academy that preserves critical organizational knowledge, accelerates onboarding and proficiency, develops functional and leadership capabilities, and creates a culture of continuous learning across Amgen India Supply Chain.

**India Customer Success Leader**

 We are seeking a transformational Customer Success \& Consulting Leader to drive strategic growth, customer value realization, and executive engagement across NielsenIQ’s FMCG and Technology \& Durables businesses in India. This leader will define and execute the customer success strategy, build deep C\-suite relationships, and position NIQ as a trusted strategic partner for some of India's leading organizations.

They will serve as the voice of the customer internally while influencing strategic decisions across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Operations teams.

Beco values trustworthiness, positivity, and straightforward communication, aiming to “do things right” at every step. Team members are invited to join a mission\-driven environment that nurtures simplicity, spirituality, and purity in everyday living.

* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, detail\-oriented environment and collaborate across cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; an advanced degree or MBA is a plus.

title: Account Manager, Tech Services Group, IT & ITES, AWS India
description:
**Description**
 Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a results\-driven Account Manager to accelerate cloud adoption across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.
   

  

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 As an Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will be responsible for driving AWS adoption across IT services companies, software product firms, and technology\-enabled services organizations. You will build strategic relationships with technology leaders, influence cloud architecture decisions, and help these organizations leverage AWS to deliver innovative solutions to their global customers while transforming their own operations.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Drive Cloud Adoption Across IT/ITeS Organizations: Lead strategic sales initiatives focused on workload migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI/ML adoption to help IT/ITeS companies build competitive advantage through AWS
   

  

 Strategic Account Planning and Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive account plans that identify growth opportunities, map stakeholder ecosystems, and align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives and technology roadmaps
   

  

 Executive Relationship Building: Establish and nurture relationships with C\-level executives, Engineering Heads, Delivery Leaders, and Practice Heads to position AWS as a strategic partner in their digital transformation and service delivery innovation
   

  

 Solution Positioning and Value Articulation: Articulate AWS value propositions across compute, storage, databases, analytics, AI/ML, and GenAI services, demonstrating how these capabilities enable IT/ITeS companies to deliver better outcomes for their end customers
   

  

 Partner Ecosystem Collaboration: Work closely with AWS Partner teams, Solutions Architects, and Professional Services to design and deliver proof\-of\-concepts, pilots, and production deployments that showcase AWS capabilities
   

  

 Revenue Growth and Pipeline Management: Own revenue targets, build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deals through complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders
   

  

 Customer Success and Expansion: Ensure successful onboarding and adoption of AWS services, identify expansion opportunities across different business units and service lines, and drive consumption growth through strategic engagement
   

  

 Market Intelligence and Competitive Positioning: Stay informed about IT/ITeS industry trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies to position AWS effectively and identify new market opportunities
   

  

 Thought Leadership and Advocacy: Organize and participate in workshops, hackathons, webinars, and industry events to build AWS mindshare, showcase customer success stories, and establish AWS as the innovation partner of choice
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal AWS teams including Solutions Architecture, Partner Development, Marketing, and Product teams to deliver comprehensive solutions and exceptional customer experiences
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As an Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large\-scale adoption. Your day will involve a mix of strategic planning, customer engagement, internal collaboration, and deal execution activities.
   

  

**A Typical Day May Include**
 Strategic Planning: Reviewing account plans, analyzing consumption trends, identifying whitespace opportunities, and preparing for upcoming customer engagements with clear objectives and value propositions
   

  

 Customer Meetings: Conducting executive briefings with CXOs and business leaders, technical deep\-dives with engineering teams, and business reviews with account stakeholders to drive alignment and momentum
   

  

 Internal Collaboration: Working with Solutions Architects on technical proposals, coordinating with Partner teams on joint go\-to\-market initiatives, and engaging Product teams to address customer requirements
   

  

 Deal Progression: Advancing opportunities through the sales cycle, addressing procurement and commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and removing blockers to close deals
   

  

 Relationship Development: Building trusted advisor relationships through regular cadence calls, proactive outreach, sharing relevant insights and best practices, and connecting customers with AWS resources and expertise
   

  

 Knowledge Building: Staying current on AWS service launches, industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success stories to bring fresh ideas and relevant insights to customer conversations
   

  

 Pipeline Management: Updating CRM systems with accurate opportunity data, forecasting revenue, tracking key milestones, and ensuring disciplined account hygiene and reporting
   

  

**About The Team**
 The IT/ITeS segment team focuses on one of India's most strategic industries—organizations that are not only transforming their own operations through cloud but also building cloud\-native solutions and services for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a collaborative, high\-energy team that values customer obsession, innovation, and results.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of stakeholder or account management experience, or experience in technical work related to computer systems and technology components


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or a Master's degree and experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Wealth Manager
description:

 Mumbai

 3–5 years
 



**Industry:** 
 Wealth Management
 



**Company:** 
 Stockify Fintech
 



**Package:** 

 Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus (3\-6 months salary)
 








**About Stockify** 




  






 Stockify is building India's most trusted marketplace for pre\-IPO and unlisted shares, giving HNI and UHNI investors access to exclusive investment opportunities before companies go public. We cover a wide universe of high\-growth unlisted companies across sectors and provide investors with pricing, research and seamless transaction support. Our offices are in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Gurugram and Dubai, and we are expanding our wealth management team aggressively to serve the growing demand from sophisticated investors.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 We are hiring experienced Wealth Managers for our Mumbai office. This is a senior client\-facing role where you will manage a portfolio of HNI and UHNI investors, advise them on pre\-IPO and unlisted share investment opportunities, and drive AUM and revenue growth for Stockify. The role combines relationship management, investment advisory and business development in equal measure.
 




  






 This is the right role for a wealth professional who already understands how HNI clients think, has experience with alternative investments or capital markets products, and wants to work in one of the most exciting and high\-growth segments of Indian finance. You will have the full backing of Stockify's research, operations and technology teams, but the relationships you build and the revenue you generate will be very much your own.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




  




* Build, manage and grow a dedicated book of HNI and UHNI clients who are interested in pre\-IPO and unlisted share investments, with a focus on deepening relationships and increasing AUM over time
* Advise clients on specific unlisted share opportunities available on the Stockify platform, clearly explaining pricing, liquidity considerations, transfer timelines, risk factors and potential upside in a way that is suitable to their financial profile
* Proactively source new HNI leads through your personal network, referrals from existing clients, community events, industry associations and targeted outreach to high\-net\-worth individuals across Mumbai \& west India
* Conduct client meetings, portfolio reviews and investment update calls at regular intervals, keeping clients informed on the performance of their holdings and new opportunities that match their profile
* Cross\-sell Stockify's broader investment offering to existing clients and introduce referrals to the B2B sales team where appropriate
* Work closely with the back office team to ensure smooth and timely execution of all client transactions, including documentation, share transfer and settlement
* Maintain detailed and up\-to\-date records of all client interactions, portfolios, upcoming transactions and follow\-ups in the CRM on a daily basis
* Represent Stockify professionally at investor events, wealth management conferences and community gatherings to build brand visibility and source new relationships



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* Three to six years of experience in wealth management, private banking, investment advisory or relationship management within a financial services organisation
* A strong and demonstrable existing network of HNI clients in Mumbai and west India who trust your investment recommendations and are open to alternative investments
* Prior experience advising clients on alternative investment products such as PMS, AIF, unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investments, structured products or private equity is strongly preferred
* NISM certification in Mutual Funds Distribution or Investment Advisory is preferred; candidates without certification but with a strong track record will also be considered
* Excellent consultative selling skills, with the ability to explain complex investment ideas in a simple and compelling way without oversimplifying the risks involved
* High integrity, a client\-first approach and the professional maturity to build lasting relationships based on trust rather than transactional interactions
* Self\-motivated with the discipline to independently manage a pipeline, set your own outreach schedule and consistently deliver against revenue targets



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  




* Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus
* Performance Incentives: Bonus of up to 3 to 6 months of monthly salary, paid based on individual and company performance
* Review Cycle: Performance review at 6 months with potential for salary revision, with earning potential that grows significantly with AUM and revenue performance

description:

1. Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment (FACE) is a non\-profit industry association and RBI\-recognised Self\-Regulatory Organisation in the FinTech sector (SRO\-FT). FinTech companies come together at FACE to facilitate consumer\-centric digital financial services that are safe, suitable, and transparent, delivering positive impacts on society and the economy. Please visit our website and refer to the SRO\-FT Framework to understand our work.
2. As an industry association and SRO\-FT, FACE works with the FinTech ecosystem towards innovative, sustainable, and responsible conduct in the FinTech sector, delivering consumer progress and well\-being in line with public policy objectives. The work requires working with a) the supply side, i.e. industry, to improve their employees’ capacity and awareness of conduct and compliance and b) the demand side, i.e. consumers, to improve their understanding of risks, rewards, rights and responsibilities with respect to digital financial services.

title: Salesforce Architect – Service 2.0
description:
#### **Job Description**


Job Description
  

Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

About Service 2\.0
  

Service 2\.0 is Blue Star's three\-year transformation of the Unitary Products service business, moving from reactive complaint handling to proactive ownership of the customer experience.
  

The programme is redesigning the complete customer journey — from installation and warranty onboarding through breakdown, repair, closure and renewal — on a modern service technology stack comprising Salesforce as the system of record, Salesforce Field Service (FSL) for the technician workforce, a bi\-directional integration backbone with SAP and partner systems, and a WhatsApp\-first customer communication layer.
  

The transformation includes GenAI\-powered service bots and self\-service, intelligent ticket allocation, workforce capacity optimisation, mobile\-first field workflows, digital proof\-of\-work, AI\-assisted audit, predictive analytics and role\-based performance dashboards.
  

The programme operates across a pan\-India service ecosystem of partners and technicians and is measured through business outcomes including warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, turnaround time and customer satisfaction.
  

Role: Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect to own the technology architecture and solution design for the Service 2\.0 transformation.
  

The person will be responsible for translating business and service transformation objectives into a scalable Salesforce architecture covering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, integrations, digital channels, automation, analytics and AI/GenAI capabilities.
  

The role will work closely with business leaders, service operations, IT teams, Salesforce/product teams, integration teams, partners and implementation vendors to establish a robust architecture that can scale across Blue Star's pan\-India service network.
  

Key Responsibilities
  

1\. Salesforce Architecture \& Solution Design
  

* Own the end\-to\-end Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Define the target architecture across Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud/digital channels and supporting Salesforce capabilities.
* Translate business requirements and service\-process designs into scalable, secure and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Define application, data, integration and security architecture.
* Establish architecture principles, design standards and reusable patterns.
* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend their adoption where they create measurable business value.
* Ensure the architecture remains scalable for future service transformation initiatives.

2\. Field Service \& Technician Transformation
  

* Architect Salesforce Field Service solutions supporting the complete technician lifecycle.
* Design solutions for work\-order management, intelligent scheduling, dispatch, technician allocation, capacity planning, mobility and digital proof\-of\-work.
* Enable optimisation of technician productivity, travel, skill matching, SLA adherence and first\-time\-fix.
* Design mobile\-first experiences suitable for a large and diverse pan\-India technician ecosystem.
* Ensure solutions work effectively across service partners and different operating models.

3\. Customer Service \& Digital Experience
  

* Architect end\-to\-end customer journeys across complaint registration, service request, appointment, technician visit, repair, closure and renewal.
* Design WhatsApp\-first and digital self\-service journeys integrated with Salesforce.
* Define architecture for GenAI\-powered service bots and assisted customer\-service journeys.
* Enable consistent customer interactions across digital and assisted service channels.
* Ensure customer, asset, warranty and service history are available as a unified view.

4\. Integration Architecture
  

* Own the Salesforce integration architecture with SAP, partner systems, WhatsApp and other enterprise applications.
* Define API, event\-driven and bi\-directional integration patterns.
* Ensure reliable synchronisation of customer, product, asset, warranty, service and transaction data.
* Establish standards for integration security, monitoring, error handling, retry mechanisms and performance.
* Work with integration architects and technology teams to build a scalable integration backbone.

5\. AI, GenAI \& Intelligent Service
  

* Define the architecture for AI/GenAI use cases within the service ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to use AI for customer self\-service, case classification and summarisation, technician assistance, smart ticket allocation, capacity and demand forecasting, audit and anomaly detection, and predictive service analytics.
* Ensure AI solutions are integrated appropriately into Salesforce workflows and user experiences.
* Establish governance around data, security, accuracy and responsible AI adoption.

6\. Data, Analytics \& Performance Management
  

* Define the Salesforce data architecture supporting service analytics and reporting.
* Ensure data quality, consistency and availability across the service ecosystem.
* Enable role\-based dashboards for service leaders, managers, partners and field teams.
* Work with data and analytics teams to enable predictive service insights.
* Establish architecture that supports measurement of warranty cost, first\-time\-fix, turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

7\. Governance \& Technical Leadership
  

* Act as the technical authority for Salesforce architecture within Service 2\.0\.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical specifications and major changes.
* Establish Salesforce development, configuration, integration and release\-management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform optimisation.
* Ensure appropriate Salesforce licensing and platform utilisation.
* Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Mentor Salesforce developers, administrators and implementation partners.

8\. Partner \& Programme Management
  

* Work closely with Salesforce, system integrators and technology partners.
* Provide technical direction to implementation partners and ensure adherence to the target architecture.
* Challenge solution designs where required and ensure commercial and technical decisions are aligned.
* Support programme planning, estimation, prioritisation and technology\-roadmap decisions.
* Ensure successful transition from implementation to sustainable operations and support.

Key Deliverables / Success Measures
  

The Salesforce Architect will be expected to deliver:
  

* Robust target\-state Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Scalable Salesforce Service Cloud and Field Service architecture across the pan\-India service network.
* Seamless integration between Salesforce, SAP, partners and digital channels.
* Mobile\-first and technician\-centric service workflows.
* Intelligent allocation, scheduling and capacity\-management capabilities.
* WhatsApp\-first customer engagement and self\-service journeys.
* AI/GenAI\-enabled service capabilities with measurable business value.
* Reliable service data and performance dashboards.
* Strong platform governance, security, scalability and maintainability.
* Reduction in technical debt and unnecessary customisation.
* Architecture aligned to measurable improvements in warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, service turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

Candidate Profile
  

Education
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications are strongly preferred.

Experience
  

* 10–15\+ years of overall technology experience, with significant experience in Salesforce architecture and enterprise application transformation.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience across Salesforce Service Cloud and Salesforce Field Service.
* Experience designing large\-scale Salesforce implementations involving complex integrations and multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience in field service, after\-sales service, customer service or service transformation is highly desirable.
* Experience working with large distributed field/service networks is an advantage.
* Experience in enterprise\-scale digital transformation programmes involving multiple technology platforms.

Salesforce Expertise
  

Strong understanding of:
  

* Salesforce Service Cloud
* Salesforce Field Service
* Service Console
* Case Management
* Work Orders and Service Appointments
* Scheduling and optimisation
* Omni\-Channel
* Salesforce APIs and integration patterns
* Platform Events / event\-driven architecture
* Apex and Lightning architecture
* Data modelling and security architecture
* Salesforce Flow and automation
* Experience Cloud / digital experience
* Salesforce reporting and analytics
* Salesforce AI/GenAI capabilities

Integration \& Technology Skills
  

* Strong understanding of enterprise integration architecture.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, middleware and event\-driven architectures.
* Experience or understanding of SAP integration and enterprise master\-data concepts.
* Knowledge of cloud architecture, API security and identity/access management.
* Understanding of data platforms, analytics and AI/ML architectures.
* Ability to assess build\-vs\-buy and standard\-vs\-customisation decisions.

Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies
  

The candidate should demonstrate:
  

* Strong enterprise architecture thinking with the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes.
* Excellent understanding of customer\-service and field\-service processes.
* Ability to simplify complex technology landscapes.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence business and technology leaders without relying solely on hierarchical authority.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Commercial orientation and ability to evaluate technology investments based on ROI.
* Ability to work effectively with internal teams, vendors and implementation partners.
* Strong ownership and accountability for architecture decisions and outcomes.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously evaluate emerging Salesforce, AI and digital technologies.

Preferred Certifications
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) – highly desirable
* Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Certified Field Service Consultant
* Salesforce Platform Developer certifications
* Relevant integration/cloud architecture certifications

* Share daily activity updates and weekly sales forecasts.

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

  

Are you ready to love your job?

  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**PURPOSE**


Collaborates on the commercial management of complex tailored standard renewal and new business deals. Contributes to the management of commercial activities policy and process in support of renewal or new standard business deals. Ensures Financial profitability compliance to financial and business objectives while supporting business growth.

 **What will you do:**

**Commercial Strategy \& Deal Structuring**

* Collaborate with sales and business development stakeholders to design commercial strategies for complex tailored renewals and new business.

**Negotiation \& Contract Management**

* Negotiate commercially and financially sound contracts directly with customers to ensure mutual, long\-term value throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Support the development of pricing proposals and contract drafts for complex tailored standard renewals and new business deals.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Governance**

* Align commercial aspects with technical solutions and limitations by working closely with SITA's technical and solution communities.
* Collaborate proactively with the wider deal team, including bid, contract, and solution colleagues.
* Ensure all commercial activities comply with company regulations, including governance, bid processes, and delegation of authority.

* Performance Management: Establish, monitor, and achieve critical chat\-specific customer service KPIs, including Average Response Time (ART), Concurrent Chat Handling, Chat Abandonment Rate, Quality Assurance (QA) scores for written interactions, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) in digital channels. Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.
* Team Development \& Coaching: Lead, coach, and mentor team members focusing on effective written communication, tone, multi\-tasking skills in a chat environment, and efficient use of chat tools and resources. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify development opportunities.

Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Technology, Bot team and Quality Assurance to ensure seamless integration of chat channels and alignment with overall business goals.
* Reporting \& Analysis: Analyze chat interaction data, generate comprehensive reports on team performance, chat trends, and bot performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision\-making.
* Issue Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues encountered via chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution while upholding service standards.

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager with 8 to 12 years of experience in the payments industry to drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of innovative digital products. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in credit and debit card ecosystems, issuer and processor models, account\-level data management, and modern digital product development. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational effici

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8 to 12 years of experience in Product Management within the payments, banking, financial services, or fintech industry.

* Deep knowledge of issuer, processor, payment network, and transaction processing ecosystems.
* Proven experience leading digital product development initiatives from concept to launch.
* Strong expertise in Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, backlog management, and product delivery frameworks.
* Experience defining product roadmaps, business cases, market strategies, and customer journeys.
* Strong understanding of account\-level customer data, segmentation models, profiling, and data enrichment methodologies.
* Experience working with APIs, microservices architectures, and modern technology platforms.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable product features and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven decision\-making approach.

Fluent English

Excellent communication and escalation management skills.
  
Customer\-oriented and proactive in stakeholder engagement.
  
Strong analytical, prioritization, and leadership skills.

title: Customer Manager
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 
  

 • You have at least 5 years of leadership experience in a customer\-focused, fast paced, and multi\-channel retail environment.
   

 • You are passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and driving business growth through operational excellence.
   

 • You have proven experience in leading, coaching, and developing teams, fostering a high\-performance culture, and building future talent through succession planning.
   

 • You possess strong problem\-solving and conflict management skills, enabling you to make informed decisions and improve business performance.
   

 • You have a solid understanding of cost and budget management, retail operations, and customer satisfaction metrics.
   

 • You are knowledgeable about talent management, including recruitment, coaching, and employee development.
   

 • You understand change management principles and can effectively lead teams through change and business transformation.
   

 • You have a good understanding of legal compliance, third\-party contracts, safety and security requirements, and can work confidently with external authorities when required.
   

 • You have knowledge of the food business, including food safety standards and commercial operations.
   

 • You are analytical, collaborative, and an effective communicator who builds strong relationships across functions to deliver business results.
   

  

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 
  

 • Lead the Customer Experience function by creating a seamless, convenient, and rewarding shopping journey across all customer touchpoints.
   

 • Drive a customer\-first culture by using customer insights, feedback, and market trends to improve the overall shopping experience and influence business decisions.
   

 • Ensure operational excellence by identifying and removing barriers that impact customers throughout their buying, checkout, payment, and after\-sales journey.
   

 • Support commercial priorities and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to maximize sales, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
   

 • Oversee the IKEA Food business, ensuring commercial success while maintaining the highest standards of food safety, Swedishness, and regulatory compliance.
   

 • Develop and implement customer service, food business, and operational action plans aligned with local, national, and global business objectives.
   

 • Ensure compliance with IKEA policies, legal requirements, food safety regulations, and operational best practices.
   

 • Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external partners to enhance operational efficiency and protect the IKEA culture and values.
   

 • Plan and manage departmental resources, budgets, and investments to achieve operational and financial targets.
   

 • Lead, coach, and develop team members by setting clear goals, supporting individual growth, and building a strong succession pipeline.
   

 • Analyze customer, consumer, brand, and operational data to provide recommendations that improve customer experience and business performance.
   

 • Champion continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the implementation of customer experience and retail food strategies across the store.
   

 • Ensure a safe environment for customers and co\-workers by promoting safety, security, and compliance across all operations.
   

 • Foster collaboration across commercial and support functions to deliver integrated and consistent customer experience across all channels.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 At IKEA it’s all about our customers, and in Customer Relations we build and retain long\-lasting relationships with new and existing customers in a multichannel retail environment. We’re a diverse team that work together to ensure a positive and joyful experience for all IKEA visitors and customers: we set up services, gather feedback and make things right! Our modus operandi is to connect to people by listening to their personal needs and to create genuine interactions. We’re a bunch of people who are truly passionate about people!
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application. From: "Why Women Don't Apply for Jobs Unless They're 100% Qualified" by Tara Sophia Mohr, August 2014"

description:
**Job Description – Customer Success Manager (CSM)**
**Company:** 
 Aliste Technology
   

  

**Department:** 
 Customer Success
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Customer Success Manager
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Noida
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Head of Customer Success / Head of Support
   

  

**About Aliste Technology**
 Aliste Technology is a smart\-metering and energy\-technology company helping property owners and operators manage electricity consumption, metering, billing and collections more efficiently.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **high\-ownership Customer Success Manager** 
 who can manage assigned clients/properties end\-to\-end and ensure that customers receive consistent service, operational issues are resolved quickly, and properties remain healthy and retained.
   

  

**Role Objective**
 The CSM will be the
 **primary owner of assigned client accounts/properties** 
 after onboarding.
   

  

**The Person Will Be Responsible For**
* Maintaining strong client relationships.
* Ensuring smooth onboarding and installation.
* Monitoring property health and meter performance.
* Driving resolution of grievances and escalations.
* Coordinating with Operations, CCE, Sales and Finance.
* Monitoring outstanding payments and supporting collections.
* Reducing property churn/drop.
* Driving Auto\-Pay and Partner App adoption.
* Conducting regular client reviews.
* Identifying risks before they become escalations.
* Maintaining accurate CRM/Zoho and reporting data.


 The CSM is expected to
 **own the problem until closure** 
 , rather than simply forwarding it to another team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client \& Account Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build strong professional relationships with property owners, operators and key stakeholders.
* Understand each property's business requirements and operational challenges.
* Conduct regular client calls and meetings.
* Maintain proper records of all important client discussions.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Property Health Management


 The CSM should continuously monitor the health of assigned properties, including:
   

  

* Number of active meters.
* Offline meters.
* Installation pendency.
* Replacement pendency.
* Grievances and unresolved tickets.
* Over\-consumption complaints.
* Billing\-related issues.
* Low\-voltage and technical complaints.
* User/deduction\-related issues.
* Outstanding payments.
* Client dissatisfaction/escalation.
* Property drop/churn risk.


 The objective should be
 **zero surprise escalations** 
 —the CSM should identify risks before the client raises them.
   

  

* Grievance \& Escalation Management
* Monitor all open grievances on a daily basis.
* Ensure tickets are progressing within defined TAT/SLA.
* Coordinate with Operations and CCE teams for resolution.
* Follow up with technicians where required.
* Ensure "Under Review" cases are actively followed up and not left unattended.
* Personally handle critical client escalations.
* Keep clients updated until final resolution.
* Ensure closure is properly documented in Zoho.
* Installation \& Operational Coordination
* Coordinate with Operations for new installations.
* Track installation pendency and ageing.
* Ensure technicians complete assigned work properly.
* Ensure final checking/closure processes are followed.
* Coordinate re\-visits wherever genuinely required.
* Ensure client communication happens during important operational activities.
* Identify recurring operational issues and escalate them to management.
* Customer Retention


 The CSM will be directly responsible for reducing customer churn.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Identify properties showing dissatisfaction or drop risk.
* Maintain a Property Risk/Health Tracker.
* Understand reasons behind client dissatisfaction.
* Create action plans for high\-risk properties.
* Escalate commercial/operational risks to management early.
* Conduct regular client health reviews.
* Maintain strong engagement with decision\-makers.


 Retention is a core CSM responsibility, with customer health and churn risk being standard measures in modern customer\-success teams.
   

  

* Outstanding \& Revenue Coordination
* Monitor outstanding amounts for assigned properties.
* Follow up with clients for pending payments.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation.
* Identify accounts where outstanding is increasing.
* Escalate chronic payment delays.
* Support Finance in improving collection timelines.
* Ensure billing/payment\-related client concerns are resolved quickly.
* Auto\-Pay \& Product Adoption
* Drive adoption of Auto\-Pay among assigned properties.
* Encourage clients to use Aliste's Partner App and relevant features.
* Educate clients on the benefits of the system.
* Monitor usage/adoption.
* Identify properties with low adoption and create an action plan.
* Client Meetings \& Reviews
* Conduct regular client meetings.
* Prepare property performance updates before meetings.
* Discuss:
+ Meter health
+ Grievances
+ Installations
+ Collections
+ Consumption\-related concerns
+ Pending actions
+ Overall property performance

* Share MOM after meetings.
* Ensure every action item has an owner and deadline.


 The CSM should act as the
 **single owner coordinating these teams** 
 , rather than allowing the client to chase multiple internal teams.
   

  

* Reporting \& Data Management
* Maintain accurate client/property data.
* Update Zoho/CRM on a real\-time basis.
* Maintain daily/weekly CSM reports.
* Track open grievances and ageing.
* Track property health.
* Track outstanding.
* Track client meetings.
* Track retention/drop risks.
* Share weekly performance reports with management.

Set up and validate the PD flow on a new PDK, including tool/flow bring-up and "pipe-clean" trial runs. Team leadership (critical) Lead a pod of ~10 junior PD engineers: assign blocks/tasks, set technical direction, and balance load dynamically across project phases. Review the team's work — floorplans, timing reports, signoff results — and enforce quality gates before handoff. Mentor and upskill junior engineers on advanced-node methodology, debugging, and tool usage. Run review-gate checkpoints (floorplan signoff, CTS targets, release candidates) and present status, risks, and QoR to internal and customer stakeholders. Coordinate handoffs with RTL/DV, DFT, and PV/signoff specialists, and drive rapid issue resolution on ECOs and debug requests. Advanced-node experience: Proven work at 7nm/5nm/3nm or below; FinFET closure mandatory, gate-all-around / advanced-node exposure a strong plus. Tools: Strong hands-on with the Synopsys + Siemens flow used on this program: Synthesis & PnR: Synopsys Fusion Compiler (or Design Compiler + ICC2) Timing: Synopsys PrimeTime (incl. SI / ECO) Extraction: Synopsys StarRC Formal/LEC: Synopsys Formality Physical verification: Siemens Calibre (nmDRC, nmLVS, PERC, multi-patterning) DFT: Siemens Tessent (scan, MemoryBIST, boundary scan) Power/IR/EM: Ansys RedHawk-SC (Cadence Innovus/Tempus/Quantus exposure is a plus for flow flexibility.) Methodology: Solid grasp of low-power design (multi-Vt, clock/power gating, multi-voltage domains), CDC handling, DFT integration, and signoff-quality QoR metrics (WNS/TNS, 0-violation DRC/LVS, EM, thermal). Scripting: TCL and Python (Perl a plus) for flow automation and productivity. Experience on high-throughput DSP / wireless / MIMO datapaths, systolic arrays, or large matrix-compute blocks. The ideal candidate will focus on the physical and electrical hardware aspects of gimbal systems, ensuring reliability in harsh environmental conditions. This role is suited for a hands-on hardware specialist who excels in connectors, harnessing, sealing, thermal management, and system-level integration of gimbal subsystems. Key Responsibilities Hardware Design & Integration Design and develop robust hardware architecture for 2-axis/3-axis gimbal systems. Integrate motors, sensors, cameras, PCBs, and wiring subsystems into compact and reliable assemblies. Ensure proper mechanical-electrical interfacing, grounding, and shielding practices. Connectors, Harness & Wiring Select and validate connectors (circular, micro-D, board-to-board, rugged connectors) based on application requirements. Design and develop wiring harnesses, including routing, strain relief, and serviceability. Ensure compliance with communication protocol harness standards for: o UART, RS232, RS485 o Ethernet / IP-based systems o Video signal transmission (HDMI, LVDS, MIPI, etc.) Perform signal integrity and EMI/EMC considerations in harness design. Environmental Protection & Sealing Design systems to meet IP ratings (IP65/IP67/IP68) for dust and water resistance. Select and implement gaskets, O-rings, sealing compounds, and potting materials. Ensure proper waterproofing and environmental sealing across enclosures, connectors, and cable interfaces. Collaborate on shock, vibration, and environmental robustness requirements. Thermal Management Analyze and implement thermal solutions including: 1) Heatsinks. 2) Thermal pads and interface materials. 3) Passive cooling strategies Ensure optimal heat dissipation for motors, electronics, and embedded systems. Motor & Hardware Component Selection Select appropriate gimbal motors (BLDC / torque motors) based on mechanical and electrical constraints. Evaluate hardware components such as fasteners, brackets, housings, and mounting interfaces. Understand mechanical load paths and ensure structural integrity. Testing & Validation Conduct hardware validation tests, including: 1) Waterproofing/IP tests 2) Vibration and shock testing 3) Thermal performance validation Troubleshoot hardware-related issues across connectors, wiring, and packaging. description:
Role & responsibilities Role Purpose The Delivery Account Manager is responsible for the end-to-end delivery, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and strategic growth of assigned automotive engineering-services accounts. The role serves as the primary bridge between the customer and internal delivery teams, ensuring that engineering programs are delivered on time, within budget, at the expected quality level, and in line with agreed scope, milestones, and service-level commitments. The position combines account governance, delivery leadership, stakeholder management, program oversight, team development, and identification of growth opportunities within existing accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in automotive product development or engineering services, along with the ability to manage complex customer relationships across technical, commercial, and operational stakeholders. Similar roles typically require ownership of delivery performance, resource planning, customer reviews, service KPIs, issue resolution, and account expansion.linkedin+2 Key Responsibilities Account and Customer Management Serve as the primary delivery contact for assigned automotive OEM, Tier-1, Tier-2, or mobility customer accounts. Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across engineering, program management, purchasing, quality, manufacturing, and leadership functions. Understand the customers product roadmap, engineering priorities, technical challenges, delivery expectations, and upcoming business opportunities. Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, translating requirements into clear delivery plans and actions. Conduct regular customer governance meetings, including weekly delivery reviews, monthly operational reviews, and quarterly business reviews. Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication, transparent reporting, and timely issue resolution. Ensure delivery against agreed scope, timelines, cost, quality, resource plans, milestones, and contractual commitments. Review project plans, work-breakdown structures, resource plans, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and change requests with project and technical leads. Monitor project health and provide timely status reporting to customer and internal leadership. Identify delivery risks early and drive mitigation plans in coordination with engineering, program management, quality, and functional leaders. Lead resolution of cross-functional issues affecting delivery, including technical dependencies, requirements changes, capacity constraints, quality concerns, and customer approvals. Ensure effective project closure, lessons learned, knowledge capture, and implementation of improvement actions. Engineering and Automotive Domain Leadership Provide functional oversight for automotive engineering-services programs in one or more domains such as: Vehicle engineering and integration Body-in-white, closures, trim, seating, and interiors Chassis, suspension, steering, braking, and dynamics Powertrain, electrification, battery, and thermal systems Electrical and electronics architecture Embedded software, AUTOSAR, diagnostics, and connected vehicles ADAS, autonomous-driving features, and validation CAE, CFD, durability, crash, and simulation Manufacturing engineering, tooling, and industrialization Testing, validation, homologation, and certification Ensure teams follow applicable customer processes, automotive engineering standards, quality systems, and development methodologies. Develop and maintain account plans, delivery forecasts, capacity plans, and budget-versus-actual performance. Partner with sales and business-development teams to identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities within assigned accounts. Support preparation of proposals, statements of work, effort estimates, rate cards, resource plans, and commercial presentations. Manage scope changes, change requests, effort variations, and commercial approvals in accordance with contractual and internal governance requirements. Track purchase orders, invoicing milestones, timesheet approvals, billing inputs, receivables, and potential revenue leakage. Support account-growth initiatives through cross-selling, upselling, new service offerings, managed-services conversion, and expansion into additional engineering domains. People and Resource Management Lead and mentor project managers, engineering leads, and delivery teams assigned to the account. Ensure appropriate staffing, onboarding, capability alignment, utilization, succession planning, and employee engagement. Collaborate with resource management and functional leaders to address skill gaps, hiring needs, attrition risks, and ramp-up or ramp-down requirements. Define competency-development plans aligned with customer technology needs and future account-growth priorities. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, quality, innovation, and continuous improvement. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching to delivery leaders and team members. Process Excellence and Continuous Improvement Drive delivery excellence through standardization, automation, reusable assets, productivity initiatives, and lessons learned. Establish and improve account-level dashboards, governance processes, escalation mechanisms, and risk-management practices. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for recurring delivery, quality, or customer-satisfaction issues. Ensure adherence to internal policies, information-security requirements, confidentiality obligations, and customer data-protection expectations. Monitor, track, and take actions on monthly sustainability global KPIs (CO2 footprint and Gj energy consumption). Lead manpower development, foster team involvement, and manage team reward and recognition programs. Ensure the overall cost competitiveness of plant and equipment maintenance operations. title: Packaging Innovation Engineer
description:
Location: Indore Job Summary To support the implementation of packaging innovation projects from concept through commercialization, including packaging-change assessment, trials, commissioning, and operational handover. The role ensures packaging innovations are delivered safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP, Quality, EHS, and engineering requirements while maintaining packaging-line performance. It also drives the evaluation and implementation of innovative packaging technologies and sustainable solutions across tubes, caps, shippers, and other packaging formats to support business growth, operational excellence, and sustainability objectives. Responsibilities 1. Packaging Innovation Project Execution Support packaging innovation projects from concept to commercialization. Coordinate trials, commissioning, start-up, and implementation activities. Work with R&D, Packaging Development, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and suppliers to deliver projects on time. Review equipment layouts, installation requirements, and project risks using AutoCAD or similar tools. Identify and evaluate emerging packaging technologies, innovative packaging concepts, and industry best practices to support future business needs. 2. Packaging Equipment & Process Assessment Assess the impact of packaging changes on equipment, tooling, utilities, and line performance. Identify and implement required equipment modifications, format parts, and engineering changes. Evaluate manufacturing readiness and equipment capability for new packaging materials, components, and formats. Support qualification, validation, and change-control activities. 3. Operations, OEE & Continuous Improvement Support trials and commercialization while maintaining operational efficiency. Monitor equipment performance, analyses losses, and drive OEE improvements. Apply root-cause analysis and corrective actions to improve reliability and performance. Support Autonomous Maintenance and Professional Maintenance practices. Identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce material consumption, and enhance operational sustainability. 4. Supplier & Stakeholder Management Coordinate with suppliers, OEMs, contractors, and internal stakeholders. Review technical proposals, specifications, layouts, and equipment solutions. Collaborate with packaging-material suppliers and technology partners to evaluate innovative and sustainable packaging solutions. Support FAT, SAT, trials, and technical acceptance activities. Maintain effective communication throughout project execution, commissioning, and handover. 5. GMP, Quality, EHS & Compliance Ensure compliance with GMP, quality, safety, and data integrity requirements. Participate in risk assessments, commissioning safety reviews, and change control activities. Support machine safety, guarding, interlocks, and energy isolation requirements. Assist in audits, CAPA, investigations, and inspection readiness activities. Escalate any risks impacting safety, quality, compliance, or equipment performance. 6. Key Working Relationships Internal: Packaging Development, R&D, Packaging Lead, Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Quality, EHS, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Project Teams. External: Packaging-material suppliers, equipment OEMs, tooling suppliers, consultants, contractors, and system integrators. Qualification and Experience B.E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, or a related core engineering discipline from a reputed institute. 3 - 5 Years of experience in FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Personal Care, Food, Pharmaceutical, or a similar manufacturing industry is preferred. Experience supporting Packaging Engineering, Packaging Innovation, Project Engineering, Packaging Development Support, or Manufacturing Operations. Required Skills and Competencies Ability to assess the impact of packaging-material and packaging-format changes on manufacturing operations and packaging equipment. Good understanding of OEE, manufacturing losses, and structured loss-reduction techniques. Working knowledge of Autonomous Maintenance and Professional Maintenance principles. Ability to evaluate emerging packaging technologies, new packaging formats, and sustainable packaging solutions for business applications. Working knowledge of AutoCAD for reviewing and updating packaging-line layouts and equipment-arrangement drawings. Strong supplier-management, stakeholder-coordination, project-tracking, action-tracking, and follow-up skills. Ability to analyze technical issues using data, shop-floor observations, and structured root-cause techniques. Basic understanding of packaging equipment, tooling requirements, machine change parts, equipment performance, and preventive-maintenance practices. Basic awareness of industrial automation and control systems, including PLCs, HMIs, sensors, drives, alarms, and interlocks. Basic knowledge of GMP, quality systems, EHS requirements, permit-to-work systems, energy isolation or LOTO, and change control. Effective communication, presentation, influencing, and collaboration skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications for analysis, documentation, reporting, and project coordination. Preferred Packaging Equipment Exposure Exposure to high-speed packaging equipment is preferred but not essential. Relevant equipment may include: Tube filling and sealing machines. Cartoners, coding, and print-verification systems. Checkweighers, inspection, and reject systems. Shrink bundlers, case packers, case sealers, and case-coding equipment. Conveying, accumulation, palletizing, and stretch-wrapping systems. Key Success Measures Successful development and commercialization of innovative packaging solutions meeting consumer, quality, sustainability, and business needs. Successful introduction and implementation of emerging packaging technologies and sustainable packaging materials. Effective delivery of packaging design, trials, validation, and manufacturing implementation activities. Robust packaging performance meeting quality, efficiency, cost, sustainability, and consumer experience requirements. Enhanced technical capability and readiness of operations, quality, and engineering teams. Successful delivery of packaging innovation, sustainability, and productivity improvement projects.
