title: Data Engineer
description:
The Opportunity EY GDS is looking for a Senior Data and AI Engineering professional to design, build and operate cloud-native data platforms and AI/ML solutions, primarily on Google Cloud. In this role, you will work on industry-led use cases that combine scalable data engineering, Vertex AI-based machine learning, GenAI-enabled automation and token-aware solution design to help clients modernize enterprise data platforms and accelerate insight generation. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build robust pipelines, integrate GenAI capabilities into data workflows, optimize token usage and cost efficiency, and support production-grade deployments using modern engineering, containerization and CI/CD practices. While the primary focus will be on Google Cloud, candidates should also understand how similar data engineering, AI/ML and GenAI solution patterns can be deployed on Microsoft Azure, where required by client or enterprise architecture needs. Your Key Responsibilities Design, build and optimize scalable data pipelines and ETL workflows using Python, Java, Go or Scala, and run them on Apache Flink, Apache Spark and Google Cloud Dataflow, with Dataflow experience preferred. Build cloud-native AI/ML solutions using Vertex AI for industry-specific use cases. Candidates should be able to describe the business use case they support, the data flow, model lifecycle and measurable outcome enabled by the solution. Integrate GenAI capabilities with data pipelines to enhance automation, insight generation, predictive analytics and intelligent data processing across enterprise platforms. Apply token economics principles while designing GenAI-enabled solutions, including prompt optimization, token usage monitoring, cost control, latency management and performance trade-off assessment. Stay current with emerging AI and GenAI technologies and identify practical ways to embed GenAI-driven intelligence into modern data platforms. Design reusable solution patterns for data engineering, AI/ML and GenAI workloads, with primary implementation on Google Cloud and the ability to adapt similar solutions for deployment on Microsoft Azure where required. Develop and maintain application components and automation scripts using Java, Python, Go and scripting languages. Manage the complete application and container lifecycle, including build, packaging, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting and support. Apply strong public cloud engineering practices, with hands-on expertise in Google Cloud. Professional or Practitioner certification on GCP is required. Demonstrate working knowledge of Microsoft Azure services to support deployment of similar data, AI/ML and GenAI solution architectures across client cloud environments. Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application builds and target platform deployments. Follow standard procedures for escalating unresolved issues to the appropriate internal engineering teams, with clear problem statements and supporting diagnostics. Document technical knowledge, deployment steps, support notes and operating procedures in the form of reusable notes, runbooks and manuals. Good to have experience with Apache Beam and Java/Spring Boot for pipeline and application development. Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution. Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals. Skills and attributes for success Strong hands-on experience in data engineering, cloud-native engineering and production-grade AI/ML solution delivery on Google Cloud. Practical experience with Vertex AI, including model development or integration, deployment patterns and use-case-driven implementation for enterprise or industry scenarios. Ability to build and optimize ETL/data pipelines using Python, Java, Go or Scala, and execute workloads on Spark, Flink and Google Cloud Dataflow. Working knowledge of GenAI integration patterns for automation, insight generation, predictive analytics and intelligent data workflows. Understanding of token economics for GenAI solutions, including prompt design efficiency, token consumption, latency, cost optimization, usage monitoring and governance considerations. Awareness of multi-cloud deployment patterns, with the ability to translate similar data engineering, AI/ML and GenAI solution architectures from Google Cloud to Microsoft Azure where client environments require it. Basic to working knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services relevant to data platforms, AI/ML workloads, GenAI-enabled applications and cloud-native deployment. Strong programming skills in Java, Python, Go and scripting languages, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize application and data-processing components. Good understanding of application and container lifecycle management, including containerized deployment, operational readiness and supportability. Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines for build, validation and target platform deployment. Professional or Practitioner-level Google Cloud certification, with demonstrated hands-on public cloud delivery experience. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability and a structured approach to escalation, documentation and knowledge sharing. Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with product, data, platform and engineering teams in a delivery-focused environment. Good to have familiarity with Apache Beam and Java/Spring Boot. description:
JOB DESCRIPTION FINANCE & ACCOUNTS OFFICER Company: Jindal Projects and Engineers
 Department: Finance & Accounts
 Designation: Finance & Accounts Officer
 Reporting To: Finance Manager / Head – Finance & Accounts
 Location: As per company requirement
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. Position Summary The Finance & Accounts Officer will independently handle end-to-end accounting operations across key areas including general accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, taxation, banking, payroll, and MIS . The position is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring statutory compliance, supporting timely financial reporting, and providing reliable financial information to management. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of accounting principles, taxation, statutory compliances, banking operations, and accounting software, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines. 2. Key Responsibilities A. General Accounting Handle day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities. Prepare and post journal entries, payment entries, receipt entries, purchase and sales entries. Maintain general ledger, cash book, bank book and other accounting records. Perform regular ledger scrutiny and account reconciliation. Ensure proper accounting and documentation of all financial transactions. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. B. Accounts Payable Process vendor invoices and verify supporting documents. Ensure proper accounting of purchases, expenses and vendor liabilities. Prepare vendor payment schedules and coordinate for timely payments. Reconcile vendor accounts and resolve discrepancies. Maintain accurate records of outstanding payables. C. Accounts Receivable Prepare and record customer invoices and debit/credit notes. Monitor customer outstanding balances and receivables. Conduct regular customer ledger reconciliation. Follow up for outstanding payments in coordination with the concerned departments. Prepare ageing reports and support collection activities. D. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Assist in ensuring timely compliance with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory requirements . Prepare and maintain data required for GST returns, TDS returns and other statutory filings. Verify tax deductions and ensure correct accounting of statutory liabilities. Reconcile GST input/output records and resolve discrepancies. Maintain proper records and supporting documents for audits and statutory requirements. Coordinate with consultants, auditors and statutory authorities whenever required. E. Banking & Cash Management Handle day-to-day banking transactions. Prepare bank payment instructions and related documentation. Perform regular bank reconciliations. Monitor bank balances and cash flows. Maintain proper records of cheque, online and other banking transactions. Coordinate with banks regarding routine banking matters. F. Payroll & Employee Accounting Coordinate with HR for monthly payroll processing. Verify salary-related data, deductions, advances and reimbursements. Ensure proper accounting of payroll and employee-related expenses. Assist with statutory deductions and payroll-related compliances. Maintain employee advances and settlement records. G. MIS & Financial Reporting Prepare periodic MIS reports for management. Prepare reports relating to receivables, payables, expenses, cash flow and outstanding balances. Provide financial data and analysis as required by management. Support preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements. Identify discrepancies, unusual transactions and variances and bring them to management's attention. H. Audit & Documentation Coordinate with internal, statutory and tax auditors. Provide required schedules, ledgers, vouchers and supporting documents. Maintain proper filing and documentation of financial records. Assist in responding to audit queries and implementing corrective actions. 3. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related field. B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter or equivalent qualification will be preferred. Strong working knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes. Practical knowledge of GST, TDS and basic statutory compliances . Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software such as Tally / ERP systems . Good numerical, analytical and reconciliation skills. 4. Experience 3–7 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts. Experience in handling end-to-end accounting operations independently will be preferred. Candidates with experience in engineering, construction, manufacturing, EPC or project-based organisations will have an added advantage. 5. Key Skills & Competencies Strong accounting and reconciliation skills. Good knowledge of taxation and statutory compliance. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Strong MS Excel and ERP/accounting software skills. Ability to independently manage multiple accounting activities. Good analytical and problem-solving ability. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality of financial information. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet statutory and reporting deadlines. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy and completeness of accounting records. Timely closure of monthly accounts. Timely completion of GST/TDS and other applicable compliances. Timely bank, vendor and customer reconciliations. Accuracy of MIS and financial reports. Reduction in outstanding receivables and reconciliation differences. Timely processing of vendor payments and employee-related transactions. Audit compliance and timely resolution of audit queries. 7. Preferred Candidate Profile The preferred candidate should be a self-driven and responsible finance professional capable of independently managing day-to-day accounting operations. The candidate should demonstrate strong practical knowledge of accounting, taxation, reconciliations, banking and MIS, along with a high level of accuracy and ownership. title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
description:
Job Summary The Engine Field Service Technician - Level II is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining, and completing less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites. The role requires a strong customer focus, sound technical knowledge, effective troubleshooting skills, and adherence to Cummins safety, quality, and service standards. The role may be considered for both internal and external candidates , based on relevant qualifications, technical capability, experience, and business requirements. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and complete less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites using approved procedures, service publications, specialized tools, and electronic service tools. Engage with customers in a courteous and professional manner, understand their needs, and provide prompt and effective service solutions. Translate customer complaints into structured troubleshooting plans and identify failed components through appropriate diagnostic methods. Perform preventive maintenance activities in accordance with documented schedules, procedures, and technical standards. Identify, prepare, and use the required parts, tools, equipment, and service information to complete repairs efficiently and accurately. Apply knowledge of engine mechanical and electrical systems, including fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, sensors, controls, and related systems, to diagnose and resolve issues. Validate completed repairs by confirming that the reported issue has been resolved and the equipment is operating as required. Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to experienced Field Service Technicians, technical experts, or the Supervisor, as appropriate. Accurately complete service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality records, and required information in business systems. Maintain accurate customer, equipment, technical, and troubleshooting records to support service history and future diagnostics. Identify additional service opportunities and communicate relevant customer needs to support service excellence. Maintain service vehicles, tools, and equipment in a clean, safe, and operational condition. Complete required technical and developmental training in line with individual skill requirements and business needs. Comply with all applicable Health, Safety Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation, and promptly report incidents, hazards, or other concerns to site management and the Supervisor. Promote a professional, customer-focused, and safety-oriented approach across all field service activities. Key account manager service for HHP segment. Adherence to Service Level Agreement (SLA), HSE guidelines and other business compliance. 1. Have clear understanding of contract scope and discuss with all the concerned at dealership on the commencement of any new contract. 
 2. Support dealership and solution team to prepare an accurate PM schedule. 
 3. Failure trend analysis especially under LHP CAMC and ensure stocking of parts as per FTA through DAMs. 
 4. Ensure the team reviews open SRN regularly and supporting dealership on PM and breakdown SLA compliance. 
 5. Ensure 100 % utilization of contract cap value. Have a monthly review of parts consumption to be tracked and ensure consumption of supplied parts are as per agreed cap value of individual contract. Prepare proactive maintenances and parts replacement in order to prevent breakdowns and share with the customer as per capped value yearly. 
 6. Ensure that vendor evaluation score should be above 95% for all the CAMC customers Develop relationship with customer 1. Prepare and update key / CAMC customer profiles highlighting decision-making positions. Update yearly 
 2. Plan proactive customer engagement and comply. Plan monthly 10 customer / month 
 3. Create 100% activities against all the action points decided in the meeting and track to close as per the agreed timelines. Also keep the customer posted with updates for the Open action items. Within 3 days of the meeting. 
 4. Conduct QBR / MIS with key CAMC customers. Quarterly 
 5. Identify critical success factor of all the key customer in the region and prepare customer support plan accordingly. 
 6. Aim to improve the percentage of customer issues resolved on the first contact, minimizing escalations and enhancing overall customer satisfaction. PM Quality Enhancement 1. ensure that all CAMC service KAMs carryout service quality audits at least for 5 DGs in a month based on 2 previous PMs done and share report with HOD, maintain a tracker with before and after audit status. 
 2. Release consolidated report with findings and improvement plan and track the improvement in processes at dealership. 
 3. Conduct preventative maintenance trainings per dealership. Cover all branches through Area offices KAMs 
 4. Drive seasonal check-ups / maintenance campaigns. -> Seasons / geographical locations 
 5. Audit DG sets older than 10 years through AO KAMs. min 5 DGs / month 
 6. Drive alternator maintenance compliance with all the CAMC customers. Increase in Alternator maintenance SRNs by 20% over previous year. 
 7. Conduct health checks and lube oil sample analysis. Prepare and release an yearly plan and release compliance status monthly. Predictive Maintenance Drive 1. Analyse service data of 5 Key customers in the area at least for last 2 years and identify parts support gaps and failure trend and take proactive measures to prevent the failures for HHP/LHP at key customers. Publish the analysis once in 6 months. 
 2. Identify the engines having clocked more than 5000 hours or 5 years, whichever is earlier and carry out health check ups to demonstrate our value added services to customer. 
 3. Submit RCA of all the failure to the customer within 3 days along with CAPA Key Competencies Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally across different audiences and situations. Customer Focus: Builds positive customer relationships and delivers solutions aligned with customer needs. Diagnostics Troubleshooting: Uses structured troubleshooting approaches, technical information, service tools, and measurements to identify and resolve product issues. Electronic Service Tool Application: Selects and effectively uses appropriate electronic hardware and software tools for diagnosis, maintenance, and repair. Engine Systems Knowledge: Understands the interaction between mechanical and electrical engine systems and applies this knowledge to field diagnostics and repair. Product Repair Maintenance: Performs repairs, maintenance, component replacement, disassembly, and assembly in accordance with approved procedures and quality standards. Service Documentation: Accurately records technical information, troubleshooting activities, repairs, and service outcomes in the required systems. Technical Escalation: Recognizes issues requiring additional expertise and escalates them appropriately while ensuring complete documentation of troubleshooting performed. Health Safety: Demonstrates proactive safety behavior, identifies hazards, follows HSE requirements, and contributes to a safe working environment. Manages Complexity: Analyzes technical information and applies sound judgment to resolve field service issues. Self-Development: Demonstrates a willingness to learn, develop technical capability, and complete required training. Develops Talent: Supports knowledge sharing and contributes to the development of colleagues where appropriate. Values Differences: Works effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and values different perspectives. Qualifications Vocational diploma/certificate from a relevant technical institution. Apprentice-trained Engine Technician qualification is preferred. Locally valid driving permit/license. Any additional technical certifications relevant to engine, mechanical, electrical, or field service activities would be advantageous. The position may require applicable licensing or authorization to comply with export control and sanctions regulations. Skills Basic to intermediate troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for engines and related systems. Ability to use mechanical and electronic service tools and diagnostic equipment. Ability to interpret service manuals, technical publications, diagnostic results, and repair procedures. Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical engine systems. Ability to perform preventive maintenance and less complex repairs independently. Good customer service and interpersonal skills. Ability to accurately complete service reports, warranty documentation, timesheets, and electronic service records. Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work safely and effectively at customer sites. Ability to identify when technical escalation is required. Willingness to travel and work in field/customer-site environments as required. Experience Basic level field service experience is preferred. Intermediate-level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products. Experience in engine maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, or related technical service environments. Customer service experience, preferably in a technical or field service environment. Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical documentation would be advantageous. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a technically capable and customer-focused professional who can independently handle routine field service activities and less complex engine repairs while recognizing when issues require escalation. The candidate should demonstrate strong safety awareness, willingness to learn, disciplined service documentation, and the ability to build effective customer relationships.

What You ll Do Support the design of game features, systems, content, and live-service experiences . Turn design ideas into clear flows, rules, requirements, and design documentation. Participate in brainstorming and design discussions , contributing ideas for new mechanics, features, events, and player experiences. Playtest features and content, identify design problems, gather feedback, and iterate on solutions. Work with designers, engineers, artists, experience designers, product managers, analysts, and QA to take ideas from concept toward implementation. Use player feedback, game data, and design principles to understand how features can be improved. Support balancing gameplay, progression, rewards, difficulty, and other game systems. Research games and competitors to understand design patterns, player motivations, market trends, and opportunities for innovation. Contribute to live-service content such as events, challenges, progression experiences, or other recurring player activities. Explore how emerging tools, including AI-assisted workflows , can help improve ideation, research, prototyping, documentation, and iteration. What You Bring A foundational understanding of game design principles , including gameplay loops, player motivation, progression, balance, feedback, challenge, and reward. Strong interest in building games and understanding why players find experiences engaging and fun . Creative and structured problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate ideas clearly through written documentation, diagrams, presentations, or prototypes. Curiosity, willingness to learn, and openness to feedback and iteration. Ability to collaborate effectively with people from different disciplines. Currently pursuing a degree/diploma in Game Design, Game Development, Computer Science, Interactive Media, or a related discipline , or able to demonstrate equivalent skills through personal or academic projects. A portfolio, playable project, prototype, game jam project, level, system design, or other game-design work that demonstrates your thinking and interest in game development. Experience designing levels, game systems, economies, progression, quests, events, or other game content. A broad interest in different game genres and a habit of breaking down and analyzing the games you play. 
 
 About Electronic Arts We re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

The role will work closely with management and project teams to ensure effective manpower deployment and smooth HR operations.
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Recruitment & Manpower Planning 
 Coordinate with department/project heads to understand manpower requirements. Prepare and maintain manpower plans and recruitment trackers. Source, screen, interview, and coordinate the selection of candidates. Coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, joining formalities, and onboarding. Maintain recruitment MIS and monitor vacancies until closure. B. HR Operations 
 Manage employee onboarding, transfers, confirmations, promotions, and exits. Maintain employee records, personal files, and HR databases. Ensure timely completion of HR documentation. Maintain employee master data and HRMS records. Implement HR policies and procedures effectively. C. Attendance & Payroll 
 Monitor daily attendance, leave, late coming, absenteeism, and overtime. Prepare and verify monthly payroll inputs. Coordinate with Finance/Payroll team for salary processing. Resolve employee queries related to attendance, leave, and payroll. Maintain accurate leave and attendance records. D. Employee Relations 
 Handle employee grievances and workplace concerns. Maintain effective communication between employees and management. Support disciplinary procedures and issue HR communications when required. Conduct employee counselling and facilitate conflict resolution. Promote a positive and professional work environment. E. Performance Management 
 Coordinate periodic performance appraisal processes. Follow up with department heads for performance evaluations. Maintain appraisal and performance records. Support management in promotions, increments, and employee development initiatives. F. Statutory Compliance 
 Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Coordinate PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity, Labour Welfare Fund and other applicable compliances. Maintain statutory registers, records, and documentation. Coordinate with labour consultants and statutory authorities where required. Support internal and external HR/statutory audits. G. Training & Development 
 Identify training requirements in coordination with department heads. Prepare and maintain training calendars. Coordinate employee training and development programs. Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness. H. Project / Site HR 
 Coordinate manpower requirements for construction/project sites. Monitor site manpower deployment and attendance. Coordinate onboarding and documentation of project/site employees. Support contract labour documentation and statutory compliance. Coordinate with Project, Administration, Finance, and Site teams. Monitor employee welfare and site HR-related requirements. I. HR MIS & Reporting 
Prepare and submit regular HR reports covering:
 Employee headcount Manpower deployment Recruitment status New joiners Employee exits Attrition Attendance and absenteeism Leave Overtime Payroll inputs Training Employee grievances Statutory compliance J. Exit & Full & Final Settlement 
 Manage employee resignation and separation processes. Coordinate notice period and handover formalities. Conduct exit interviews. Coordinate clearance and full & final settlement with Finance. Ensure proper issuance of relieving and experience letters. 3. Required Qualifications 
 Graduate in any discipline. MBA / PG Diploma in Human Resources preferred. Additional certification in HR / Labour Laws will be an advantage. 4. Required Experience 
 57 years of relevant experience in Human Resources , preferably within:
 Real Estate Construction Infrastructure Hospitality Engineering / Project-based organizations 5. Required Skills 
 Strong knowledge of HR operations and processes. Recruitment and manpower planning. Employee relations and grievance handling. Attendance and payroll coordination. Labour law and statutory compliance knowledge. Strong MS Excel and HRMS skills. HR MIS and reporting. Good written and verbal communication. Strong interpersonal and coordination skills. Problem-solving and decision-making ability. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Position (Title) : Talent Acquisition Specialist 
Experience Required : 5-8 Years 
Location : Hyderabad 
 Role Overview: We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our HR team and manage end-to-end recruitment across technical and non-technical roles. The ideal candidate should be a strong talent sourcer and stakeholder manager, with the ability to understand business requirements, identify the right talent, manage multiple positions simultaneously, and deliver a smooth candidate experience in a fast-paced environment. 
 Role& Responsibilities: 
 End-to-End Recruitment Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requirement understanding, sourcing, and screening to interview coordination, selection, offer management, and onboarding handover. Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, define candidate profiles, and create effective JDs. Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while meeting agreed hiring timelines and targets. 
 Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, professional networks, and other relevant channels. Use effective Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques to identify relevant talent. Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and upcoming business requirements. Research talent markets and identify new sourcing channels to improve hiring effectiveness. 
 Stakeholder Management Partner with hiring managers and business stakeholders throughout the recruitment process. Conduct regular discussions on hiring priorities, candidate feedback, and pipeline status. Provide timely updates on open positions, interview progress, challenges, and expected closures. Act as a trusted point of contact for candidates and internal stakeholders throughout the hiring journey. 
 Recruitment Operations & Reporting Maintain accurate candidate and recruitment data in the ATS/HRIS. Track recruitment metrics such as Time-to-Fill, Time-to-Hire, Source Effectiveness, Interview-to-Selection Ratio, and Offer Acceptance Rate. Ownership of recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring reports and updates. Ensure recruitment documentation and processes are completed accurately and on time. 
 Candidate Experience & Employer Branding Ensure a professional and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. Maintain timely communication with candidates at every stage of the hiring cycle. Support employer branding and talent attraction initiatives through relevant recruitment campaigns and engagement activities. 
 Required Skills: 
 Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end Talent Acquisition / Recruitment. Proven experience hiring for both technical and non-technical positions. Strong sourcing skills using Naukri, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms. Good understanding of Boolean Search, X-ray Search, and passive candidate sourcing. Strong candidate screening and interviewing skills. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and hiring requirements independently. Strong follow-up, coordination, and negotiation skills. Data-driven approach with an understanding of recruitment metrics and hiring analytics. Experience working with ATS/HRMS platforms. 
 Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 5-8 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment. Experience in a technology-driven or fast-paced organization is preferred.

title: HR Generalist
description:
SOFTLINK GLOBAL PEOPLE CULTURE HR Generalist (Payroll Compliance) Location: Mumbai (Marol) | Permanent (Full-time) | Experience: 3 to 6 years 
 A quick sense of who you would be joining: Young and fast - Average age is 26. You will support a team that learns quickly and moves quicker. Global by default - Logi-Sys runs in 50+ countries and we are pushing into more. Your work touches a business that crosses global borders every single day. People who stay - Average tenure is 7 years. We build careers here, not revolving doors. Real room to grow - Many of todays leaders started early in their careers and now run the business, coached directly by the CEO. God-view visibility - Work directly with the CEO, CGO, and Chief of Staff. No layers, no filters, no waiting for your ideas to trickle up. 
 The Role We are hiring an HR Generalist who lives and breathes payroll, compliance, and statutory benefits, and who can own the entire employee journey on top of it. Recruitment, business partnering, engagement: all yours. This is not a keep-the-lights-on role. Payroll and statutory are your anchor, but you get something rare: a genuine mandate to rebuild the processes, policies, and systems behind People Ops as we scale past the 50+ countries we already operate in. If you have been waiting for the permission and the platform to fix how HR actually runs, this is it. 
 What You ll Own Payroll (core) - Run the end-to-end monthly payroll cycle for India: inputs, processing, reconciliation, pay slips, and full-and-final settlements. Zero slippage. Statutory compliance (core) - Keep us fully compliant across PF, ESIC, PT, TDS on salaries, gratuity, bonus, Shops Establishments, and every labour register and filing. Statutory company benefits - Administer statutory and company benefits, including group medical cover enrolments, changes, and the employee queries that come with them. Employee lifecycle - Own the full journey from onboarding and confirmations through transfers, records, and exits, with clean documentation at every step. Systems audit-readiness - Keep payroll and HRIS data accurate and reconciled in Keka, and keep us audit-ready for internal, statutory, and certification (including ISO) reviews. Rebuild, don t just run - Take a hard look at our people processes, policies, and systems and make them sharper as we scale. This is the part most HR roles never get to do. title: HR Generalist
description:
":" ProCreator is looking for an HR Generalist / People Operations professional to own and drive core HR operations across the employee lifecycle, while helping strengthen people processes, employee experience, policy governance, and hiring coordination.
 This role is ideal for someone who is hands-on, process-oriented, and comfortable managing day-to-day HR operations independently. The person will play a key role in ensuring smooth onboarding, employee record management, attendance and leave administration, payroll inputs, engagement initiatives, policy execution, and exit formalities. Alongside this, the role will also support recruitment governance and collaborate closely with the recruiter and hiring stakeholders to ensure process adherence and business continuity.
 While the role is primarily an individual contributor position, the person may oversee one recruiter and is expected to step into hiring execution when recruitment volumes or business priorities demand it.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1) Core HR Operations 
 Own end-to-end employee lifecycle administration from post-offer handover through onboarding, active employment, and exits
 Manage employee records, letters, workflows, approvals, and documentation through HR systems, especially Zoho People 
 Handle joining formalities including employment documents, NDA, code of conduct, KYC, bank details, background verification coordination, and induction readiness
 Coordinate with internal stakeholders such as IT for asset allocation, ID creation, access setup, RFID cards, and other onboarding requirements
 Administer leave, attendance, holiday calendars, attendance regularizations, special leave creation, and exception handling
 Provide accurate monthly payroll inputs to the Accounts team and support resolution of employee queries related to attendance, leave, payroll inputs, and employee records
 Maintain HR documentation required for audits, compliance, and insurance-related processes
 
 2) People Processes and Employee Experience 
 Drive probation confirmations, salary revision documentation, promotions, role changes, and related employee lifecycle actions
 Act as a reliable first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, insurance, documentation, and routine employment matters
 Plan and coordinate employee engagement initiatives including birthdays, work anniversaries, festive celebrations, team activities, culture-building efforts, and internal learning sessions
 Support employee well-being initiatives, feedback surveys, POSH-related coordination, and periodic learning and development facilitation
 Ensure a smooth, professional, and employee-friendly HR experience across key people touchpoints
 
 3) Employee Relations and Governance 
 Support managers on policy interpretation, employee discipline matters, notice period discussions, underperformance cases, and other sensitive people issues, escalating when necessary
 Maintain and update employee handbook, leave policy, code of conduct, and day-to-day HR process documentation
 Help strengthen governance by ensuring HR processes are followed consistently and documentation is maintained accurately
 Own HR workflow updates, template changes, automation requests, and coordination with system partners for issue resolution
 
 4) Recruitment Coordination and Business Support 
 Provide recruitment governance support by coordinating hiring intake, role approvals, interview process adherence, and hiring progress tracking with stakeholders
 Partner with the recruiter and hiring managers on offer approvals, parity checks, onboarding readiness, and seamless handover from recruitment to people operations
 Support hiring execution directly during peak hiring periods or when business needs require additional recruitment bandwidth
 Ensure recruitment ownership is approached with flexibility and collaboration, rather than as a rigidly separated function
 
 

 Requirements Must-Have Skills and Experience 
 45 years of relevant experience in HR operations, people operations, or HR generalist roles 
 Strong hands-on experience managing the employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit
 Working knowledge of HRMS platforms , preferably Zoho People 
 Solid experience in onboarding, HR documentation, leave and attendance management, payroll input coordination, and employee records management 
 Ability to independently handle employee queries and routine people operations matters in a timely and professional manner
 Good understanding of HR policies, process documentation, compliance coordination, and governance practices 
 Experience supporting employee engagement initiatives and people experience programs
 Strong coordination skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with recruiters, managers, Accounts, IT, and leadership
 Willingness to support recruitment execution when required by business demand
 Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, process discipline, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment
 
 Preferred Skills / Nice to Have 
 Proficiency in Zoho People and Zoho Recruit for HR operations and recruitment coordination
 Ability to make backend changes, workflow updates, and system-level process improvements in Zoho tools
 Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling HR processes for operational efficiency
 Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption in HR , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools
 Awareness of evolving HR technology trends and the ability to suggest process or system improvements
 Prior experience working in UX/UI, development, branding, creative, or marketing agency environments will be preferred for stronger business and cultural fit
 
 Education 
 Bachelor degree in any discipline
 Relevant work experience and practical HR capability will be valued more than academic specialization
 
 What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days 
 By the end of the first 90 days, success in this role would look like:
 You have taken ownership of day-to-day HR operations and are independently managing core employee lifecycle processes with minimal supervision
 Employee records, onboarding documentation, leave and attendance tracking, and routine HR workflows are well organized and running smoothly in Zoho People 
 Payroll inputs are being shared accurately and on time, with fewer follow-ups or errors
 New joiner onboarding is structured, timely, and well-coordinated across HR, IT, and other stakeholders
 Employee queries are being responded to promptly and professionally, creating a dependable HR support experience
 Key HR documents, templates, and policy/process trackers are updated, easy to access, and better organized than before
 At least a few process improvement opportunities have been identified and implemented across HR operations, workflows, or system usage
 Employee engagement and people experience initiatives are being run consistently with strong coordination and follow-through
 Recruitment governance is running smoothly, with proper coordination between hiring managers, recruiter, and internal stakeholders
 During high hiring periods, you are able to step in and support recruitment execution without losing grip on core HR operations
 You have built trust with employees, managers, the recruiter, and the COO as a reliable owner of people operations
 
 Who You Are 
 Hands-on and dependable, with a strong bias for execution
 Comfortable balancing structure, empathy, and responsiveness in day-to-day HR work
 Process-minded, organized, and able to manage multiple moving parts without losing detail
 Collaborative and practical in approach, with the confidence to work closely with managers and leadership
 Adaptable enough to support both people operations and hiring priorities as needed

You will help shape core HR processes, improve employee experience, support managers and teams, and bring structure and consistency to the people function while partnering closely with leadership.

Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment across multiple levels and functions. title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition professional with 5+ years of experience , preferably from the Retail industry , who can independently manage PAN India recruitment across retail stores and corporate functions. The candidate should have strong sourcing capabilities, extensive HR/community networks, exposure to campus hiring, and experience in innovative offline recruitment campaigns. Key Responsibilities 1. PAN India Retail Recruitment Manage end-to-end recruitment for PAN India retail stores and corporate requirements . Handle bulk and volume hiring for positions such as Store Managers, Sales Managers, Sales Executives, Cluster Managers, and other retail roles . Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline across different cities and regions. Ensure positions are closed within agreed timelines and hiring targets. 2. Sourcing & Recruitment Utilize Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media, recruitment agencies, and local hiring channels . Develop innovative sourcing strategies for difficult-to-hire and volume positions. Build strong relationships with candidates and ensure a positive candidate experience. Maintain a database of potential candidates for future requirements. 3. Offline & Outdoor Recruitment Advertising Plan and execute recruitment campaigns through Bus, Train/Metro, Auto, Wall Posters, Hoardings, Pamphlets, Local Advertisements, and other outdoor media . Coordinate with vendors/agencies for recruitment advertisements and branding activities. Identify cost-effective local advertising channels to support retail hiring. 4. Campus & College Hiring Drive college/campus hiring initiatives across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities . Establish relationships with colleges, universities, placement cells, and educational institutions. Conduct campus drives, walk-in drives, job fairs, and bulk recruitment campaigns. Build a strong network of colleges for continuous entry-level hiring. 5. HR Community & Local Network Develop and maintain strong contacts with HR professionals, recruiters, consultants, local HR communities, and recruitment networks across India. Leverage HR networking groups and professional communities for faster sourcing. Build local recruitment networks in key retail markets and cities. 6. Recruitment Analytics & Reporting Track recruitment metrics such as open positions, sourcing, interviews, selection, joining ratio, TAT, and hiring cost . Prepare regular recruitment reports and provide updates to management. Identify hiring challenges and implement corrective sourcing strategies. Required Skills & Experience 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment. Strong experience in Retail Hiring / Volume Hiring / PAN India Recruitment . Experience hiring for multiple locations and retail stores across India . Strong knowledge of Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, social media, and other sourcing channels . Exposure to campus hiring, Tier 2 & Tier 3 city hiring, job fairs, and walk-in drives . Experience in offline recruitment advertising and outdoor recruitment campaigns . Strong network with HR communities, recruiters, consultants, and local hiring partners . Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder-management, and coordination skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven recruitment environment . Preferred Candidate Candidates from Retail, Furniture, Home Furnishing, Consumer Durables, FMCG, Lifestyle, or other high-volume hiring industries will be preferred.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
":" We are looking for a Technical Recruiter to own end-to-end hiring execution for ProCreator, with a strong focus on creative and technical roles across UI/UX Design, Graphics/Visual design, Product Design, and Frontend/Backend development .
 This role is ideal for someone who can independently drive recruitment from role intake through offer closure and pre-joining engagement, while partnering closely with hiring managers, HR, and leadership. The recruiter will be responsible not just for execution, but also for improving hiring workflows, maintaining strong candidate experience, and contributing to more efficient, insight-led recruitment operations.
 The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience hiring for agency-style and technical environments, understands the nuances of assessing both creative and technical talent, and is comfortable using modern tools and AI-enabled workflows to improve hiring quality and speed.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Talent Acquisition Execution 
 Own end-to-end recruitment for design and technology roles, especially across UI/UX, visual design, product design, and front-end developer hiring.
 Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and create or refine job descriptions, candidate assessments, hiring tasks, and interview questions.
 Publish and manage open roles across ATS platforms, LinkedIn, job boards, social channels, and relevant sourcing platforms.
 Drive proactive sourcing, outreach, screening, and shortlisting of candidates aligned to role requirements and agency-specific expectations.
 Conduct recruiter screening conversations to assess candidate fit across experience, role relevance, communication, motivations, and compensation expectations.
 Manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely movement of qualified candidates through each stage of the process.
 Coordinate assessments, collect submissions, share them with hiring teams, and drive follow-through on interview stages.
 Stakeholder and Candidate Management 
 Schedule and coordinate interviews across stakeholders while ensuring a smooth and timely process.
 Gather structured interview feedback and keep hiring managers aligned on candidate status, risks, and next steps.
 Deliver a strong candidate experience through clear communication, expectation setting, and timely closure at every stage.
 Support offer discussions, compensation alignment, document collection, and candidate negotiation in partnership with HR and leadership.
 Maintain pre-joining engagement with selected candidates to reduce drop-offs and ensure smooth transition until joining.
 Recruitment Operations and Talent Strategy 
 Build and maintain talent pipelines and market maps for recurring or hard-to-fill roles.
 Work with external agencies, campus partners, and niche talent sources when required.
 Maintain ATS hygiene and ensure accurate candidate records, stage tracking, notes, and follow-ups across all active roles.
 Track recruitment metrics such as source effectiveness, funnel conversion, aging positions, and closure timelines, and share insights with relevant stakeholders.
 Contribute to employer branding from a hiring lens through candidate-facing communication, hiring-related content, and brand perception across recruitment platforms.
 Document and improve recruitment workflows, interview scorecards, candidate communication templates, and best practices to support operational efficiency and scale.
 
 

 Requirements 
 Must-Have Skills and Experience 
 45 years of relevant recruitment experience in an in-house, agency, digital, product studio, or tech/services hiring environment . 
 Strong experience hiring for technical and creative roles , especially in areas such as UI/UX, visual design, product design, and front-end development . 
 Ability to independently manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake to offer closure and pre-joining engagement.
 Strong sourcing and outreach capability across multiple channels and platforms.
 Experience partnering with hiring managers to define role requirements and improve hiring quality.
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to drive alignment and momentum across hiring teams.
 Experience managing ATS workflows and maintaining strong process discipline and candidate tracking hygiene.
 Experience coordinating interviews, managing assessments, and ensuring a smooth candidate journey.
 Ability to evaluate candidates on role relevance, functional capability, communication, and compensation fit.
 Experience supporting offer management and negotiation in coordination with HR and business leaders.
 Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, and ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously.
 Preferred / Bonus Skills 
 Experience working with Zoho Recruit ATS .
 Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling recruitment processes for better operational efficiency.
 Prior hiring exposure in a UX/UI agency , digital agency, product studio, or similar fast-paced creative-tech environment.
 Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption within recruitment , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools.
 Awareness of evolving recruitment technology trends and the ability to suggest process, workflow, or system improvements.
 Educational Qualification 
 Bachelor degree in any discipline is acceptable.
 Relevant prior recruitment experience will be valued more strongly than academic specialization.
 What Success Looks Like in 90 Days 
 Takes confident ownership of active hiring mandates across design and technical roles with minimal handholding.
 Builds strong working relationships with hiring managers and establishes credibility through responsiveness, judgment, and process ownership.
 Maintains clean and reliable ATS data, clear pipeline visibility, and disciplined follow-ups across open roles.
 Improves quality and speed of shortlisting through stronger sourcing, screening, and role understanding.
 Creates a smoother and more professional candidate experience across scheduling, communication, and closure.
 Brings structure to assessments, interview coordination, and feedback collection.
 Begins identifying practical opportunities to improve hiring workflows, reduce delays, and strengthen recruitment operations.
 
 
 

 Benefits Benefits
 At ProCreator, were not just offering a job; were providing a platform for you to thrive, grow, and lead. Here what makes us unique: 
 Unmatched Growth Opportunities : 
 Wealth-Building Benefits : ESOPs, Shared Appreciation Rights (SAR), profit-sharing, and referral bonuses to recognize your contributions. 
 Skill Development : Access professional growth funds, learning courses, and mentorship programs tailored to your ambitions. 
 A Work Environment That Inspires: 
 Comfort Redefined: Ergonomic furniture, standing desks, and training for optimal productivity and well-being. 
 Flexibility : We offer the flexibility of working from the office as well as hybrid work arrangements. 
 Health and Wellness Focus : 
 Comprehensive Health Coverage : Insurance up to INR 5,00,000. 
 Team Bonding Retreats: Strengthen connections and recharge during annual team-building getaways.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Job Purpose 
 The Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth by acquiring new clients and expanding existing accounts for RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing), Permanent Staffing, Contract Staffing and Payroll Management Services . The role requires a strong understanding of the staffing and HR services industry, consultative selling capabilities, excellent client relationship management skills, and the ability to independently manage the complete business development cyclefrom lead generation and prospecting to proposal, negotiation, closure and account handover. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Business Development & Client Acquisition 
 Identify and develop new business opportunities for RPO, permanent staffing and payroll services. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients across industries. Conduct market mapping to identify target companies, decision-makers and potential staffing requirements. Generate leads through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn, networking, references, industry events and existing relationships. Develop relationships with CXOs, CHROs, HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Heads, Procurement Heads and Business Leaders. Understand client requirements and recommend appropriate staffing / HR solutions. Own the complete sales cycle from lead generation to commercial closure. 
 RPO Business Development 
 Identify organizations with significant or recurring recruitment requirements and position RPO as a strategic talent acquisition solution. Develop customized RPO proposals based on client hiring volumes, locations, job categories, turnaround time and recruitment complexity. Present RPO solutions, operating models, SLAs, governance structures and commercials to prospective clients. Work with internal recruitment and operations teams to develop implementation plans for new RPO accounts. Track industry trends and competitor offerings in the RPO market. 
 Permanent Staffing / Recruitment Services 
 Acquire new clients requiring permanent recruitment and executive / professional hiring services. Understand manpower plans, hiring volumes, job specifications and recruitment challenges of clients. Develop recruitment mandates across functions and levels. Negotiate recruitment fees, replacement terms, payment terms and commercial agreements. Drive repeat business and increase wallet share from existing clients. 
 Payroll Services 
 Develop business opportunities for outsourced payroll and payroll management services. Understand client requirements around payroll processing, statutory compliance, employee data management, payroll reporting and HR administration. Position payroll outsourcing solutions based on client size, employee strength, locations and complexity. Coordinate with payroll / operations teams to prepare proposals, solution designs and commercials. Develop long-term relationships with clients to drive renewals and additional business. 
 Client Relationship Management 
 Build strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers. Conduct regular client meetings and business reviews. Understand client satisfaction levels and identify opportunities for service improvement. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across RPO, permanent staffing, payroll and other HR services. Ensure smooth transition of newly acquired accounts to the operations / delivery team. 
 Proposal, Commercials & Negotiation 
 Prepare business proposals, presentations, capability decks, RFP / RFQ responses and commercial proposals. Work with internal teams to develop accurate pricing and solution models. Negotiate commercials, SLAs, payment terms and contractual conditions with clients. Ensure that all commercial proposals meet the company's profitability and business objectives. Maintain accurate records of opportunities, proposals, closures and revenue forecasts. 
 Sales Target & Performance Management 
 Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual revenue and business acquisition targets. Maintain a healthy sales funnel and provide accurate sales forecasts. Track lead-to-conversion ratios, sales cycle, average deal value and revenue realization. Regularly report business development activities, pipeline and closures to management. Take ownership of revenue generation and new client acquisition. 
 Required Skills & Competencies 
 Strong B2B business development and consultative selling skills. Good understanding of RPO, staffing, recruitment and payroll outsourcing models. Proven experience in selling HR / staffing / recruitment services. Strong client acquisition and relationship management capabilities. Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills. Ability to engage with senior HR and business stakeholders. Strong commercial and financial understanding. Ability to prepare business proposals and presentations. Strong networking and lead-generation capabilities. Target-oriented and highly result-driven. Ability to work independently and manage the complete sales cycle. Good knowledge of CRM / sales management tools. 
 Educational Qualification 
 Bachelor's degree in any discipline. MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, HR or Business Management would be preferred. 
 Experience 
 5-10 years of relevant experience in business development / sales within: RPO services Recruitment / permanent staffing Contract staffing Payroll outsourcing HR consulting / HR services Recruitment consulting Workforce management services

Through our business, we work with B2B buyers, distributors, wholesalers, importers and private-label brands and provide solutions including bulk products, private labeling, packaging and brand launch support. description:
Position Title: Vice President of Aftersales
 Department: Aftersales (Service, Parts, and Customer Relations)
 Reports To: Dealer principle/CEO
 Location: Chennai 
 Job Purpose 
 The Vice President of Aftersales provides strategic vision, operational leadership, and financial oversight for the dealerships service, parts, collision repair, and customer care departments. As a key member of the executive leadership team, this role is fully responsible for maximizing aftersales profitability, improving fixed operations absorption rates, and embedding the core Toyota "Customer First" philosophy across all locations to drive lifetime owner retention. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic & Operational Leadership Direct the daily operations of multi-location Service and Parts departments to ensure peak efficiency, modern workflow throughput, and maximum technician efficiency. Implement and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs) aligned with global Toyota Dealer Operation Guidelines to optimize workflow and reduce operational waste. Oversee parts inventory management, utilizing retail inventory systems to balance high fill rates with efficient stock turnover. 2. Financial Performance & Profitability Take full profit and loss (P&L) accountability for all fixed operations, establishing annual revenue, gross profit, and expense budgets. Drive labor sales, parts sales, wholesale growth, and accessory penetration to exceed monthly and yearly financial benchmarks. Analyze daily operational metrics (e.g., effective labor rate, hours per repair order, parts matrix pricing) to implement corrective strategies when needed. 3. Toyota Guest Experience & Retention Champion the Toyota Customer First mindset, continuously tracking and improving the Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) and net promoter metrics. Develop proactive customer retention initiatives, service marketing campaigns, and digital booking strategies to secure long-term brand loyalty. Ensure professional, swift resolution of complex customer escalations, maintaining close communication with regional Toyota distributors. 4. Team Development & Compliance Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing team of Service Managers, Parts Managers, advisors, and technical personnel. Establish training paths to ensure technicians achieve and maintain required Toyota certifications. Enforce strict compliance with local governmental regulations, environmental standards, workplace safety protocols, and factory warranty policies. Required Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Automotive Technology, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is highly desirable. Experience: Minimum of 15 years of comprehensive automotive fixed operations or OEM aftersales experience, with at least 5 to 7 years in a senior executive or multi-site director role. Brand Knowledge: Direct experience managing high-volume Toyota or Lexus aftersales environments, with deep familiarity with Toyota systems, warranty processes, and value-chain operations is strongly preferred. Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in modern Dealership Management Systems (DMS), parts inventory databases, and retail analytics tools. Leadership: Proven track record of managing large teams, driving cross-functional collaboration, and executing successful change management. Role & responsibilities

 Natarajan Empowerment Foundation (NEF) works toward the vision of an empowered India a Viksit Bharat — by enabling women, youth, and senior citizens to realize their full potential. Founded by Dr. Ganesh Natarajan, NEF believes that empowerment is the key to national transformation: giving people the agency to transform themselves, and in doing so, transform India. NEF's work is built on a proprietary five-step framework called "Agency by Design" — Aspiration, Awareness, Action Agenda, Preparedness, and Execution — which systematically builds confidence, skills, and market opportunities for its beneficiaries. Among its core focus areas is women's empowerment , since women make up 48% of India's population but contribute only 18% to its GDP. NEF runs flagship programs such as the IIM Mumbai – NEF Women Leadership Accelerator Program and Success With Scale , an entrepreneurship-focused initiative. Learn more: www.nefconnect.org 
 About the Role NEF is looking for a motivated and results-driven Education Sales Executive to join our team in Pune. This role is central to our mission of empowering women through programs like the IIM Mumbai – NEF Women Leadership Accelerator Program , Success With Scale , and other allied training programs focused on leadership and entrepreneurship development for women. The ideal candidate will be responsible for connecting with prospective learners over phone/calls, understanding their needs, explaining program value, and converting leads into enrolments — all while representing the Foundation's mission with integrity and empathy. Deliver a positive and professional customer experience during every interaction and build report and establish trust with prospective customers through effective communication. Address customer questions and provide accurate information regarding telecom products and services. Ensure all customer interactions reflect the company's commitment to service excellence with Australian telecommunications regulations, company policies, and campaign requirements. Follow approved scripts, call guides, disclosure requirements, and quality standards. Obtain and document customer consent where required. Maintain accurate customer records and update CRM systems promptly. Participate in quality monitoring, coaching sessions, and performance reviews. Maintain high standards of attendance, adherence, and call quality. Collaborate with Team Leaders and Management to achieve campaign objectives.

 Minimum 1-3 years of experience in Lead Generation, Telecom Sales, Customer Acquisition, BPO Sales, or Appointment Setting. Experience working on Australian telecom campaigns will be highly preferred. Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Strong lead qualification and customer engagement abilities. Experience with CRM systems, dialers, and lead management tools. Goal-oriented mindset with a passion for achieving targets. Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. Regular team outings, rewards, and employee engagement activities. Supportive and growth-oriented work environment.

title: Territory Sales Executive
description:
TERRITORY SALES EXECUTIVE - GENERAL TRADE 
 Industry: Imported Glassware / Tableware / Houseware 
 Department: General Trade Sales 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Field Sales 
 Working Days: 6 Days per Week 
 Salary: 26,000 - 45,000 per month + applicable TA/DA/Conveyance at Actuals/ 
 Mobile Allowance. 
 OPEN POSITIONS 
 Delhi / NCR - 2 Positions 
 Territory 1: North Delhi + West Delhi + GT Road Belt up to Ambala 
 Territory 2: South Delhi + East Delhi + Gurgaon + Faridabad 
 Kolkata / West Bengal - 1 Position 
 Territory: Kolkata + Entire West Bengal 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for energetic, street-smart and result-oriented Territory Sales Executives - General Trade to develop the market for a leading Imported Glassware Brand . 
This is a pure General Trade Field-sales role , focused on independent retail outlets such as: 
 Glassware and crockery shops 
 Kitchenware and cookware shops 
 Houseware and plastic household-product stores 
 Gift shops 
 Departmental stores 
 Independent neighborhood / mom-and-pop retailers 
 The sales channel is primarily: 
 Company to Distributor to Retailer to Consumer 
 The role will focus strongly on four areas: 
 DISTRIBUTOR STRENGTHENING 
 OUTLET COVERAGE 
 SECONDARY SALES 
 PRODUCT VISIBILITY 
 This is not a HORECA or Institutional Sales position. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Drive Secondary Sales 
Generate and grow secondary sales from distributors to General Trade retailers. Regularly visit retailers, present products, book orders, introduce new products and generate repeat business. 
The objective is to ensure continuous movement of products from: 
 Distributor to Retailer to Consumer 
 2. Increase Outlet Coverage 
 Continuously identify and develop new retail outlets in the assigned territory. Focus on increasing the number of productive outlets that actively stock, sell and reorder the Imported Glassware Brand. 
 Develop both: 
 New retailers 
 Existing retailers with additional sales potential 
 Approximately 70% focus on new business development and 30% focus on existing business development , depending on territory maturity. 
 3. Strengthen Distributors 
 Work closely with existing distributors to improve: 
 Market coverage 
 Retailer servicing 
 Product availability 
 Secondary sales 
 Stock movement 
 New-product distribution 
 Market penetration 
 Identify areas where distribution is weak or additional distributors may be required. Support the company in identifying suitable new distributor opportunities. 
 4. Improve Product Visibility 
Ensure good visibility and presentation of products at important retail outlets. 
Look for opportunities to improve: 
Shelf placement 
Counter displays 
Product presentation 
New-product visibility 
Range display 
Promotional material 
The objective is to make the products visible and easy for retailers to recommend to customers. 
 5. Increase Product Range Per Outlet 
 Encourage retailers to stock a wider range of products instead of only a few fast-moving items. 
 Focus on: 
 Increasing number of SKUs per outlet 
 Introducing new products 
 Expanding product categories 
 Improving repeat ordering 
 Developing higher-value retailers 
 6. Territory & Beat Management 
 Plan and cover the assigned territory systematically. 
 Develop: 
 Markets - Beats - Retailers - Visit Frequency 
 Maintain disciplined market coverage and regularly identify: 
 New outlets 
 Underdeveloped markets 
 Inactive retailers 
 Distribution gaps 
 Competitor activity 
 New sales opportunities 
 7. Year-on-Year Sales Growth 
 Take ownership of sales growth in the assigned territory. 
 Sales targets will be planned considering: 
 Previous-year sales 
 Existing business 
 Territory potential 
 Outlet opportunities 
 Distributor strength 
 New product opportunities 
 Performance will be strongly evaluated on Year-on-Year sales growth . 
 8. New Product Introduction 
 Actively present and introduce new products to distributors and retailers. 
 The salesperson should be comfortable explaining: 
 Product features 
 Design and usage 
 MRP 
 Retail potential 
 Product dierentiation 
 Consumer appeal 
 9. Market Intelligence 
 Regularly provide feedback on: 
 Competitor brands 
 Competitor pricing 
 New launches 
 Retailer feedback 
 Product trends 
 Retail margins 
 Market opportunities 
 Fast- and slow-moving products 
 Distributor and retailer activity 
 COLLECTION RESPONSIBILITY 
 The Territory Sales Executive will be responsible only for Sales and Market Development . 
 Retailer payment collection will be handled by the respective distributor. 
 IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 
 Experience 
 2 to 5 years of relevant General Trade Field-sales experience preferred. 
 Candidates may come from: 
 Glassware 
 Crockery 
 Tableware 
 Kitchenware 
 Cookware 
 Plasticware / Plastic Household Products 
 Houseware / Homeware 
 Giftware 
 Utensils 
 Small Home Appliances 
 FMCG / Consumer Goods with strong General Trade experience 
 Direct glassware experience is preferred but not mandatory. 
 Strong candidates from Cookware, Kitchenware, Plastic Household Products, Crockery or Houseware are highly relevant. 
 Candidates primarily experienced in HORECA, Hotels, Restaurants or Institutional Sales without meaningful General Trade experience will not be suitable. 
 SKILLS & PERSONAL QUALITIES 
The ideal candidate should be: 
 Strong in General Trade sales 
 Street-smart and energetic 
 Comfortable working extensively in the market 
 Good at retailer relationship building 
 Strong in new outlet opening 
 Experienced in secondary sales 
 Good at distributor coordination 
 Target-oriented 
 Self-driven and disciplined 
 Strong in follow-up 
 Comfortable working independently 
 Commercially aware 
 Willing to travel regularly 
 
 Knowledge of MS Word or Excel is beneficial 
 VEHICLE & TRAVEL 
 Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred / required depending on the territory. 
 The candidate should be comfortable with extensive local travel and outstation travel wherever required. 
 WORKING DAYS 
 This is a 6-day Field-sales position . 
 Weekly off will normally be: Sunday OR the weekly closure day of the principal market being covered. 
 TERRITORY DETAILS 
 NORTH & WEST DELHI / GT ROAD BELT 
 North Delhi, West Delhi and markets along the GT Road belt up to Ambala. Candidates already familiar with retailers and distributors in these markets will be preferred. 
 SOUTH & EAST DELHI / NCR 
 South Delhi, East Delhi, Gurgaon and Faridabad. 
 Existing General Trade market knowledge will be preferred. 
 KOLKATA / WEST BENGAL 
 Based in Kolkata with responsibility for the entire West Bengal market . 
 Regular outstation travel across West Bengal will be required. 
 Knowledge of the West Bengal General Trade market and ability to communicate in Bengali and Hindi will be preferred. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS 
 Performance will primarily be evaluated on: 
 
 Distributor Strengthening 
 Distributor productivity 
 Market coverage 
 Product availability 
 New distributor opportunities 
 Outlet Coverage 
 New outlets opened 
 Productive outlets developed 
 Existing outlet growth 
 New market penetration 
 Secondary Sales 
 Secondary sales growth 
 Year-on-Year sales growth 
 Repeat orders 
 New-product sales 
 Product Visibility 
 Product placement 
 Range visibility 
 New-product displays 
 Retail presence 
 WHO SHOULD APPLY? 
 Apply if you can confidently say: 
 I know General Trade. I can strengthen distributors, increase outlet coverage, drive secondary sales, improve product visibility and grow my territory year after year. 
We are looking for a strong market developer and salesperson , not merely an order taker.

Key Skills: Channel Sales,Dealer Management,Territory Sales,Territory,Key Accounts,Channel,B2B Sales,Network Expansion

Wireless access points, routers, switches, VoIP/IP phones, fiber networking products, ISP and telecom solutions. Youll personally plan, write, run, and measure campaigns, own the marketing side of our CRM (HubSpot), lead nurture campaigns, build our LinkedIn and thought-leadership presence, and work side-by-side with BD/Sales to turn marketing activity into a measurable pipeline. Youll also take on product marketing support for FinOpz, our new AI-enabled finance operations platform, as one part of a broader, all-around marketing role rather than a dedicated product marketing seat. Youll meet weekly with the fractional CMO to set priorities and review work, and use freelancers or agencies as extra hands, not as a substitute for your own execution.

Manage the marketing side of our CRM (HubSpot): email nurture campaigns, list segmentation, and reporting, in coordination with BD/Sales on lead handoff and pipeline feedback. Partner with BD/Sales on account-based approaches for target accounts and joint go-to-market plans. Track leads through the funnel and report results and ROI to leadership. Brand content Build and personally drive our LinkedIn presence and thought-leadership content: founder posts, articles, case studies, and market commentary that build credibility across finance and HR/people-ops circles. Translate FIABs finance, HR, and expanding service offerings into clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for different buyer personas. Own website updates, one-pagers, decks, and sales-enablement content, working with leadership and BD. Track competitor positioning and market developments in fintech/finops, and B2B services to keep messaging sharp and current. title: Junior Content Writer
description:
Introduction 
 We are looking for a Content Writer with exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong storytelling ability, and a deep sense of empathy.
You will work closely with the Sales/Operations Team to understand patient cases, medical conditions, treatment requirements, financial situations, and other relevant information, and convert these details into clear, emotionally engaging crowdfunding campaigns.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling sensitive medical stories and should be able to balance emotional storytelling with factual accuracy and responsible communication . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Write compelling, emotion-driven medical crowdfunding campaign stories based on information and case details provided by the Sales/Operations Team. Create high-quality long-form campaign content, typically 300500 words , that clearly communicates the patient's medical condition, treatment requirements, financial need, and urgency. Understand medical information and simplify complex medical conditions, procedures, and treatment details into content that is easy for donors to understand. Develop strong storytelling narratives that create empathy and encourage donors to support the campaign. Ensure all campaign content is factually accurate, grammatically correct, structured well, and aligned with the information provided by the Operations/Sales Team . Work closely with the Sales/Operations Team to clarify missing information and ensure campaign stories accurately represent the patient's situation. Manage multiple campaign stories simultaneously while meeting defined turnaround times and daily content targets. Adapt writing styles based on different patient cases, medical conditions, audiences, and fundraising requirements. 
 What You Bring to the Table 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills , with strong command of English. Strong storytelling ability and the ability to create emotionally engaging content. Ability to understand and simplify complex information, particularly medical and financial details. Strong attention to detail and commitment to factual accuracy. Ability to write clearly, concisely, and empathetically. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and manage multiple assignments simultaneously. Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification. English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Media, or related backgrounds preferred. A highly motivated self-starter with a willingness to learn and take ownership. Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Operations, and other internal teams. Prior experience in content writing, storytelling, healthcare content, crowdfunding, journalism, or digital media will be an added advantage.
