description:
Our Specialty Risk Team offers candidates the opportunity to support the evolution of value-based care across the Radiology, Cardiology and Oncology spaces. We are advocates for creating patient value and demonstrate this by ensuring that our financial arrangements are actuarially sound and sustainable. We value humility, adaptability, intellectual curiosity, and accountability as we solve complex business problems. 
 
 What You ll Be Doing: 
 Support calculation of IBNR balances for monthly close Maintain and enhance reporting dashboards and underlying data to support reporting, including membership, claims, forecast assumptions, and IBNR balances Help internal business customers achieve goals by performing statistical analysis, developing analytic models, creating data reports/dashboards using a variety of performance metrics Support ad hoc analyses to provide data-driven insights to answer specific business questions that arise from company leadership and partners Streamline processes to improve efficiency of key deliverables Be reliable; set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and escalate risks as needed Consistently deliver high-quality, error-free deliverables 
 
 The Ideal Candidate: 
 Desires to work on challenging projects for a high-growth organization Reliable, takes initiative, operates in ambiguity, and manages competing deadlines Works collaboratively and pitches in for the greater good of the team Manages multiple deadlines while maintaining high quality standards 
 
 The Experience You ll Need (Required): 
 Bachelor s Degree in Actuarial Science, Finance, Math, Economics or related degree 6+ years of experience in Data Analysis with strong analytical skills using Excel (including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis tools) 
 
 Finishing Touches (Preferred): 
 Familiarity or experience with medical/pharmacy claims Familiarity with PowerQuery/BI/VBA Ability to read and write SQL code 
 
 Mandatory Requirements: 
 Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business. 
 
 Who You ll Be Working With: 
 The Manager, Financial Analytics utilizes analytic tools to solve complex business challenges as well as support decision making that can have a considerable impact on the organization and patient health. This role primarily supports calculation of deliverables for the monthly financial close. The Manager, Financial Analytics will inform decision making across the company by conducting analyses and developing actionable insights. The Manager, Financial Analytics will have the opportunity to shape team culture and operating norms at a high-growth organization.

title: Accounts Executive
description:
Location: Coimbatore (Onsite) Experience: 2 - 4 years (Hands-on) 
 
 Job Summary 
 Were looking for a hands-on Accounts Executive who can independently manage day-to-day bookkeeping, compliance, and reporting for a growing consulting firm serving global clients. Youll work closely with leadership to keep the books accurate, compliance timelines met, and financial reporting audit-ready. Youll take ownership of the full accounting cycle-from transaction entry to PL and balance sheet reporting-while coordinating statutory filings and payroll-related compliance across multiple organizations/entities under our umbrella. If youre detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable owning numbers end-to-end, this role is for you. Were a firm thats constantly picking up new tools, so youll fit right in if you enjoy figuring out a better, faster way to do something rather than sticking to the same process out of habit. Given that youll be handling sensitive financials across multiple entities, this is a role built on trust - someone we can hand the numbers to and not have to double-check. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Maintain books of accounts for multiple entities/organizations in parallel, keeping each set of records distinct and audit-ready. Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping and ledgers in Zoho Books . Perform regular expense reconciliations (bank, vendor, and credit card). Prepare and maintain the Chart of Accounts . Prepare PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets for management review. Track and report on cash flow , flagging shortfalls or timing gaps proactively. Process payroll accurately and on time, including statutory deductions. Maintain Asset Management records (fixed assets, depreciation schedules). Handle GST and TDS computation, payment, and return filing (including quarterly TDS filings). Ensure compliance with Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment registrations and renewals. Support Income Tax related filings and coordination with auditors/consultants. Manage client and vendor invoicing , including follow-up on outstanding receivables. Handle multi-currency transactions (USD billing) and reconcile FX conversions. Support audit requirements by preparing schedules and responding to auditor queries. Keep records in Zoho Books clean and consistent, so reports and dashboards stay reliable. Use AI tools to improve accuracy and speed of recurring accounting tasks. Maintain clear, professional written communication with internal teams, vendors, and clients over email. 
 
 Early Impact 
 Weeks 1-2: Understand our accounting systems, chart of accounts, compliance calendar, and ongoing processes. By ~60 days: Independently manage bookkeeping, reconciliations, and routine compliance filings with minimal supervision. By ~90 days: Own the monthly close process end-to-end, including PL/Balance Sheet preparation, and proactively flag compliance deadlines, cash flow gaps, and budget variances before theyre asked about. 
 
 Must-haves 
 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Accounting and Bookkeeping. Proven experience managing books for multiple organizations/entities simultaneously , keeping each set of accounts separate and accurate. Strong working knowledge of Zoho Books (or equivalent accounting software). Proficiency in Excel (formulas, reconciliations, reporting). Practical experience with GST and TDS compliance, including quarterly TDS filings. Experience preparing PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets . Good understanding of cash flow - tracking inflows/outflows and anticipating shortfalls. Experience maintaining a Chart of Accounts . Experience with payroll processing and statutory deductions. Experience with Asset Management (fixed asset tracking, depreciation). Working knowledge of Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment compliance. Comfort using AI tools to support accounting workflows. Strong written communication skills, especially over email. Someone who takes ownership of the numbers, follows through without needing reminders, and is comfortable being the person others can rely on when it matters. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a consulting or services firm billing international clients. Exposure to Income Tax filings and audit coordination. Experience working directly with external auditors, CAs, or compliance consultants. Experience handling client/vendor invoicing and receivables follow-up. Exposure to multi-currency accounting , particularly USD billing and FX reconciliation. 
 
 Skills 
 Zoho Books Excel AI Tools GST TDS Income Tax Bookkeeping Multi-Entity Accounting Expense Reconciliations PL Balance Sheets Cash Flow Projections Budgets Chart of Accounts Payroll Processing Asset Management Professional Tax PF Gratuity Shop Establishment Compliance Client Vendor Invoicing Multi-Currency Accounting Audit Support Written Communication 
 
 Educational Qualifications 
 We care more about the quality of your work and thinking than specific degrees. A strong track record in similar roles matters most.

 Skilled in cross-functional coordination (Sales, Support, and Implementation) to ensure smooth onboarding

 escalations, and ensuring seamless implementation of financial or ERP solutions.

Join us as an Analyst \- Financial Controller at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.


To be successful as an Analyst \- Financial Controller, you should have experience with:


* Qualified Accountant – CA/CMA/ACCA.
* Strong academic background – 1st class honour's minimum bachelor degree from a reputable institution.
* Prior experience, if any in a month\-end or quarter\-end focused reporting role or control environment based or finance automation skillset based.
* Strong excel skills.

  

Some other highly valued skills include:


* Good stakeholder engagement skills and understanding \& executing their requirements.
* Understanding of the key accounting principles under IFRS.
* Strong interpersonal skills and excellent communicator.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role will be based out of Chennai.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage the financial operations of the organisation, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of financial reporting.


**Accountabilities**


* Management of the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial statements, and other accounting records in accordance with the relevant accounting standards, rules and regulations.
* Support in identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Development and maintenance of a robust system of internal controls to safeguard assets, ensure that there is no fraudulent misreporting, and ensure the accuracy of financial data, including regular assessment of the effectiveness of internal controls addressing any weaknesses or gaps. .
* Development and implementation of up\-to\-date financial policies and procedures to ensure consistent and effective financial practices across the organisation.
* Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of financial systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate financial systems with other enterprise systems.
* Preparation and submission of statutory and regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports.
* Coordination with external auditors and regulatory authorities in support of audits and examinations.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Analyst, Open-end Fund Accounting (CLO)
description:
Responsibilities The successful candidate will be an integral member of the fund accounting team providing support to Oaktree's Senior Loan strategy. The Fund Accounting Manager will supervise and execute tasks related to maintaining the books and records, reporting, and auditing for a diverse portfolio of investment funds, including open-end funds, closed-end funds, collateralized loan obligation portfolios (CLOs), and risk retention vehicles. This role will ensure compliance with international accounting standards and regulatory requirements, while facilitating communication with internal teams and external service providers, such as third-party administrators, custodians, directors, legal and tax. Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following activities: Portfolio Oversight and Reconciliation Supervise the monthly and quarterly closing process, including pricing, management fee calculations, expense accruals, and portfolio activity reconciliation with custodial and counterparty records. Conduct daily cash and position reconciliations, resolve discrepancies with custodians, administrators, and counterparties, and address complex corporate actions. Ensure books and records accurately reflect purchase and sale transactions, trade par, and cash reconciliations for CLOs. Compliance and Reporting Prepare and review financial statements in compliance with U.S. and U.K. GAAP, IFRS, and investment company accounting rules (when applicable). Coordinate regulatory filings, including AIFMD Annex IV, Form PF, ADV reporting, CRS, and corporate tax reporting. Evaluate fund and client-specific performance metrics (e.g., XIRR and TWR). Audit and Efficiency Execution Coordinate annual financial statement audits and fieldwork with external auditors. Support fund-related automation and efficiency initiatives, ensuring adherence to Sarbanes-Oxley compliance standards. Client Fund Activity Management Calculate income and expense allocations, update distribution waterfalls, and track cash forecasting for loan-to-value ratio and borrowing limits. Prepare borrowing notices and funding memos for corporate-related activity. Manage fund openings, closings, client drawdowns, and distributions, ensuring smooth communication between stakeholders. Cash and Expense Analysis Support expense analysis, corporate expense reimbursement tracking, waterfall invoice preparation, and wire payment execution. Oversee corporate actions related to delayed compensation, cost of carry, amendment fees, and PIK interest amongst others. Support and Collaboration Monitor work performed by third-party administrators and custodians, ensuring accuracy and quality control. Respond to ad-hoc queries from client services and internal teams and implement setups for new funds and CLOs across accounting, marketing, performance, and trading systems. Experience Required Minimum 2-6 years relevant accounting or audit experience within Big Four public accounting or a mix of public accounting and investment management industry experience; Strong knowledge of reconciliation and account analysis; Excellent understanding of accounting and the ability to apply relevant investment company accounting rules; Solid analytical skills and ability to understand and resolve complex problems; Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word; Experience with Geneva and/or Geneva World Investor accounting systems is a plus; Experience with PowerBI, Alteryx, or other data analytical tools is a plus; Working knowledge of CLOs and Risk Retention Vehicles a plus, including CLO lifecycle, including all aspects of the Warehouse Phase, Ramping of Portfolio, Pricing, Close, Drawdowns, Repayments, Day One S110 Test, 1st Loss Equity Tranche, Waterfall Schedule, Priority of Payments, Resets and Refinancing, Management and Incentive Fees, Par and Cash, Aggregate Principal/Collateral Balance Calculations Education Bachelor's degree is required, preferred in Accounting or Finance CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent qualification is a plus

Group Account Manager 
 Job Summary We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Group Account Manager to manage key client accounts and lead the execution of BTL marketing campaigns, events, activations, exhibitions, and brand initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing client relationships, coordinating with internal and external teams, driving account growth, and ensuring seamless execution of projects while meeting client expectations and business objectives. The candidate should have strong experience in client servicing, brand activations, events, exhibitions, and experiential marketing , along with the ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Account & Client Management Manage a portfolio of key client accounts and act as the primary point of contact. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders. Understand client briefs, business objectives, brand requirements, and project expectations. Ensure timely communication, follow-ups, approvals, and delivery across all accounts. Proactively identify client requirements and provide relevant solutions. Handle client escalations and ensure timely resolution of issues. 
 2. Campaign & Event Management Lead the planning and execution of BTL campaigns, events, activations, exhibitions, and brand experiences. Develop campaign approaches and execution plans in line with client objectives. Coordinate with creative, production, operations, and other internal teams for smooth project execution. Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. Be actively involved in pre-event planning, on-ground execution, and post-event closure. Conduct post-project reviews and identify areas for improvement. 
 3. Business Development & Account Growth Identify opportunities for growth within existing accounts. Explore upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the agency's services. Support new business pitches, proposals, presentations, and client meetings. Develop a strong understanding of client businesses to identify potential opportunities. Contribute towards revenue growth and expansion of assigned accounts. 
 4. Team & Internal Coordination Lead and coordinate account servicing teams working across assigned accounts. Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of deliverables. Work closely with creative, production, operations, procurement, and finance teams. Ensure clear communication of client briefs and expectations to internal teams. Review team deliverables and provide necessary guidance and feedback. Support junior team members in managing client requirements and projects. 
 5. Creative & Strategic Collaboration Work closely with creative and strategy teams to develop relevant campaign concepts and solutions. Participate in brainstorming sessions, client presentations, and pitch discussions. Ensure creative solutions are aligned with brand guidelines and campaign objectives. Provide strategic inputs based on client requirements, market understanding, and campaign objectives. 
 6. Project & Operations Management Manage multiple projects simultaneously from briefing to execution and closure. Prepare and track project timelines, deliverables, approvals, and dependencies. Monitor project progress and proactively identify potential delays or challenges. Coordinate with vendors and external partners wherever required. Ensure smooth execution while maintaining quality and client expectations. 
 7. Budget & Commercial Management Support preparation and management of project budgets and estimates. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to ensure cost-effective execution. Monitor project costs and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Support commercial negotiations with vendors and service partners. Ensure projects are executed efficiently without compromising quality. 
 8. Reporting & Documentation Prepare regular account updates, project status reports, presentations, and other client communication. Maintain proper documentation of briefs, approvals, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables. Track account activities and provide regular updates to senior management. Maintain accurate records of ongoing and completed projects. 
 9. Client Retention & Relationship Growth Understand client expectations and proactively address concerns. Maintain regular engagement with key client stakeholders. Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships and increase account engagement. Ensure a high level of client satisfaction across projects. Build trust with clients through consistent communication, ownership, and quality delivery. 
 10. Overall Ownership Take complete ownership of assigned accounts and projects. Ensure timely, high-quality, and commercially effective delivery. Demonstrate strong accountability and proactive problem-solving. Contribute to the overall growth, profitability, and reputation of the agency. Take greater responsibility for client relationships, team performance, and project outcomes.

description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. EY- Assurance - Senior Manager As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements. The opportunity We re looking for individual who should have Assurance related experience in the Asset Management industry. In addition to supporting the management of service delivery for several key clients, the incumbent should have the potential to coach managers in the Asset Management segment, provide technical support, deliver industry training and assist in growing the Asset Management practice. Your key responsibilities Manage and develop people Be an effective manager by empowering, monitoring, coaching and motivating the team members. Identify development opportunities and training needs for high performing managers. Identify technical and non-technical training needs with respect to client servicing, decision making, people issues, etc Conduct Assurance team s performance reviews, serve as a positive leader and mentor, and play a significant role in the team s performance Manage business and clients Develop and maintain strong relationship network with key contacts in the Asset Management sector of engagement teams Actively support the Sector agenda both in terms of growth and quality initiatives (e.g. improvement of service delivery, standardization of projects, new solutions, etc.) Enhance connectivity between GDS team and engagement teams and leverage good connections to identify more opportunities for work Actively support the communication agenda for the Asset Management sector Support the Segment Leader in developing annual growth, resource and activity plans Monitor KPIs (growth, quality feedback, utilization, risk management compliance, attrition, etc.) for the teams under supervision and take appropriate action wherever required Manage quality of service delivery Identify sector-specific training needs, review and update current curriculum Assist in organizing and providing technical training (both Sector and Assurance methodology) Assist in addressing service delivery quality issues if and when they occur Support exceptional service delivery action programs Establish a practice of Best Practice sharing within the Asset Management Segment teams Skills and attributes for success Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards Asset Management, assurance experience with specific focus on Hedge Funds and Private Equity Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills Strong project and people management skills with experience in serving global clients Strong verbal and written communication skills in English To qualify for the role, you must have Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / CPA/ACCA) Approximately over 10 years of Assurance relevant experience with well-known CA firms. International experience of over 2 years will be an added advantage Ideally, you ll also have Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office. Interest in business and commerciality. What we look for A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide. Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries What we Offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. Continuous learning : You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. description:

 About Asset Infinity Asset Infinity, a product of PcsInfinity Pvt. Ltd. , is a leading cloud-based B2B SaaS platform that helps organizations efficiently manage, track, and optimize their assets throughout the asset lifecycle. We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Executive to join our Finance & Accounts team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, accounts receivable and payable processes, statutory compliances, reconciliations, and month-end closing activities while ensuring financial accuracy and compliance. 
 Key Responsibilities Financial Accounting & Bookkeeping Manage day-to-day accounting transactions, journal entries, invoicing, expense bookings, and ledger maintenance. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions in Zoho Books. Maintain organized accounting records and supporting documentation. Accounts Receivable (AR) & Collections Generate and process customer invoices accurately and on time. Record customer payments and maintain updated customer ledgers. Monitor outstanding receivables and prepare AR ageing reports. Follow up on overdue payments and coordinate with Sales and Customer Success teams for collections. Resolve customer account discrepancies, including invoices, credit notes, and payment adjustments. Accounts Payable (AP) & Vendor Management Verify, process, and record vendor invoices as per company policies. Manage timely vendor payments and maintain vendor reconciliations. Monitor AP ageing and ensure timely settlement of dues. Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve invoice and payment-related issues. Maintain complete records of vendor transactions and supporting documents. Reconciliations & Financial Controls Perform regular bank, customer, and vendor reconciliations. Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies. Ensure compliance with internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Statutory Compliance Manage GST, TDS, PF, and other applicable statutory compliances. Ensure timely filing of returns, tax payments, reconciliations, and record maintenance. Coordinate with auditors, consultants, and regulatory agencies when required. Expense & Advance Management Process employee reimbursements, advances, and operational expenses. Ensure proper documentation and adherence to approval workflows. Audit & Closing Activities Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and reconciliations. Assist in month-end and year-end financial closing activities. Prepare schedules and reports required by management and auditors. 
 Required Qualifications Education Bachelors or master s degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. Experience 2-4 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts. Prior experience in a SaaS, IT, or technology-driven organization will be preferred. Hands-on experience with Zoho Books , QuickBooks, or similar accounting software. Technical Skills Strong understanding of Accounting Principles, AP, AR, and Financial Reconciliations. Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, Taxation, PF, and Statutory Compliance . Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting. 
 Key Competencies Ability to independently manage accounting operations with minimal supervision. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. High attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Strong organizational and time-management skills. High level of integrity, ownership, and accountability. 
 Why Join Us Be part of a fast-growing B2B SaaS company. Opportunity to gain exposure to end-to-end finance operations. Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment. Learn and work with modern cloud-based financial systems and processes.

title: Junior Manager - Global Reward and Benefits Operations
description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title: Benefits Case Specialist - Global Benefits Operations Level: L5C Reports To: Manager - Global Benefits Operations (Bangalore) 
 
 About the Function 
 Human Resources is about shaping the experience of working at Diageo and helping our people learn and grow every day. From attracting talent to developing careers, this team plays a central role in building a culture where people feel supported, challenged and able to grow. They work closely with teams across the business, bringing insight, care and commercial understanding to everything they do. You'll help create an environment where different perspectives are valued and where people can learn new skills and thrive, unlocking potential across a truly global organisation. 
 
 Context/Scope 
 As part of the Group Reward and Benefits Operations team, you will play a crucial role in developing a high-performing and highly engaged Global Benefits Operations team. Reporting directly to the Assistant Manager - Global Reward and Benefits Operations, your responsibilities will include leading critical activities such as Benefits Purchase Order creation, invoice management and reconciliation, vendor management, report generation and distribution, and query management. Your outstanding customer management, financial control, governance application, and execution skills will be key to the success of these projects. Applying extensive experience in HR and payroll operations, or HR and payroll service delivery, process engineering, and process simplification, you will implement best practices processes and data management strategies to enhance operational efficiency and accuracy across multiple regions and time zones. Proficiency in employee communications for benefits programs, ensuring clear and effective dissemination of information. Skilled in benefits process design to optimize efficiency and effectiveness of program administration. Strong analytical skills to assess and improve benefits program performance and outcomes. Expertise in vendor management, encompassing performance monitoring, invoice and payment management, issue resolution, relationship management, and service review and improvement. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 a) Financial Ensure timely and accurate completion of all in-scope reporting activities. Regularly review and update Process Steps, Maps, Work Instructions, Benefits Matrices, Benefit Guides, Factsheets, and FAQs. Make them available to relevant teams, conduct necessary training, and ensure consistency and accuracy in all communications materials. Perform all CARM controls and data reconciliations, resolving any issues. Review and reconcile vendor invoices within agreed timelines to ensure payments are made as per the agreed SLAs. 
 
 Leadership Responsibilities 
 Leverage insights to find opportunities for process and workflow improvements. Apply strong social skills to motivate multiple teams, business processes, and data and technical governance. Drive significant simplification and efficiency in processes and systems to support the global productivity agenda. Ensure all controls and processes meet internal and external regulatory requirements. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across Diageo and with vendor teams. 
 
 About this role 
 Purpose of Role The Global Reward Operations (GRO) team supports various benefit processes (e.g., product allowance, car allowance, health insurance) for European markets. The Junior Manager will define, document, and improve both online and offline benefit processes and ensure a successful annual benefit enrollment for the entire European population. title: Specialist - Operations
description:
Group Company: Mahindra Logistics Limited Designation: Specialist - Operations Office Location: Pune chakan Designation: Deputy Manager Warehouse & Transportation Management 
 
 Primary Responsibilities 
 Warehouse & Transportation Management Manage end-to-end warehouse operations including inbound, receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch and inventory control. Manage transportation planning, vehicle deployment, route planning, dispatch scheduling and delivery performance. Ensure adherence to customer SOPs, SLAs, KPIs and operational requirements. Monitor warehouse productivity, manpower utilization, space utilization and equipment utilization. Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counts, stock audits and reconciliation. Monitor OTIF performance, vehicle turnaround time and delivery adherence. Manage transporters, 3PL partners and other logistics service providers. Ensure timely resolution of operational issues and customer escalations. Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly operational MIS. Drive cost optimization, productivity improvement, Lean/Kaizen initiatives and process standardization. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, security and statutory requirements. Lead and develop warehouse and transportation operations teams. 
 
 Additional Responsibilities 
 The Deputy Manager will be expected to consistently deliver safe operations, high inventory accuracy, excellent customer service, on-time transportation performance, optimized logistics costs and continuous operational improvement . Additional responsibilities include: Customer relationship and stakeholder management. Operational planning and resource allocation. Vendor and transporter performance management. Root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions. Support customer audits and internal/external audits. Drive 5S, Lean, Kaizen and continuous-improvement initiatives. Identify and implement process automation and digital solutions where applicable. Support budgeting and cost-control activities. Ensure business continuity during operational disruptions. 
 
 Reporting Team 
 Reporting Designation: Senior Manager / Operations Manager Supply Chain & Logistics Reporting Department: Supply Chain / Logistics Operations 
 
 Educational qualifications preferred 
 Category: Graduate / Postgraduate Field specialization: Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration or related field Degree: Bachelor's Degree B.E./B.Tech/BBA/B.Com or equivalent; MBA/PG Diploma in Supply Chain or Logistics preferred Academic score: Minimum 60% preferred Institution tier: Recognized / accredited university or institution 
 
 Required Certification/s

 Required Training/s

 Required work experience

 Preferred experience

Experience handling multiple transporters and logistics vendors. Experience with WMS, TMS and SAP/ERP systems. Experience in customer-facing operations and SLA/KPI management. 
 
 Key Performance Indicators 
 The role will primarily be measured against: OTIF / On-Time Delivery: 98% or customer-defined target Inventory Accuracy: 99.5% Order Picking / Dispatch Accuracy: 99.5% Vehicle Placement Adherence: 98% Transportation Cost per Unit / Shipment: Within approved budget Warehouse Productivity: Achievement of agreed productivity targets Vehicle Turnaround Time: Within defined SLA Warehouse Space Utilization: Optimized utilization Damage / Loss / Shortage: Within approved tolerance Customer Complaints: Minimum / continuous reduction Safety: Zero major accidents / incidents Audit Compliance: 100% closure of critical observations Employee Productivity: Achievement of manpower productivity targets Continuous Improvement: Minimum agreed number of Kaizen / improvement projects per year

 Physical

Ability to stand/walk for extended periods when required. Ability to work across shifts where operational requirements demand it. Ability to follow required PPE and site-safety procedures.

title: Manager, Supply Chain Planning & Operations
description:
Job Summary 
 The Supply Chain Network Modeling Manager is responsible for leading the development and application of advanced supply chain network models that support operational decision-making across the enterprise. This role combines hands-on modeling expertise with people leadership responsibilities, managing a team of supply chain modelers and analysts while ensuring delivery of high-quality network design, transportation optimization, capacity planning, inventory optimization, and business continuity initiatives. The Manager translates business challenges into analytical solutions that optimize cost, service, capacity, inventory, risk, and growth objectives. The role is accountable for developing team capabilities, establishing modeling standards and best practices, and ensuring successful execution of a portfolio of modeling projects aligned with organizational priorities. 
 
 Primary Duties and Responsibilities 
 
 People Leadership Talent Development 
 Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Supply Chain Modelers and Analysts. Conduct performance management, career development planning, and succession planning activities. Support hiring, onboarding, training, and capability development of modeling resources. Establish technical competency standards and promote continuous learning across the team. Foster collaboration, innovation, and a high-performance culture. 
 
 Project Portfolio Leadership 
 Manage a portfolio of network modeling, transportation optimization, simulation, and supply chain strategy projects. Prioritize initiatives based on business value, resource availability, and organizational objectives. Provide project oversight, quality assurance, and governance throughout project lifecycles. Ensure project deliverables are completed on schedule and align with stakeholder expectations. Present recommendations and business cases to senior leadership and executive stakeholders. 
 
 Supply Chain Modeling Optimization 
 Lead the design, development, maintenance, and enhancement of end-to-end supply chain network models. Evaluate scenarios including network expansion, consolidation, facility location, inventory positioning, manufacturing footprint changes, transportation strategies, and capacity investments. Analyze tradeoffs between cost, service levels, inventory, risk, resilience, sustainability, and growth. Develop transportation optimization and cost-to-serve models. Support long-range planning, annual operating planning, and capital investment decisions through scenario analysis. Drive adoption of advanced analytics, optimization, simulation, AI, and emerging technologies. 
 
 Stakeholder Management Consulting 
 Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for analytics-driven decision making. Translate complex business problems into quantitative analyses and actionable recommendations. Facilitate workshops to define objectives, assumptions, constraints, and decision criteria. Communicate findings through executive presentations, dashboards, visualizations, and storytelling. Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 
 
 Process Capability Development 
 Establish and maintain modeling methodologies, governance processes, and best practices. Improve data quality, model documentation standards, and model validation procedures. Develop reusable templates, tools, and frameworks to improve efficiency and consistency. Support the evolution of Network Modeling as a Service (NMaaS) and consulting capabilities. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. 
 
 Work Experience 
 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics Optimization. 2+ years of team management/leadership experience. Expertise translating business rules into modeling requirements and scenarios Expertise in network modeling, optimization, transportation, and operations research. Experience with supply chain network modeling tools, data analytics and visualization. Hands-on with network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, PowerBI, Alteryx, Databricks). Strong knowledge of supply chain design, inventory, warehousing, and capacity planning. Exposure to Operations and different supply chain strategies (store, crossdock, import, buy/lease, etc) Experience coaching and training modelers 
 
 Education Qualification 
 Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or any other related discipline or equivalent related experience. 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, or similar) Supply chain simulation and modeling tools Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and analytics platforms Statistical analysis, optimization, and scenario planning Supply chain design, inventory, transportation, warehousing, and capacity planning 
 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Strategic thinking Influencing without authority Executive communication Coaching and talent development Project and portfolio management Change leadership Analytical problem-solving 
 
 Success Measures (KPIs) 
 On-time delivery of modeling projects Stakeholder satisfaction Team engagement and capability growth Business value from recommendations Cost savings, service improvements, and capacity optimization Adoption of modeling tools and best practices Reduced analysis cycle time through automation and standardization

title: Purchase Manager - Restaurants
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION PURCHASE MANAGER Company: Pebble Street Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
 Brands: FOO Asian Tapas & KOKO Gastropub
 Location: Mumbai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Pune / Ahmedabad
 Department: Purchase & Stores / Procurement
 Designation: Purchase Manager
 Reporting To: Deputy General Manager – Procurement / Head – Procurement
 Experience: 7–10 Years
 Industry: Hospitality / Restaurants / Food & Beverage
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. JOB PURPOSE To manage and execute end-to-end procurement activities across FOO and KOKO outlets, ensuring the right product, at the right quality, right price and right time . The Purchase Manager will be responsible for vendor management, price negotiation, market benchmarking, tender and quotation management, purchase planning, procurement coordination, quality coordination, inventory availability and procurement documentation. The role will also ensure adherence to approved procurement processes, commercial controls, defined TATs and company policies while supporting uninterrupted restaurant operations across locations. 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Procurement & Cost Management Manage end-to-end procurement of food products, fresh produce, beverages, consumables, packaging, housekeeping materials and other operational requirements. Ensure purchases are made from approved vendors and within approved budgets and commercial terms. Achieve targeted procurement savings through negotiation, competitive sourcing, alternate vendors and market benchmarking. Monitor market price fluctuations, particularly for fresh produce, exotic vegetables, fruits and other high-value/perishable products. Identify opportunities for centralized procurement, volume buying and category-wise cost optimization. Maintain updated purchase rates, product specifications and market benchmark data. B. Vendor Management & Development Develop and maintain a reliable and competitive vendor base across operating locations. Ensure availability of dual/multiple vendors for critical categories to minimize supply disruption. Identify and develop new vendors and alternate sources wherever required. Negotiate pricing, credit terms, delivery schedules, minimum order quantities and service levels. Monitor vendor performance based on price, quality, delivery, responsiveness and service. Conduct periodic vendor reviews and initiate corrective action for recurring issues. C. Tender & Quotation Management Coordinate the complete tendering and quotation process for identified categories. Ensure 100% of planned tenders are released within defined timelines. Obtain and evaluate competitive quotations from approved/new vendors. Prepare commercial comparison statements and recommendations for management approval. Maintain proper tender, quotation and negotiation documentation. Ensure transparency and compliance with the company's procurement procedures. D. Rate Negotiation & Market Benchmarking Conduct regular/monthly price comparisons between approved purchase rates and prevailing market rates. Negotiate improved rates with existing and new vendors. Track and report savings achieved through negotiations and alternate sourcing. Specifically monitor procurement savings and rate negotiations for Bangalore and Pune. Identify price variances and take corrective action wherever required. Support volume-based and centralized negotiations for key categories. E. Purchase Planning & Operational Efficiency Ensure timely procurement against approved requisitions and outlet requirements. Monitor the complete procurement cycle: Requisition Quotation Negotiation Approval Purchase Order Delivery GRN Bill Submission Ensure 100% weekly bill submission along with GRN to Finance within the defined 7-day TAT. Monitor order-to-delivery TAT and proactively resolve delays. Track pending orders and communicate critical supply issues to relevant stakeholders. Conduct weekly purchase-team meetings to review pending orders, vendor issues, TAT gaps and operational requirements. Coordinate closely with Operations, Chefs, Finance, Stores and other stakeholders to ensure uninterrupted supply. Manage urgent/emergency procurement requirements while ensuring adherence to company controls. F. Product Quality & Vendor Performance Coordinate with Executive Chefs, Chefs and outlet teams for first-level quality checks of procured products. Ensure products received conform to approved specifications, quality standards, pack sizes and agreed rates. Monitor product rejections, substitutions and quality complaints. Maintain a structured vendor/product quality feedback mechanism. Review recurring quality issues and implement corrective action with vendors. Work closely with the culinary team to resolve quality-related procurement issues. G. Inventory Availability & Stock-Out Management Monitor procurement requirements to minimize stock-outs of critical products. Track critical inventory items and ensure timely replenishment. Coordinate with Stores and Operations to improve purchase planning and inventory availability. Circulate fortnightly inventory/stock-out reports to relevant stakeholders. Analyze recurring stock-out incidents and implement corrective measures. Escalate critical supply risks that may impact restaurant operations. H. Food Waste & Spoilage Control Monitor procurement quantities of perishable products to minimize over-purchasing. Work with Chefs, Stores and Operations to identify causes of spoilage and wastage. Support initiatives to achieve a minimum 0.5% reduction in food waste arising from over-purchasing and spoilage . Review wastage trends and recommend corrective procurement practices. Improve ordering frequency and quantities based on consumption patterns wherever possible. I. Team Management Supervise and coordinate the purchase team to ensure timely completion of procurement activities. Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual/team productivity. Review pending purchase activities, vendor follow-ups and TAT compliance. Coach and train team members on procurement processes, negotiation, documentation and system usage. Monitor adherence to procurement SOPs, approval processes and company policies. Support performance evaluation and development of purchase-team members. J. MIS, Reporting & Documentation Prepare and maintain accurate and timely procurement reports, including: Purchase cost analysis Vendor-wise purchase analysis Rate comparison reports Procurement savings reports Tender status Vendor performance reports Order-to-delivery TAT Stock-out reports Product quality feedback Purchase pending reports GRN and bill submission status Food waste/spoilage-related procurement analysis Ensure procurement data is accurately updated and readily available for management review. Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Commerce, Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related field. Additional qualification/certification in Procurement or Supply Chain Management will be an advantage. 3. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 7–10 years of relevant experience in Purchase/Procurement. Preferably from the hospitality, restaurant, QSR, hotel or F&B industry. Experience in multi-location procurement is preferred. Strong experience in fresh produce, food products, consumables, packaging and operational procurement. Experience in vendor negotiations, tender management and market benchmarking is essential. 4. TECHNICAL & FUNCTIONAL SKILLS Procurement and cost-control expertise Strong negotiation and vendor-management skills Market-price benchmarking Tender and quotation management Food/F&B procurement knowledge Vendor development and alternate sourcing Inventory and stock management Strong analytical and numerical skills MIS and reporting Advanced Excel / Google Sheets ERP / procurement software knowledge Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability Strong communication and interpersonal skills Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple locations 5. KEY STAKEHOLDERS Internal: DGM / Head – Procurement Finance & Accounts Operations Executive Chefs / Culinary Team Outlet Managers Stores / Inventory Team HR & Administration External: Suppliers and Vendors Distributors Manufacturers Service Providers Logistics / Delivery Partners 6. CORE ACCOUNTABILITY The Purchase Manager is accountable for ensuring: Right Product | Right Quality | Right Price | Right Vendor | Right Quantity | Right Time while maintaining procurement compliance, controlling costs, improving vendor performance, minimizing stock-outs and supporting uninterrupted operations across Pebble Street Hospitality outlets. Primary Focus Areas Cost Saving | Vendor Management | Negotiation | Quality | Availability | TAT | Tender Management | Inventory Control | Waste Reduction | Compliance | Reporting

title: Program Manager
description:
Program Manager SteelBazaar Location: Noida / Delhi NCR | Experience: 5-10 Years | Full-time 
 About the Role SteelBazaar is building a technology-led ecosystem for the steel industry, connecting buyers, sellers, manufacturers, warehouses, logistics partners and financial services through digital products, data and AI. 
 We are looking for an Analytical Program Manager who can combine data-driven decision making, business analytics and strong program execution . The role will work closely with leadership and teams across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, warehouses, sales, procurement, operations, finance and technology . 
 What You Will Do Business & Operational Analytics Analyse business performance across sales, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, warehouses, logistics, customers and suppliers . Identify trends, bottlenecks, inefficiencies and growth opportunities through data. Conduct root-cause analysis and convert insights into actionable business recommendations. Define and track KPIs, targets and performance benchmarks across functions and locations. Dashboards & MIS Build and own management, operational and performance dashboards using Power BI / Tableau / similar tools. Create dashboards covering sales, revenue, RFQs, conversion, inventory, ageing, plant utilisation, warehouse movement, dispatch, logistics, supplier performance and collections. Establish a single source of truth for key business metrics. Automate recurring MIS and reporting wherever possible. Cross-Functional & Ground Operations Act as the bridge between corporate teams and ground operations across plants, warehouses and business locations. Coordinate with functional and location heads to ensure accurate, timely and actionable data. Track performance deviations, identify issues and drive corrective actions. Understand operational realities on the ground rather than relying only on dashboards. Program Management Own strategic initiatives from problem identification analysis planning execution measurement . Define milestones, owners, timelines, dependencies and success metrics. Drive cross-functional programs and ensure timely closure of actions. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide leadership with clear status, risks and recommendations. AI & Automation Adopt an AI-first, hands-on approach to analytics and program execution. Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, Google AI Studio and similar tools to analyse data, build prototypes, automate reporting and create internal decision-support tools. Identify opportunities to use AI agents and automation for operational monitoring, alerts and reporting. 
 What We're Looking For 5-10 years experience in Business Analytics, Program Management, Business Operations, Strategy, Consulting, Product Operations or similar roles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent Excel / Google Sheets and SQL capabilities. Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar BI tools . Strong understanding of business KPIs, dashboards, performance management and data-driven decision making. Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and cross-functional programs . Excellent communication and presentation skills. Comfortable working with both senior leadership and ground-level teams . Strong ownership, execution orientation and ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment. 
 Good to Have Experience in steel, manufacturing, B2B, e-commerce, marketplace, supply chain or logistics . Exposure to plants, warehouses, ERP, inventory or procurement systems. Experience with automation, APIs, data platforms or AI/ML. MBA / PGDM from a reputed institution.

title: Team Member - Logistics Assurance Group
description:
Purpose/Objective 
 
Team Member – Group Logistics Assurance is responsible for executing on-ground logistics assurance tasks including process observation, data validation, and site-level implementation of digital and governance solutions across the Group’s logistics network.
 This role involves extensive coordination with BU plant teams, support for technology rollout (GPS, RFID, fuel management), and ongoing verification of policy compliance and operational metrics.
 Operating in a fully executional capacity, the team member ensures that logistics SOPs are being followed, dashboards are accurately updated, and assurance mechanisms are supported through timely documentation, field feedback, and local issue resolution.
 Key Responsibilities of Role 
 
Process Mapping and Observation: Travel extensively across logistics-intensive sites—cement plants, mines, power plants—to document current processes such as truck loading/unloading, route optimization, warehouse handling, and driver behavior.
 Capture deviations, inefficiencies, and risks first-hand and provide structured documentation to support root-cause analysis and solution design.
 Policy Adherence and Compliance: Regularly check if issued policies (driver hours, fuel pilferage monitoring, delivery order sequencing) are being followed at plant level, and escalate non-compliance with evidence.
 Assist in verifying whether digitized governance mechanisms (e.
g.
, first-in-first-out truck dispatch) are fully enforced and tamper-proof.
 Digitization Rollouts at Site Level: Work with BU plant logistics teams to implement digital solutions like RFID readers, dashcams, fuel sensors, and GPS tracking on owned fleet, ensuring proper calibration and use.
 Support integration of these tools into central dashboards, troubleshoot technical issues, and help plants interpret the outputs for local improvements.
 Project Data for Reporting: Collect, clean, and structure logistics performance data (e.
g.
, unloading times, GPS routes, vehicle fuel efficiency) from SAP, BI dashboards, and on-site records for monthly review.
 Work closely with analytics team members to ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency before it is submitted for senior management review.
 Cross-BU Learnings and Replication: Document best practices observed in certain BUs (e.
g.
, port-side rail efficiency, AI use in import freight booking) and package them for replication across similar logistics contexts.
 Coordinate pilot testing and feedback loops when new tools, templates, or SOPs are introduced across plants or businesses.
 Vendor and System Integration: Liaise with approved vendors for tech installations (dashcams, fuel systems) and ensure seamless handover to BU teams post-deployment.
 Validate system functionality, guide local staff on usage, and support monthly report generation to ensure systems deliver intended assurance metrics.
 Project Timelines and Documentation: Maintain detailed trackers, progress reports, and documentation for each ongoing project under their scope, highlighting milestones, risks, and pending items.
 Serve as the operational continuity point during follow-ups, audits, or site visits, ensuring all updates are timely, accurate, and traceable.
 Technical Competencies 
 
Logistics Management & Optimization,Performance Monitoring and Reporting,Trend Analysis,Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) Development,Power BI Data Analytics,Driving Operational efficiency in logistics - Ocean/ Rail/ Road, sensitivity analysis of various mode,Cost Optimization Qualifications and Experience 
 
Educational Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Commerce, or Business Administration Certification in logistics operations, analytics, or digital systems (optional but advantageous) Work Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in logistics operations, supply chain execution, or business support roles Exposure to plant-level logistics processes, data tracking, digital tool support (e.
g.
, RFID, GPS, SAP), and inter-department coordination Field exposure and willingness to travel extensively across sites required

title: Executive / Senior Executive - Customs & Logistics
description:
We are looking for experienced Customs & Logistics professionals to support and manage inbound and outbound logistics, freight forwarding, EXIM operations, customs documentation, commercial coordination, shipment costing, SAP invoicing, and statutory compliance. The role will involve close coordination with Freight Forwarders, CHAs, Customs Authorities, Suppliers, Buyers, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Operations, Plant Commercial, and Logistics teams to ensure timely, cost-effective, and compliant movement of materials and finished goods. Suitable candidates may be considered for roles based on their expertise in Freight Forwarding & Costing, EXIM & Liaisoning, or SAP Invoicing & Commercial Operations . Key Responsibilities Freight Forwarding & Logistics Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods. Manage inland and overseas logistics operations. Coordinate with Freight Forwarders, CHAs, transporters, shipping lines, and other logistics service providers. Monitor shipment schedules and prioritize urgent and critical shipments. Track shipments and ensure timely material delivery at the required location. Prepare logistics RFQs and obtain quotations from service providers. Prepare commercial comparisons and support service provider selection. Analyze and optimize transportation modes including Air Freight, Sea Freight, LCL, FCL, Road and Multimodal Transportation . Prepare freight and logistics cost estimations for project cargo and bulk material shipments. Identify logistics risks, delays, and bottlenecks and coordinate timely resolution. EXIM & Customs Compliance Handle and review Import and Export documentation. Verify Bills of Entry, Bills of Export, Certificates of Origin, Shipping Documents, Customs Clearance Documents, and related statutory documents . Coordinate with CHAs and Customs authorities for smooth clearance of import and export shipments. Support documentation and compliance related to: EPCG IGCR DGFT Import / Export Licenses Statutory Returns License Maintenance Ensure compliance with Customs, EXIM, and other statutory requirements. Coordinate for import and export certifications as applicable. Maintain accurate EXIM records and documentation. Commercial & Vendor Coordination Coordinate with logistics service providers and vendors for quotations, commercial terms, and delivery schedules. Support commercial discussions and negotiations with logistics service providers. Process and coordinate timely payments to suppliers and service providers. Maintain commercial records, cost data, and logistics-related documentation. Coordinate with internal stakeholders for approval of logistics requirements and commercial proposals. SAP, Invoicing & Dispatch Operations Handle invoicing and waybill generation for Finished Goods (FG) and Scrap Dispatches . Ensure correct item description and duty structure mapping in SAP. Work with SAP SD/MM modules for invoicing and transaction processing. Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Plant Commercial, and Logistics teams for dispatch activities. Handle E-Way Bill and other dispatch documentation. Resolve invoice, waybill, and SAP-related discrepancies. Maintain accurate SAP records and compliance documentation. Coordinate with Finance for GST-related issues and compliance. Documentation & Reporting Maintain accurate records of shipments, freight costs, customs documents, invoices, and statutory compliance. Track shipment status and generate periodic logistics reports. Prepare MIS and performance reports for management. Maintain documentation related to logistics operations, EXIM, customs, invoicing, and compliance. Ensure timely submission of statutory and internal reports. Required Skills Customs & EXIM Operations Import & Export Documentation Freight Forwarding Logistics & Supply Chain Management Freight Costing & Commercial Comparison CHA & Freight Forwarder Coordination Customs Clearance EPCG / IGCR / DGFT Documentation Bills of Entry & Bills of Export SAP SD / MM Invoicing & E-Way Bill GST Compliance Shipment Tracking Air / Sea / LCL / FCL Logistics Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination MS Excel & Reporting Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or any relevant discipline. Candidates with qualifications or experience in International Business, EXIM, Logistics, Supply Chain, Finance, or Commercial Operations will be preferred. Experience 4 - 8 Years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: Customs & Logistics Freight Forwarding EXIM Operations Import & Export Customs Clearance Commercial Operations SAP Invoicing Plant Commercial Supply Chain & Logistics Experience in Manufacturing, Solar, Renewable Energy, EPC, Engineering, Project Cargo, or Industrial Operations will be an added advantage. Preferred Candidate Profile Strong knowledge of Customs and EXIM procedures. Experience working with Freight Forwarders and CHAs. Hands-on experience in Import and Export documentation. Knowledge of EPCG, IGCR and DGFT processes. Experience in freight costing and logistics commercial evaluation. SAP SD/MM experience preferred. Good understanding of GST, invoicing and E-Way Bill processes. Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple shipments and work under tight deadlines.

Key Skills: Customs,Logistics,Procurement,Air Freight,Sea Freight,Costing,Import,Customs Authorities

title: Support Engineer
description:
Job Description 
 
 Position: Support Engineer
 Location: Ahmedabad
 Shift: US business hours 
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 2 to 5 years
 
 About the Company 
 
Altum is a Chicago-based technology consulting firm delivering cloud-native and AI-driven solutions to clients across industries including finance, healthcare, transportation, manufacturing, and insurance. Leveraging our proprietary AI platform, NiceFlow.ai , Altum enables organizations to accelerate digital transformation and achieve measurable business outcomes. 
Altum fosters a culture of professionalism, collaboration, and continuous learning, offering employees meaningful opportunities for growth and long-term career development
 
 About this role 
We are looking for a Support Engineer with 2 to 5 years of experience to support our business applications and our US-based customers. You do not need to be a deep technical expert. You do need a solid understanding of how business systems work, a structured approach to troubleshooting, and clear communication skills. We provide structured training on our applications, tools, and support processes. This role works US business hours from our Ahmedabad office.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Provide Level 1 and Level 2 support for business applications to US-based customers and internal teams. Log, triage, and prioritize incidents and service requests in the ticketing tool, and see them through to resolution. Monitor application health, alerts, and dashboards, and escalate issues to the right team when needed. Follow documented troubleshooting steps and runbooks to resolve common issues. Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and business teams on issues that need deeper investigation. Assist with root cause analysis for recurring issues and suggest preventive measures. Communicate clearly with customers and stakeholders over email, chat, and calls, and provide regular status updates. Create and maintain support documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures. Ensure compliance with SLAs and escalate proactively when an SLA is at risk. Participate in shift-based and on-call production support as required. Skills Required 
 2to 5 years of experience in application support, technical support, or customer support roles. Good understanding of how software systems, databases, and integrations fit together at a conceptual level. Ability to follow troubleshooting steps and read basic application logs and error messages. Hands-on experience with a ticketing tool such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar. Strong written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate directly with US-based customers. Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and a strong willingness to learn new systems. Ability to work independently during US business hours and manage priorities under pressure. Preferred Skills 
 Basic SQL knowledge for reading data and running simple queries. Familiarity with Windows or Linux environments. Basic understanding of APIs, web services, and system integrations. Exposure to ITIL concepts such as Incident, Problem, and Change Management. Prior experience supporting US or other international customers. Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in any discipline; Computer Science, IT, or a related field is preferred. Willingness to work US time zone shifts on a consistent, long-term basis. What We Offer 
 Structured onboarding and hands-on training on our applications, tools, and support processes. Direct exposure to US-based customers and cross-functional teams. A clear growth path into senior support, application, or technical roles. Employee Benefits & Growth Opportunities 
 Altum offers a professional and supportive work environment with opportunities for career growth and skill development. Employees benefit from: Health insurance and employee well-being support Continuous learning and professional development opportunities Exposure to global clients and emerging technologies A collaborative culture that encourages ownership and innovation Long-term career growth aligned with organizational expansion 
 Altum is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Area Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE: 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic Area Manager with strong management and operational skills to oversee existing and upcoming restaurants. The ideal candidate should have experience in the QSR or FMCG industry and be responsible for driving sales, profitability, operational excellence, and team performance while ensuring California Burrito standards and customer expectations are consistently met. 
 Locations: Bengaluru | NCR | Pune | Mumbai | Chennai 
 THE IDEAL CANDIDATE: 
 Area Manager is responsible for the overall Business operations of the allocated restaurants according to California Burrito operational standards and run profitable business. A majority of time is spent leading/Guiding and coaching the team to meet Guest expectations, achieving both bottom and topline objectives by the guiding ambition of our organization. 
 Looking for someone who is from QSR or FMCG industry. 
 ROLES/RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 1) LEAD GREAT RESTAURANTS 
 Own the performance of your allotted restaurants and Strive for Excellence across operations, hospitality, food safety, sanitation and cleanliness. Lead from the front. Model great hospitality, coach restaurant teams and remove anything getting in the way of a great guest experience. Empower teams to resolve guest concerns quickly, thoughtfully and for the long term. Spot problems and opportunities early, build clear action plans and make sure they get done. 
 2) BUILD TEAMS THAT KEEP GROWING 
 Build an Open & Honest culture where every team member is treated fairly and respectfully. Develop restaurant leaders and their teams through strong training, regular coaching, meaningful recognition and clear accountability. Set clear goals, share performance openly and give teams Freedom with Ownership to deliver results. Stay flexible and step in wherever the business needs you most. 
 3) DRIVE HEALTHY GROWTH 
 Own sales, costs and profitability across your restaurants, monitoring every cost line against the annual business plan. Regularly review performance with your direct reports, conduct gap analysis and help every restaurant stay on target and achieve its bottom-line incentive. Understand and execute all in-store marketing promotions, while sharing relevant market-level inputs for national marketing across digital, print and other channels. Lead new product rollouts, support new restaurant openings and drive strong sales across new and existing locations. 
 4) KEEP EVERYONE MOVING TOGETHER 
 Work closely with support teams to solve problems, align on business priorities and turn plans into action. Communicate goals, results and next steps clearly so every team understands what they are working towards and how they contribute. Keep growing everyday. Ask for feedback, share ideas and keep finding better ways to work. 
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 
 5+ years of experience in QSR Graduate in any discipline; Hospitality/Hotel Management preferred. Relevant experience in Cafes, QSR, Restaurant or Hospitality Prior experience managing multiple outlets/stores is preferred. Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Strong understanding of sales, P&L, people management, inventory, and operations. Highly customer-focused, energetic, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. 
 SALARY 
 Will depend on experience. Upto 10 LPA (including incentives). Local conveyance will be covered by company.

title: Visualisation Designer 3D
description:
Job Summary We expect the candidate to work actively to hit the project goals in time. Candidates applying must have a minimum of 3 years of work experience in a consulting environment or a startup environment. This can convert to a full-time role if there is a synergy between the team and the individual. Analogy is a close-knit team working on disruptive products for clients around the world. We are purposefully structured as a small but highly specialized team with individuals who love to push the boundaries in design. Our Values Courage You are open and you say what you feel even if it's controversial. You make tough decisions without agonizing. You take smart risks and don't play it safe all the time. You question actions inconsistent with our values. Pick and choose your battles well - challenge the status quo when it's truly required. Empathy You seek at all times what is best for the company, rather than what is best for yourself or what is best for your group. You are ego-less when searching or listening for the best ideas. You consult with team members and share success. You take the time to help out your fellow employees. You share information freely and without any bias. You are in the shoes of the user and the client at all times. Honesty You are direct and you are yourself. We don't encourage you to be someone else. You are also honest about what you want to achieve and work on and when you are wrong you admit you are. Being adamant is a trait that wastes time and clashes with being self-aware. Be true to yourself and to the team. Don't be a Yes Man or Woman. Impact You get things done no matter what. Without excuses, without the need to justify yourself or others, or what ideal situation you would need to achieve the goals set. You demonstrate a consistently strong performance so others may see you as their role model. You focus on great results with simple steps. In short, you don't wait or hold things up. You exhibit bias to action and avoid analysis paralysis. About the Job Analogy is looking to break the boundaries between physical and digital with design as our weapon of choice. There is a niche we look to fit into and develop groundbreaking, smart and connected products. As a Freelance 3D Visualisation Designer, you will work directly with the lead industrial designers to drive innovation in projects from start to finish. In addition to your strong foundation in ID, you bring strong skills in driving innovative ideas. You have experience in various rendering tools, like Keyshot, Cinema 4D or Blender. Additionally, a strong sense of documentation and process is very much required. Role: Freelance 3D Visualisation Designer Location: Hybrid/Remote - Bangalore, India Your Experience A minimum of a Bachelor degree in Design. A Master's degree is a bonus. 3 to 5 years of working experience at a design consultancy or similar environment. A strong body of portfolio/work outlining your ability to fulfill the role above. What We Are Looking For You love products and you love design. You have a keen eye and obsess over details because you know that's the difference between good products and great products. You're extremely collaborative in a team environment but equally comfortable working autonomously. You're an excellent communicator and able to tailor your style to a specific audience whether it be external partners or internal stakeholders. A person that has a passion for their craft, is able to innovate or even restart when they hit roadblocks to create fresh IP-worthy designs. A natural leader who is comfortable taking ownership, with a desire to win in a highly competitive environment. Strong KeyShot visualization skills, as well as proficiency with SolidWorks or Fusion 360 software. Knowledge of computational design software, such as Grasshopper, is an added bonus. Tasks & Accountabilities Work collaboratively and implement critical feedback effectively. Collaborate with the lead industrial designers and team to drive innovation in projects from start to finish. Conduct research and analysis of client needs and user feedback to inform design decisions. Develop and present design concepts and solutions to clients and other stakeholders. Create detailed design documentation, including sketches, renderings, and technical drawings. Work with rapid prototyping processes, such as 3D printing and CNC machining, to create prototypes and test designs. Conduct user testing and incorporate feedback into design iterations. Ensure designs meet project goals, deadlines and budget constraints. Personal Qualities and Behavioral Requirements Taking initiative with a flexible and adaptable approach to drive tasks forward. Getting things done with a results-oriented mindset. Commitment to timelines and responsibilities. Great time management and communication skills between clients and team members. Approaching work with a professional, calm, and presentable attitude.
