title: Assistant Manager HSE
description:
Position:- Asst. Manager HSE Exp - 4-7 years Job Purpose To drive the continual development and maturity of Sodexo Safety Culture and Safe Behaviors by demonstrating safety leadership behaviors and embedding the Group Zero Harm Mindset initiatives. Deploy the implementation of the APMEA Food and Health and Safety Processes across all sites, Adaption of APMEA processes, where required, into Country / Local Processes to check legal compliance within country /area of responsibility. The overall mission is to deliver safe and compliant work solutions for operations teams providing services. This will be achieved by operationally implementing APMEA HSE systems and procedures and where required, identify any policy and or procedure gaps or omissions or variations required. Also assist in the development of HSE solutions specifically for our clients. Roles and Responsibilities 
 Make sure deployment of Zero Harm mindset within frontline employees. Make sure Safety improvement plan action implemented at site/ account. Confirm deployment of Sodexo Safety Net and Client Safety initiative at site / account. Food Safety Responsible of overall upkeep, food hygiene and safety standards of the location. Monitor activities through out food chain for upkeep of Food safety standards. Risk Assessment - Identify the potential risk related to working environment, machinery or equipment and suggest the preventive measure to site manager. Prepare Risk Assessment & Risk Register. Update risk assessment post incident or new scope addition. Train all frontline staff in hazard identification and reporting. Communicate risk assessment to staff. Legal Register - Prepare and update Legal Register. Make sure all legal compliance in place and escalate in case of Non compliances. Safety Walk and Safety Observation - Conduct safety walks and Safety Observation. Report in Salus system and track for closure Near Miss - Create awareness on Nearmiss reporting and report Nearmiss in Salus Incident Management - Inform regional HSE & region Head. Investigate the incident and Prepare RCA along with Site Manager and team. Make sure all root causes corrective actions implemented at site. Share Incident learning with site teams, HSE Practices - Make sure adherence to Time temperature, FIFO, Sorting Process, Thawing, salt & Turmeric processes, CCPs, Deep Cleaning, Pest Control, PPM of Equipment, Electrical Safety, Global engineering practices, HSMS processes. Documentation - Monitoring that all checklists and records are maintained. Cleaning Checklist, Pest Control Records, 11/ A-L files, Temperature records, COA, E-guarantee form, Invoices etc. Escalate in case of repeated deviations. HSE Trainings -Prepare Training Matrix. Inform site manager in advance of planned training (TBT, Quick Share, Campaign, regular training etc.). Conduct HSE induction for new joiners. Make sure compliance to Training Matrix update Site wise Training Tracker. Training compliance to be tracked as per training calendar in training tracker. Upload training details to Access system. Safety Campaigns -Plan and arrange the various safety motivation program such as safety day celebration, safety contest to motivate and spread awareness among the staff. Calibrations - Verify that calibration of equipment e.g., thermometer probe, GLD, weighing balance, pressure gauge is being carried out on defined frequency. Conduct Self inspection and Safety declaration monthly and track and close all reported gaps / observations. HSE Audit Findings - Follow, track and Coordinate with site manager, region head and client for closures. Escalate in case of overdue. Food Sample Retention - Periodically verify the sample and freezer temperature. Report deviation to site manager and escalate in case sample are not retained. Mobilization Framework – Make sure HSE mobilization framework includes MOB 03, BCP, ERP, Communication Board, PPE matrix, HSE Files and Folders, HSE induction training, HSE Accountability, Risk Assessment, Hazard Analysis, SOP implementation. Follow up for due diligence points with client or vendor or region head. Subcontractor Management- Co-ordinate with Site Leads and SCM and make sure subcontractor Management processes are implemented across all sites. Monitor vendor partner’s activities for the compliance on food & Health and Safety practices. PPE Compliance - verify that all staff are using the required PPE while performing the task. Provide list and quantity of required PPE. Prepare PPE matrix. Raise negligence issues with region head. Report negligence issues in Access HR. Lab Testing - Coordinate with site manager and verify that periodic external food and water testing is being done. Review test report for suitability and make sure samples are send as per sampling plan SNAG list - Provide inputs related to snag points. Follow-up with site manager & client for closure. Participate in joint discussion with client for snag. Review health condition of equipment and suggest for rectification and addition of safety feature, if required connect with regional purchase or client. Miscellaneous – Food Inspector Visit - Inform Regional HSE and Regional Head. To provide compliance documents. Co-ordinate with food testing lab for testing (reference sample). Obtain COA, invoice of sample. Review the existing SOP and recommended corrections Support for BCP Review and Audit, MMR and QBR Data support, Emergency Response and Mock Drill at site / account. Job Requirements Qualifications 
 Graduate / Postgraduate – BSC/ MSC/ B.E/ B. Tech - Food Certified Lead auditor ISO22000/ HACCP / ISO 9001 / ISO45001 – (Optional) Advance Diploma in Food Safety (Optional) Certified Food safety HACCP Level 3 & Food Safety Level 4 (Optional) Experience 
 Minimum 2-5 years' experience in Food Safety and Health and Safety Systems Management Experience working with industrial food safety and occupational work safety. Functional Competencies 
 Business Know-How – Understanding of our business Awareness about the Socio-Economic, Legal, Political forces that impact our nature of business Client Obsessed - Understanding their needs, focus points, adding & delivering value Industry Clue-In; Aware of the Best Practices / Business Insights Financial Acumen - Understanding of Financial Parameters and impact on Business Behavioral Competencies 
 Optimizes Work Process Drives Results Courage Good Decision Quality Effective Communication Drive Accountability Collaborates Being Resilient Manages Ambiguity

Key Skills: HSE Audit,Food Safety,Hazard Analysis,HSE Documentation,Analysis,Auditing,Safety,HSE

title: Clinical Data Manager
description:
Job Title: Clinical Data Manager Experience: 3-5 Years
 Location:- Ahmedabad, WFO. 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 Job Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Clinical Data Manager with 3-5 years of experience in clinical data management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing clinical trial data throughout the study lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, accurate, and compliant data. The role involves database design review, data validation, query management, data cleaning, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to support successful clinical study execution. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end clinical data management activities for assigned clinical studies in accordance with project timelines. Review study protocols and contribute to the design and review of electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), edit checks, and clinical databases. Perform data validation, discrepancy management, and query generation/resolution to ensure data quality, consistency, and completeness. Develop and execute data cleaning strategies, including routine data review and reconciliation activities. Review clinical trial data for accuracy, integrity, and compliance with study protocols, SOPs, client requirements, and regulatory guidelines. Coordinate database User Acceptance Testing (UAT), database updates, and database lock activities. Generate data listings, reports, metrics, and study status summaries for internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Medical Monitoring, and external vendors to resolve data-related issues. Review and maintain Data Management Plans (DMPs), Data Validation Plans (DVPs), CRF Completion Guidelines, and other study documentation. Support medical coding activities using MedDRA and WHO Drug dictionaries, where applicable. Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, CDISC standards, SOPs, and applicable regulatory requirements. Participate in audit and inspection readiness activities and address data management findings. Prioritise workload effectively to meet project milestones and deliverables. Mentor or guide junior Clinical Data Management associates, as required. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Nursing, or a related discipline. 3-5 years of experience in Clinical Data Management within a CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environment. Experience working with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems such as Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm, Veeva EDC, or similar platforms. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, database management, and data cleaning methodologies. Knowledge of ICH-GCP, CDISC (CDASH/SDTM), and regulatory guidelines. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications. 

 Required Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data quality. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Ability to manage multiple studies and prioritise competing deadlines. Strong interpersonal and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting Phase IIV clinical studies. Exposure to data reconciliation, external data management, and medical coding processes. Certification in Clinical Data Management or Clinical Research is desirable. Good to have knowledge of CDISC/ SDTM Good to have knowledge of oncology trials. 
 Looking for an immediate joiner to 30 days of Notice Period.

title: Doorman
description:
Greet and escort guests to rooms. Open doors and assist guests/visitors entering and leaving property. Inform guests of property amenities, services, and hours of operation, and local areas of interest and activities. Identify and explain room features to guests (eg, use of room key, mini-bar, ice and vending areas, in-room safe, valet laundry services). Transport guest luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area. Assist with luggage storage and retrieval. Assist guests/visitors in and out of vehicles, including assisting guests with loading/unloading luggage. Supply guests with directions. Arrange transportation (eg, taxicab, shuttle bus, limousine/sedan service) for guests/visitors, and record advance transportation request as needed. Communicate parking procedures to guests/visitors. Follow all company policies and procedures, and report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager. Maintain awareness of undesirable persons on property premises. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals - Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis. - Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work. - Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others. - Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met. - Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results. - Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals. Supporting Management of Front Desk Team - Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example. - Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. - Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors. - Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence. - Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team. - Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager. Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service - Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention. - Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed. - Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints. - Sets a positive example for guest relations. - Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. - Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals. - Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction. - Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters. - Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels. - Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement. Managing Projects and Policies - Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process. - Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates. - Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy. - Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures. - Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process. title: HR Manager
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a dynamic, people-oriented and proactive HR Manager to lead and strengthen the organisations HR function. The role is primarily focused on recruitment, employee engagement, people management and building a positive workplace culture . The HR Manager will work closely with management and employees to ensure the organisation attracts the right talent, supports employee performance and development, and maintains a healthy and positive work environment. This is a hands-on HR role for someone who enjoys working closely with people, taking ownership of HR activities and contributing directly to the organisations growth. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition 
 Manage the end-to-end recruitment process across different functions and levels. Understand manpower requirements from department heads and management. Source candidates through job portals, professional networks, references and other recruitment channels. Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate discussions. Coordinate interviews and maintain regular communication with candidates. Follow up with selected candidates through the offer and joining process. Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular updates on hiring status. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates for current and future requirements. 
 2. Employee Engagement & Workplace Culture 
 Build positive relationships with employees across different teams. Create a supportive, energetic and employee-friendly work environment. Identify employee concerns and facilitate appropriate discussions with management. Organise employee engagement activities, team interactions and internal initiatives. Encourage open communication and a positive approach to workplace challenges. Contribute towards strengthening employee morale, motivation and team spirit. 
 3. Employee Relations & People Management 
 Act as a point of contact for employees for day-to-day HR-related matters. Support employees and managers in resolving workplace issues professionally and fairly. Maintain effective communication between management and employees. Understand employee needs and provide appropriate HR support. Promote professional behaviour, accountability and teamwork within the organisation. 
 4. Performance & Development 
 Support the implementation and monitoring of employee performance processes. Coordinate performance reviews and maintain relevant records. Work with managers to identify employee development needs. Support training, learning and development initiatives. Encourage continuous improvement and professional growth among employees. 
 5. HR Operations 
 Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation. Support onboarding and induction of new employees. Coordinate attendance, leave and other routine HR processes. Ensure timely completion of HR-related documentation and internal records. Support management in implementing HR policies and processes. Maintain confidentiality of employee and organisational information. 
 6. HR Planning & Management Support 
 Work closely with management on current and future manpower requirements. Provide HR-related insights and updates to management. Identify opportunities to improve employee experience and HR processes. Support organisational initiatives related to people, culture and performance. Take ownership of assigned HR projects and ensure timely execution. 
 Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate will be: A people-oriented and approachable HR professional . Proactive, energetic and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Strong in communication and interpersonal skills. Capable of independently managing recruitment activities. Comfortable interacting with employees at different levels. Positive in approach and able to create a healthy workplace environment. Good at coordinating multiple HR activities simultaneously. Strong in follow-up, execution and maintaining HR records. Business-focused while maintaining an employee-centric approach. Mature and professional in handling confidential and sensitive matters. 
 Preferred Experience & Qualifications 
 4-10 years of relevant HR experience. Graduate/Postgraduate qualification in HR, Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field . Strong experience in recruitment and talent acquisition. Experience in employee engagement and employee relations. Experience in Tourism, Travel, Hospitality or other service-oriented industries will be an added advantage . Good working knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace and HR/recruitment tools. 
 Languages 
 Hindi Mandatory Malayalam Preferred Good communication skills in English are expected. 
 Key Skills 
 Recruitment | Talent Acquisition | Employee Engagement | Employee Relations | People Management | Performance Management | HR Operations | Communication | Coordination | Conflict Resolution | Team Building | Culture Building 
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are looking for someone who sees HR not merely as an administrative function, but as a people and business function . The right candidate should be someone who can hire the right people, connect with employees, build positive energy within the organisation and create a workplace where people feel supported, motivated and accountable. 
 If you are an HR professional who enjoys working closely with people and wants to make a meaningful contribution to organisational growth, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Description Senior Data Engineer Mindera At Mindera, we build technology products that create meaningful business impact. We work with modern cloud technologies and encourage engineering ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and self-organization. Our Data Engineering teams build scalable, reliable, and high-performance data platforms that enable analytics, reporting, machine learning, and data-driven decision-making. 
 Requirements What We’re Looking For Key Responsibilities Design and develop scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines using AWS Glue, PySpark, Python, and SQL. Develop and maintain distributed data processing applications using Apache Spark . Build and orchestrate data workflows using Apache Airflow . Develop AWS Glue jobs for batch and incremental data processing. Work with Amazon S3 and other AWS services to build cloud-based data solutions. Perform complex data transformations, cleansing, validation, and enrichment. Write optimized and maintainable SQL queries for large datasets. Optimize Spark and PySpark jobs for performance, scalability, and resource utilization. Implement data partitioning, caching, broadcast joins, and other Spark optimization techniques. Design reliable and fault-tolerant data pipelines with appropriate error handling and retry mechanisms. Implement data quality checks and monitoring across data pipelines. Troubleshoot production data pipeline failures and performance issues. Work with large-scale structured and semi-structured datasets. Participate in technical design and architecture discussions. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering best practices. 
 Required Skills Python Strong programming experience in Python. Experience writing production-quality, modular, and reusable code. Knowledge of exception handling, logging, testing, and debugging. Familiarity with Python data-processing libraries. SQL Strong SQL skills with experience handling large datasets. Complex joins and subqueries. CTEs and window functions. Aggregations and analytical queries. Query optimization and performance tuning. Data deduplication and incremental processing logic. Apache Spark / PySpark Strong hands-on experience with Spark and PySpark. Understanding of Spark architecture and execution model. DataFrames and Spark SQL. Transformations and actions. Partitioning and repartitioning. Shuffle optimization. Broadcast joins. Caching and persistence. Handling data skew. Spark job troubleshooting and performance optimization. AWS Glue Hands-on experience developing AWS Glue ETL jobs. Experience with Glue Data Catalog and Crawlers. Glue Spark jobs. DynamicFrames and DataFrames. Job bookmarks and incremental processing. Partitioned data processing. Schema evolution and data quality. Integration with Amazon S3 and other AWS services. Apache Airflow Experience designing and developing Airflow DAGs. Task dependencies and scheduling. Operators and sensors. Retries and failure handling. Backfills and catchup. XCom and task communication. Monitoring and troubleshooting DAGs. Designing idempotent and reusable workflows. AWS Strong experience with AWS data services. Amazon S3. AWS Glue. IAM. CloudWatch. Familiarity with services such as Lambda, Athena, Redshift, or EMR is an advantage. 
 Preferred Skills Experience with modern data lake / data warehouse architectures. Experience with Parquet and other columnar storage formats. Knowledge of data modeling and dimensional modeling. Experience with CI/CD and Git-based development workflows. Familiarity with Docker and infrastructure-as-code concepts. Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience working with high-volume and large-scale datasets. Understanding of data governance, security, and data quality practices. 
 Senior-Level Expectations Independently own data engineering projects from requirements through production. Design scalable and maintainable data architectures. Make appropriate technology and architecture decisions. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Troubleshoot complex production issues. Establish coding, testing, and data quality standards. Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical decision-making. Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Benefits We offer Flexible working hours (self-managed) Annual bonus, subject to company performance Access to Udemy online training and opportunities to learn and grow within the role At Mindera we use technology to build products we are proud of, with people we love. Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do at Mindera. We partner with our clients, to understand their products and deliver high-performance, resilient and scalable software systems that create an impact on their users and businesses across the world. You get to work with a bunch of great people, and the whole team owns the project together. Our culture reflects our lean and self-organisation attitude. We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way and talk to everyone to enhance communication. We are proud of our work and we love to learn all and everything while navigating through an Agile, Lean and collaborative environment.

title: Software Engineer- AI-Driven SRE & Cloud SRE
description:
About Us CLOUDSUFI is a Silicon Valley-based specialist Data Engineering Cloud Technologies player with top-tier clients, favorable revenue mix, strong financial performance, and robust management. We help organizations with Data Discovery, Insights, and Monetization, offering our engineers the opportunity to work on new platforms and technologies-including Cloud Hyper Scalers and AI/ML/NLP-that put them ahead of peers in the IT Services industry. Started in 2019, CLOUDSUFI is a family of 250+ members working towards a common goal of making enterprise data dance. 
 This role sits within CLOUDSUFI s live engagement where AI is already embedded operationally across reliability and platform engineering-not a future aspiration. The team runs an AI SRE co-pilot that reasons across observability, cloud, and ticketing platforms; a set of purpose-built AI sub-agents for incident triage, monitor hygiene, and usage/cost attribution; and a formal AI governance program that assesses CLOUDSUFI s own internal AI agents for risk before they touch production. You will be embedded with the client s SRE function supporting a regulated consumer-lending platform on AWS-hundreds of microservices, event-driven pipelines, and customer-facing loan origination and servicing journeys where reliability is directly a customer-trust and compliance concern. As a Junior SRE Engineer, you will work under the guidance of senior engineers and architects to support, operate, and learn from this AI-driven reliability program. Responsibilities - AI-Driven Initiatives 
 1. AI-Augmented Incident Response Root Cause Analysis Support incident response as a shadow or secondary responder, using AI-driven detection, correlation, and root-cause analysis tooling under the guidance of senior engineers to speed up triage. Help assemble incident timelines from metrics, logs, traces, and deploy history, learning to separate the alert that fired from the change that actually caused it. Help operate and monitor the existing AI SRE sub-agents (covering areas such as incident summarization, monitor-gap detection, and usage attribution), flagging anomalies or failures for senior review. Assist in documenting AI-assisted incident findings and postmortems, including tracking corrective and preventive actions through to closure. 
 2. AI-Driven Observability Alert Quality Build and maintain monitors, dashboards, and SLO definitions in Datadog as code via Terraform , rather than clicking through the UI. Assist in reducing alert noise using AI/ML-assisted detection (anomaly, outlier, and forecast monitors, composite conditions, and dynamic thresholds) so that pages stay actionable and rare. Run recurring monitor-hygiene and coverage-gap reviews - no-data monitors, missing no-data notification, orphaned monitors on decommissioned services, and monitors with no owning team tag or valid notification target. Support SLI/SLO and error-budget reviews for critical customer journeys, escalating services trending toward budget exhaustion to senior team members. 
 3. AI-Enabled Cloud Reliability, Capacity Cost Engineering Support day-to-day reliability of AWS workloads - ECS/Fargate, EKS, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, ALB, SQS/SNS and Step Functions - under senior guidance. Use predictive analytics and intelligent monitoring dashboards to spot capacity, saturation, and cost anomalies across host, container, log, APM, and serverless usage, escalating notable trends with evidence. Assist in observability and cloud cost governance , attributing spend and telemetry volume to owning teams and services and helping identify low-value, high-cost signals. 
 4. AI Governance, Risk Reliability Reviews (Learning Track) Participate in architecture and design reviews, learning how reliability risk and AI-agent risk (e.g., prompt injection, authorization gaps, secrets exposure in agent and tool configuration, blast radius of autonomous actions) is assessed and documented. Learn how production-readiness, change management, and audit expectations apply in a regulated environment (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, SOX, GLBA), and why observability evidence matters to auditors. Assist in tracking action items from the AI-risk and reliability remediation roadmap and help prepare status updates for stakeholders. 
 5. AI-Enabled DevOps, CI/CD Automation Support the implementation of reliability and safety controls within CI/CD pipelines , learning automation-first and AI-augmented approaches and shift-left practices from senior engineers. Help integrate AI-assisted checks (e.g., change-risk summaries, infrastructure drift detection, dependency and configuration checks) into the delivery lifecycle. Write and maintain automation in Python and Bash against platform APIs (Datadog, AWS, GitHub, PagerDuty, Jira) to replace recurring manual work, and contribute Terraform modules and pull requests under review. Assist with runbook creation and the progressive automation of runbook steps toward self-healing. 
 6. AI-Enabled Program Workflow Support Support multiple concurrent reliability initiatives using AI-enabled workflow and tracking tools shared across SRE and Security teams. Help promote a reliability-first culture by learning and sharing data-driven, AI-backed operational practices with the wider team. 
 SRE Cloud Capabilities Interest in observability and monitoring fundamentals - metrics, logs, traces, and APM - and a willingness to learn predictive analytics and anomaly detection. Exposure to at least one observability platform (Datadog preferred; Grafana/Prometheus, New Relic, CloudWatch, or ELK/OpenSearch also relevant). Foundational understanding of SLI, SLO, and error-budget concepts, and of why alert fatigue is a reliability problem rather than an annoyance. Hands-on exposure to AWS (or an equivalent hyperscaler) across compute, networking, storage, and managed database services, with interest in automated reliability tooling. Foundational knowledge of container and orchestration concepts (Docker, ECS or Kubernetes) and of serverless execution models. Beginner-to-intermediate familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred; Ansible or CloudFormation acceptable) and an eagerness to build deeper IaC expertise. Basic Linux troubleshooting and networking fundamentals, including DNS, TLS, load balancing, timeouts and retries. Some hands-on exposure to automation or scripting (Python, Bash, or similar), including consuming REST APIs and parsing JSON. Comfort with Git and pull-request-based workflows, and exposure to CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD or similar). Familiarity with incident management and on-call concepts, including severity models, escalation policies, and paging tools such as PagerDuty or Opsgenie. Basic exposure to cloud posture and continuous monitoring concepts, and to change and release management discipline. Practical curiosity about LLM-based assistants and agents applied to operations, and about how to verify whether their output is actually correct. About You 1-3 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform, or production-support engineering, with an eagerness to build deeper expertise in infrastructure as code. Some exposure to cloud-native logging and monitoring tools, and interest in AI-driven alerting and noise reduction. You debug from evidence: when something breaks, your instinct is to look at the data before offering a theory, and you are comfortable saying I don t know yet, here is what I am checking. You would rather automate a task the second time you do it than the tenth. Coursework or hands-on exposure to monitoring and observability platforms. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and interest in integrating reliability controls and shift-left practices. Basic understanding of capacity, performance, and reliability cost concepts, including risk-based prioritization of remediation work. Awareness of common compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, SOX, HIPAA/GLBA) and comfort working with production-change discipline. Willingness to learn incident management processes, including AI-assisted triaging, and the judgment to escalate early rather than sit quietly on an uncertain production signal. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity to assess simple architectures for failure modes under senior guidance. Clear written communication - you can explain an incident, a metric, or a trade-off to someone who was not in the room. Interest in learning how reliability standards, operational policies, and governance frameworks are developed and maintained, including for AI-agent usage. 
 Core Competencies Working knowledge of, or strong willingness to learn, several of the following domains: Site Reliability Engineering fundamentals (SLI/SLO, error budgets, toil reduction) Observability and Monitoring (metrics, logs, distributed tracing, APM, RUM/Synthetics) AIOps basics - anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive analytics, alert noise reduction Incident Response and Postmortem/RCA practice Cloud Infrastructure (AWS core services, multi-account and IAM basics) Containers and Orchestration (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes) Infrastructure as Code and Configuration Management (Terraform, Ansible) CI/CD, Release Engineering and Progressive Delivery Automation and Scripting (Python, Bash, platform APIs) Capacity, Performance and Reliability Cost Engineering (FinOps fundamentals) Resilience Patterns (retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, graceful degradation) Chaos/Failure-Injection and Disaster Recovery concepts Runbook Automation, Automated Remediation and Self-Healing (exposure) DevSecOps and secure-by-default operations fundamentals AI Agent Risk Governance basics (authorization models, prompt-injection risk, secrets exposure in AI tool configs, human-in-the-loop controls) 
 Preferred Certifications AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Associate-level AWS certification (preferred, not required) HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (preferred, not required) Datadog Fundamentals or an equivalent observability-platform certification (preferred, not required) Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or KCNA (preferred, not required) Exposure to AI/ML applications in operations and reliability is a plus (preferred, not required) Required Skills SRE Observability AI-reliability AI-Observability AI

This is a hands-on technical leadership role , not an engineering management position. You will continue to design systems and write production code , while also owning architecture and technical direction for significant workstreams. You will work across Java, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and GCP , solving problems spanning event ingestion, distributed processing, query engines, analytical storage, low-latency serving, and reporting. A key part of the role is helping us evolve two mature analytics platforms toward a more unified data foundation without compromising the reliability of systems already serving production customers. 
The Engineering Landscape Our production data platform includes: ClickHouse - self-hosted and ClickHouse Cloud for high-volume analytics and SaaS reporting BigQuery - large-scale analytics and data processing Bigtable - low-latency NoSQL serving Redis - caching, queues, and distributed coordination Kafka - high-volume real-time event streaming GCP - GCS, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, IAM, Secret Manager, GKE and VMs Java - Spring Boot and JVM-based backend services Apache Beam / Dataflow - distributed event and batch processing Go - adjacent SQL and reporting services Alongside the existing platform, we are building capabilities around: Warehouse-native experiment computation in customer Snowflake/BigQuery environments Cross-platform visitor profiles and identity First-party cohorts and saved audiences Unified metrics across internal and customer warehouses Converging Wingify and AB Tasty analytics onto a common data foundation 
What Youll Do Architecture System Design Own the technical architecture and design of significant backend/data-platform workstreams. Design distributed systems for high-volume event ingestion, analytical querying, data processing, and low-latency serving . Make architectural decisions around data modelling, storage engines, partitioning, query patterns, caching, streaming, reliability, and cost . Evaluate trade-offs across ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and other technologies based on workload characteristics. Drive designs that can evolve as the Wingify and AB Tasty platforms converge. Hands-on Engineering Remain hands-on with Java and production backend code . Work with Kafka, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, GCS, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, and Redis at production scale. Own critical systems through design, implementation, deployment, observability, and operation . Technical Leadership Set technical direction for a platform area or major engineering workstream . Break ambiguous product and platform requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans. Review architecture and designs from other engineers and challenge assumptions constructively. Establish engineering practices around reliability, scalability, observability, performance, and maintainability . Strong experience designing systems around analytical databases, data warehouses, and/or large-scale non-relational stores . Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Cloud Monitoring.

The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing the existing Forms/Reports application, using appropriate Oracle migration/conversion tooling where applicable, and rebuilding, adapting and testing the application in Oracle APEX. This is primarily a database-centric Oracle application modernisation project , rather than a conventional web-development project. Key Responsibilities Oracle Forms 6i Analysis and Migration Analyse existing Oracle Forms 6i applications, including: Forms modules (.FMB) Menus (.MMB) Object libraries (.OLB) PL/SQL libraries (.PLL) Forms triggers Program units LOVs and record groups Data blocks Master/detail relationships Form-level and item-level business logic Understand and document existing application functionality and business rules. Identify Forms-specific functionality that does not have a direct APEX equivalent. Use Oracle Forms/APEX migration and conversion tools where appropriate. Analyse migration/conversion output and resolve issues requiring manual development. Preserve existing business functionality while improving the user experience for the web environment. Oracle APEX Development Design and develop Oracle APEX applications to replace existing Forms functionality. Convert Forms data blocks into appropriate APEX components. Develop: Interactive Reports Interactive Grids Forms Master/detail pages LOVs Faceted searches Charts Dashboards Navigation menus Modal dialogs Implement APEX: Validations Computations Processes Branches Dynamic Actions Shared Components Authentication and authorisation Develop responsive browser-based interfaces using Oracle APEX Universal Theme. Oracle Database / PL/SQL Work extensively with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL. Understand and maintain existing: Tables Views Packages Procedures Functions Triggers Sequences Indexes Jobs Where appropriate, move business logic currently embedded in Forms triggers/program units into reusable database packages and procedures. Analyse and optimise SQL and PL/SQL performance. Assist with database compatibility issues arising from the migration from the existing Oracle 10g environment to a modern Oracle Database release. Oracle Reports 6i Migration Analyse existing Oracle Reports 6i reports (.RDF/.REP and associated objects). Categorise reports according to whether they should be: Rebuilt as APEX reports Implemented using APEX Interactive Reports/Grids Rebuilt using Oracle Analytics Publisher / BI Publisher Replaced with another appropriate reporting solution Reproduce existing report functionality, calculations, parameters and business rules. Ensure PDF, Excel, CSV and other required outputs are available where applicable. Maintain existing report layouts where business requirements require them. Web / Integration Development Develop and consume REST APIs where required. Understand Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS). Work with JSON and RESTful services. Integrate APEX applications with external systems where required. Understand HTTP, HTTPS and basic web application architecture. Testing and Deployment Perform functional testing against the existing Forms application. Compare existing Forms behaviour with the new APEX application. Identify and resolve migration discrepancies. Perform regression testing. Support user acceptance testing. Prepare APEX application exports and deployment scripts. Work with source control/version control systems such as Git. Support deployment between development, test and production environments. Essential Skills and Experience The successful candidate should have strong experience in the following: Essential Oracle APEX development Oracle SQL Oracle PL/SQL Oracle Forms 6i Oracle Reports 6i Experience migrating or modernising legacy Oracle Forms applications. Experience analysing Forms triggers and Forms business logic. Experience with Oracle APEX Forms, Reports, Interactive Reports and Interactive Grids. Experience with APEX Dynamic Actions, validations and processes. Good understanding of Oracle database architecture. Experience with Oracle database upgrades or compatibility issues. Ability to understand an existing legacy application and reproduce its functionality in APEX. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Strongly Desirable Previous Oracle Forms 6i Oracle APEX migration experience. Experience with Oracle Forms-to-APEX migration/conversion tooling. Oracle Reports 6i APEX / BI Publisher migration experience. Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS). REST APIs and JSON. HTML5 and CSS. JavaScript, particularly the Oracle APEX JavaScript API. Git/source control. Oracle Analytics Publisher / BI Publisher. Oracle Database 19c or later. Experience with large transactional business applications. Technical Skills The candidate should ideally be comfortable working with: Oracle Oracle Database 19c+ SQL PL/SQL Packages Procedures Functions Views Triggers Indexes Query optimisation Execution plans Oracle APEX APEX Pages Regions Page Items Interactive Reports Interactive Grids Forms Master/Detail LOVs Dynamic Actions Processes Validations Computations Shared Components Authentication Authorisation Security Universal Theme Web HTML CSS JavaScript REST JSON HTTP/HTTPS ORDS Reporting Oracle Reports 6i APEX reporting PDF/Excel/CSV output Oracle Analytics Publisher / BI Publisher Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who can work with an existing mature Oracle application and understand why the application does something , rather than simply reproduce the appearance of an old Form. The ideal candidate will be comfortable reading legacy Forms 6i code, understanding Forms triggers and PL/SQL business logic, identifying dependencies, and deciding how that functionality should be implemented properly in APEX. The candidate should be able to distinguish between: Business logic Oracle PL/SQL / database packages User interface logic APEX pages, processes, validations and Dynamic Actions Web/integration functionality APEX / ORDS / REST / JavaScript Reporting APEX Reports / Analytics Publisher / appropriate reporting technology Project Deliverables The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to: 1. Assessment and inventory of the existing Forms 6i and Reports 6i application. 2. Identification of Forms modules, libraries, menus, reports and dependencies. 3. Migration/conversion assessment using appropriate Oracle tooling. 4. APEX application architecture and design. 5. Conversion/redevelopment of Forms modules into APEX. 6. Conversion/redevelopment of Reports 6i reports. 7. Refactoring of Forms-specific business logic where appropriate. 8. Database compatibility and migration support. 9. Functional and regression testing. 10. User acceptance testing support. 11. Deployment documentation. 12. Technical documentation for the new APEX application. 13. Knowledge transfer to existing Oracle/PLSQL development staff. Qualifications Professional experience in Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline. 5+ years Oracle development experience preferred. Demonstrable Oracle APEX experience. Demonstrable Oracle Forms experience. Experience with legacy application modernisation is highly desirable. Candidates with strong Oracle Forms/PLSQL experience and proven APEX migration experience will be preferred over candidates who are primarily general-purpose web developers. Preferred Experience The ideal candidate will have previously completed a project involving: Oracle Forms 6i Oracle APEX and/or Oracle Reports 6i APEX / BI Publisher and can provide examples of such work. Experience migrating an application from an older Oracle database version to Oracle Database 19c or later would also be highly desirable. Important Requirement This is not simply an APEX page-development position . The candidate must be able to understand and work with an existing Oracle Forms 6i / Reports 6i application , including legacy Forms triggers, PL/SQL, libraries, menus, reports and database dependencies. Experience in both legacy Oracle Forms and modern Oracle APEX is therefore strongly preferred.

title: Junior Developer Intern
description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for a motivated and curious Junior Developer Intern to join our development team. This role is ideal for freshers or early-career developers who want hands-on exposure to real-world product development across both frontend and backend systems. As a Junior Developer Intern, you will support the team in building, testing, and improving web applications. You will work with modern technologies such as React.js, Angular, Node.js, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap, while learning engineering practices, debugging workflows, and collaborative development processes. Along with core engineering skills, this role also expects comfort with AI-assisted development workflows to improve speed, learning, debugging, and documentation quality in day-to-day work. This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning quickly, and contributing to live projects in a fast-paced environment. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Assist in the development and maintenance of web applications across frontend and backend layers. Support the team in building responsive, user-friendly interfaces using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, React.js, and Angular. Help develop and maintain backend APIs and server-side logic using Node.js. Write clean, readable, and maintainable code under guidance from senior developers. Participate in bug fixing, troubleshooting, testing, and performance improvements. Collaborate with designers, developers, and project stakeholders to understand requirements and implement solutions. Work with version control systems such as Git for code collaboration and tracking changes. Assist in integrating APIs, third-party libraries, and backend services. Use AI-assisted development tools to support coding, debugging, code review, documentation, test case generation, and faster issue resolution, while validating outputs for accuracy and quality. Leverage AI tools to improve development productivity, understand unfamiliar codebases, and accelerate learning of frameworks, libraries, and best practices. Learn and follow coding standards, development workflows, and deployment practices. Actively participate in team discussions, sprint planning, reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Must-Have Skills 
 Basic understanding of frontend-development concepts and responsive web design. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. Familiarity with at least one modern frontend framework such as React.js or Angular. Basic understanding of Node.js and backend development concepts. Understanding of REST APIs and client-server architecture. Familiarity with databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL at a foundational level. Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub or other version control tools. Understanding of debugging, testing, and problem-solving fundamentals. Comfort using AI-assisted developer tools for code suggestions, debugging support, documentation, learning assistance, and productivity improvement with proper human review. Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in a project environment. Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team. 
 
 Preferred Traits 
 Strong learning mindset and enthusiasm for software development. Attention to detail and commitment to code quality. Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and follow through. Curiosity to explore both frontend and backend technologies. Positive attitude toward feedback and continuous improvement. 
 
 Who Should Apply 
 Fresh graduates or final-year students in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields. Candidates with internship, academic, freelance, or personal project experience in web development. Individuals looking to build a career in full-stack or web application development.

The role combines backend development, production engineering, operational excellence, automation, and system scalability. Candidates are expected to work on systems serving millions of users and handling high-volume traffic and content processing   Key Responsibilities Design, build, enhance, and maintain large-scale backend services and distributed systems. Develop new product features and capabilities. Debug, troubleshoot, and improve production systems at scale. Drive operational excellence through automation, tooling, and process improvements. Handle production incidents and participate in on-call support. Collaborate with stakeholders to convert business requirements into executable technical solutions and sprint plans. Work across multiple technologies and platforms to improve system reliability, resiliency, and performance   Required Skills & Experience\ 4-6 years of backend engineering experience. Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale. Strong production support and debugging experience. Experience handling high-throughput systems, large datasets, and scalable architectures. Ability to design resilient systems and solve real-world engineering problems.   Must-Have Skills Distributed Computing & Distributed Systems. Java and Python development experience. Kafka, event streaming, and streaming data processing. Microservices architecture and scalable backend systems. Kubernetes and Docker ecosystem knowledge. Production support, troubleshooting, and incident management. System design, scalability, resiliency, and performance optimization. Experience building and supporting systems serving millions of users and handling large-scale workloads.   Preferred Background Engineers who have built and deployed multiple large-scale distributed applications. Experience working with content platforms, decisioning systems, or latency-sensitive applications. Exposure to large-scale inference or AI/LLM-powered systems. Experience working across multiple technologies rather than specializing in a single language. Cloud experience is beneficial but  not mandatory .   Ideal Candidate Profile 5+ years of hands-on experience in distributed systems and microservices. Strong backend engineer who can both build new features and support production systems. Comfortable with Java, Python, Kafka, databases, and backend architecture. Proven experience handling large-scale systems, high QPS traffic, and complex production issues. Strong problem solver with operational excellence and automation mindset. Adaptable engineer who can learn and work across different technologies and platforms. Bengaluru-based candidate who can attend in-person interview drives and collaborate effectively in a large-scale engineering environment   Interview process: In-person Interview L1 –  Technical + Coding Interview Focus on real-world backend engineering problems. title: React Native Developer
description:
Job Summary 
 Role: React Native Developer Location: Hyderabad only Work Mode: Hybrid (3 days) 
 
 Role overview 
 We are seeking an experienced React Native Developer with 10+ years of mobile application development experience to design, develop and maintain high-quality cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, native mobile development, application security, architecture, performance optimization and the complete mobile application lifecycle. Experience with React Natives New Architecture, native modules and AI-native development practices is highly preferred. 
 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 1.Mobile Application Development 
 Design, develop and maintain high-quality mobile applications using React Native. Build and enhance applications for both iOS and Android platforms. Ensure applications are production-ready and aligned with business and technical requirements. Work with native modules and platform-specific capabilities using Kotlin/Java and/or Swift/Objective-C. Ensure successful application builds, releases and deployments to Google Play Store and Apple App Store. 
 
 2.React Native Native Platform Development 
 Develop applications using React Native, including the New Architecture with Fabric and TurboModules. Implement state management using Redux, Zustand, MobX or similar technologies. Work with navigation frameworks and REST/GraphQL integrations. Collaborate with native platform technologies including Jetpack Compose/MVVM and SwiftUI/UIKit. Design and implement reusable, scalable and maintainable components. 
 
 3.Security Data Privacy 
 Implement secure storage and encryption using technologies such as Keychain, Keystore, encrypted AsyncStorage and MMKV. Apply secure networking practices across mobile applications. Ensure compliance with applicable data privacy and security requirements. Identify and address mobile application security vulnerabilities. Follow security best practices and familiarity with OWASP MSTG guidelines. 
 
 4.AI-Native Development 
 Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot for code generation, refactoring, debugging and testing. Effectively prompt AI agents for application scaffolding, integrations and development workflows. Review and validate AI-generated code before integration. Identify risks associated with AI-generated code, including insecure recommendations, hallucinated APIs and intellectual property concerns. Apply mandatory human review and engineering standards to AI-assisted development. 
 
 5.Architecture Design 
 Apply MVVM, Clean Architecture and common design patterns such as Factory, Adapter and Observer. Ensure consistent architectural practices across cross-platform and native code. Design scalable, maintainable and high-performing mobile application architectures. Contribute to technical decisions and architectural improvements. 
 
 6.CI/CD, Release Application Lifecycle 
 Work with Git and Azure DevOps for source control and development workflows. Implement and maintain mobile CI/CD pipelines. Work with tools such as Fastlane, App Center and Bitrise. Manage the complete mobile application lifecycle, including build, submission, deployment, monitoring and maintenance. Troubleshoot release and deployment issues across iOS and Android platforms. 
 
 7.Performance Quality 
 Perform mobile application performance profiling and optimization. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Ensure applications meet quality, stability and usability expectations. Collaborate with QA teams to support testing, debugging and release readiness. 
 
 8.UI/UX Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Work closely with UI/UX designers to deliver high-quality mobile experiences. Ensure designs are translated accurately into responsive and intuitive mobile interfaces. Collaborate effectively with product, engineering, QA and other cross-functional teams. Communicate technical decisions, challenges and progress clearly to stakeholders. 
 
 Required technical skills and competencies 
 10+ years of experience in React Native/mobile application development. Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript. Hands-on experience developing and publishing applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Strong experience with React Native and its New Architecture, including Fabric and TurboModules. Experience working with native modules using Kotlin/Java and/or Swift/Objective-C. Strong knowledge of state management frameworks such as Redux, Zustand or MobX. Experience with REST and GraphQL integrations. Strong understanding of mobile application security, encryption and secure storage. Experience with MVVM, Clean Architecture and common design patterns. Strong understanding of CI/CD for mobile applications. Experience with mobile application performance profiling and optimization. Strong understanding of the complete mobile application lifecycle. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 
 Must have skills 
 10+ years of React Native/mobile application development experience. Expert-level JavaScript/TypeScript skills. Strong React Native expertise. Experience with iOS and Android application development. Experience with native modules using Kotlin/Java and/or Swift/Objective-C. Experience with React Native New Architecture - Fabric/TurboModules. Experience with Redux/Zustand/MobX or equivalent state management. Strong knowledge of mobile application security and secure storage. Experience with REST/GraphQL. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture and design patterns. Experience with Git and CI/CD. Strong performance optimization and troubleshooting skills.

title: AWS Glue Python Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced AWS Glue Python Developer to design, develop, and support scalable cloud-based inbound and outbound file based data integration and processing solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, AWS Glue, PySpark, and serverless AWS services. Key Responsibilities Design and develop inbound and outbound file processing using AWS Glue, Python, and PySpark. Develop reusable Python modules, utilities, and frameworks for data ingestion, validation, transformation, and error handling. Support production deployments, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning. Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement CI/CD pipelines for AWS Glue jobs and related infrastructure. Prepare technical documentation, data flow diagrams, operational procedures, and support documentation. 8+ years of experience in Python development and data engineering. Strong hands-on experience with AWS Glue and PySpark. Excellent knowledge of Python programming, object-oriented programming, and exception handling. Experience designing ETL pipelines and data processing frameworks. Strong experience with Amazon S3, including bucket structures, lifecycle policies, partitioning, and file formats. Experience with Amazon EventBridge for scheduled and event-driven execution. Experience developing and deploying AWS Lambda functions using Python. Experience with Amazon SNS and SQS for notifications, messaging, and asynchronous processing. Experience with Amazon CloudWatch for logging, monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting. Understanding of AWS IAM, security policies, encryption, and least-privilege access. Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Amazon RDS. Strong knowledge of SQL and database connectivity from Python or AWS Glue. Experience working with REST/SOAP APIs and external system integrations. Understanding of JSON, XML, CSV, Excel, and fixed-width file formats. Experience with Git and software development best practices. Preferred Skills Experience with AWS Step Functions or AWS Glue Workflows. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, or AWS CodePipeline. Knowledge of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, and audit requirements.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager
Department Project Management Office (PMO) / Delivery
Reports To Delivery Manager / Head of Delivery
Experience 3+ years in project management (services / consulting environment)
Location Remote (occasional travel for client or team offsites, if required)
Employment Type Full-time
Shift Aligned to client time zones flexibility for European / North
American overlap where required
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our Project Managers set the standard for how delivery runs they own the plan, run the
governance, protect the margin, and make sure the client sees measurable return on every rupee
they spend with us.
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive Project Manager who can independently run
4–5 concurrent client projects end to end. This is a hands-on delivery role: you will run the sprint
ceremonies, own the RAID log, chase the blocker, build the dashboard, and then present the
delivery story to a client stakeholder in the same day.
The person who succeeds here brings structure to ambiguity, communicates in facts rather than
adjectives, and escalates early with a proposed solution attached. Project Mobilisation & Onboarding
Take overall responsibility for planning, coordination, execution, and completion of new client
onboarding in line with the standard onboarding playbook — delivered within the agreed
timetable and budget.
Prepare and maintain the onboarding plan, project plan, milestone schedule, resource
plan, and RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).
Run project kick-off and mobilise extended teams, including internal squads, consultants, and
third-party vendors.
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and — where applicable — technical
specifications, involving all relevant stakeholders and confirming technical feasibility before
commitment.
Establish clear entry/exit criteria, acceptance criteria, and a RACI matrix (Responsible,
Accountable, Consulted, Informed) so ownership is unambiguous from day one. Service Delivery & Day-to-Day Operations
Lead day-to-day delivery of contracted services across 4–5 accounts, ensuring quality,
productivity, and continuity across distributed teams.
Ensure every project is delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Coordinate internal resources and third-party vendors to ensure proper execution.
Manage the testing and acceptance regime — including phased and final acceptance — and
align milestone sign-offs to the agreed performance-based payment plan.
Manage ticket queues and support operations: incident and request management, triage,
prioritisation, SLA tracking, and closure.
Track project performance against short-term and long-term goals, and adjust constraints based
on financial and delivery analysis. Daily & Weekly Milestone Targets
Break every project plan down into daily and weekly milestones with named owners, due
dates, and a clear definition of "done" — no task carried without a date against it.
Set and communicate daily delivery targets for each squad at stand-up; confirm at end of day
what moved, what slipped, and what is at risk for tomorrow.
Own weekly milestone achievement across all 4–5 projects: track planned vs. actual
completion, calculate slippage, and publish a weekly milestone scorecard to Delivery leadership.
Maintain a target of 90% weekly milestone adherence per project; any milestone missed
must carry a documented reason, recovery plan, and revised date within 24 hours.
Run a short daily blocker review — anything blocking a daily target for more than one working
day is escalated the same day, not held to the weekly review.
Reconcile daily task closure and weekly milestone burn against sprint burndown so the sprint,
the plan, and the client commitment never drift apart.
Chase timesheet and effort logging daily so weekly effort-vs-plan variance is accurate before it
reaches Finance or the client.
Publish a weekly delivery summary every Friday per account: milestones achieved,
milestones missed with cause, upcoming week's targets, open risks, and open blockers.
Convert weekly misses into corrective action in the next planning cycle — repeated slippage on
the same workstream is treated as a structural problem, not a scheduling one. Agile & Scrum Execution
Run all Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and
backlog refinement.
Own and groom the product/project backlog alongside the Product Owner and client
stakeholders.
Break epics into user stories with clear acceptance criteria; ensure stories are estimated and
sprint-ready before planning.
Track and act on velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time, throughput, and defect trends
— forecast from data, not optimism.
Apply the right framework per engagement: Scrum, Kanban, Scrumban, Waterfall, or a hybrid
model, as the contract and client maturity demand.
Continuously improve workflow efficiency; ensure retrospective actions are actually
implemented, not just recorded. Tooling, Dashboards & Reporting
Configure and administer Azure DevOps and Jira — boards, workflows, custom fields, epics/
features/stories, sprints, iterations, and release plans.
Build and maintain dashboards for sprint progress, delivery health, defect trends, SLA
adherence, resource utilisation, and risk exposure — for both team-level and executive
audiences.
Produce weekly status reports (WSR), MIS reports for senior management to support
strategic decisions, governance decks, and monthly delivery reviews.
Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, communication plans, and a live
decision/action log.
Working knowledge expected across: Confluence, ServiceNow, MS Project, MS Visio, Excel
(advanced formulas, pivot tables, dashboards), PowerPoint, and BI/reporting tools such
as Power BI.
Stay current on new Excel, PowerPoint, and AI-assisted productivity tooling to keep reporting
sharp and effort low. Governance, Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Operate the engagement governance model: chair operational performance meetings, support
periodic governance committee reviews, and contribute to annual strategic reviews.
Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, and minutes within agreed timelines.
Manage escalations through defined governance tiers — with a documented owner, action,
and target date for every open item.
Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for client stakeholders on assigned accounts.
Present oral and written reports covering plans, problems, and resolutions to the appropriate
level of management.
Manage expectations proactively: flag anything that may affect timely completion the moment it
is known, never at the review. Risk, Change & Blocker Management
Proactively identify, document, and communicate risks, and propose mitigation approaches
before they become issues.
Identify roadblocks early — scope creep, technical dependencies, resource constraints, thirdparty
delays — and drive them to resolution.
Run a disciplined blocker/impediment process: log it, assign it, escalate it, close it within
agreed timelines.
Manage all changes to scope, schedule, and cost through a formal change-control process —
impact assessment, client approval, re-baselining.
Convert genuine scope expansion into commercial opportunity rather than absorbing it silently. Commercial & Resource Management
Manage project budget and resource allocation; monitor costs and track expenses to protect
delivery margin.
Support Work Orders, SOWs, and Change Requests — including scope, volumes, charges,
and applicable service levels.
Communicate resource requirements and availability ahead of need, not at the point of crisis.
Track and follow up on client invoices and receivables in coordination with Finance.
Ensure sufficient, competent staffing and team continuity across extended teams and
consultants. Quality, Security & Compliance
Ensure final deliverables meet both the agreed brief and the technical requirements.
Ensure delivery complies with contractual security requirements, data processing obligations,
supplier code of conduct, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Maintain audit-ready project documentation at all times. People & Continuous Improvement
Mentor team members on Agile practice, delivery hygiene, and stakeholder communication.
Support team building, resourcing, and retention within a distributed working model.
Continuously identify ways to improve quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of delivery in line
with engagement improvement commitments.
EXPERTISE YOU'LL BRING
Must-Have
3+ years of project management experience, ideally in an IT services, consulting, digital
agency, or managed-services environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage 4–5 concurrent projects without letting delivery quality slip
on any of them.
Hands-on proficiency with Azure DevOps and Jira — configuration and reporting, not just
usage.
Strong practical command of Agile and Scrum, backlog management, sprint execution, and
ceremony facilitation.
Working knowledge of RACI, RAID logs, change control, and structured escalation/
blocker mechanisms.
Proven discipline in setting and tracking daily and weekly milestone targets, with visible
planned-vs-actual reporting.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and incident/request management (ServiceNow or
equivalent) and time/resource management tooling.
Strong MS Office skills — Excel (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards) and PowerPoint at a clientpresentable
standard.
Excellent written and spoken English; structured, data-driven communication.
Strong attention to detail, organisational discipline, and the ability to prioritise across competing
deadlines.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Project Management, Business, or a
related discipline (Master's/MBA desirable).
Proven self-management in a remote setting — reliable connectivity, a professional working
environment, and strong async communication habits.
Certification (at least one required)
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I / II)
PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, or PRINCE2 / PRINCE2 Agile
SAFe Agilist / SAFe Scrum Master
ITIL Foundation (advantage for support and managed-services engagements)
Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer (advantage)
Good-to-Have
Exposure to SLA/KPI-based engagements and commercial constructs (SOWs, Work Orders,
Change Requests).
Experience with onshore–offshore or distributed delivery models serving European or North
American clients.
Basic understanding of databases/queries, SDLC, UI/UX principles, CMS platforms, and QA/
production environments.
Familiarity with creative delivery workflows (design, content, video) where engagements are
agency-adjacent.
Exposure to regulated environments (BFSI, healthcare, public sector) or government/publicsector
project delivery.
Commercial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, margin management, and contract awareness.
QUALITIES & CHARACTERISTICS
Ownership: a strong sense of personal responsibility for your own and the team's work — you
proactively step in to ensure quality delivery within timeframes, whatever the situation.
Composure: able to lead cross-functional teams and stay calm under tight deadlines and client
pressure.
Negotiation: comfortable holding a position with a client while keeping the relationship intact.
Curiosity: eager to learn new tools, frameworks, and techniques in project management and
delivery.
Judgement: knows what to escalate, what to absorb, and what to decide alone.
KEY SUCCESS FACTORS IN THIS ROLE
Managing multiple projects and priorities across regions and time zones simultaneously.
Balancing global delivery standards with individual client expectations.
Maintaining accuracy and predictability of forecasts while running at high volume.
Building trust with clients you will rarely, if ever, meet in person.
SUCCESS INDICATORS — FIRST 6 MONTHS
All assigned projects delivered within agreed schedule, effort, and margin variance thresholds.
90% weekly milestone adherence sustained across all assigned projects, with every miss
carrying a documented cause and recovery plan.
Daily targets and weekly scorecards published consistently without prompting from leadership.
Live, accurate dashboards available to leadership and clients without manual chasing.
Zero surprises — risks and blockers surfaced before they become escalations.
Measurable improvement in sprint predictability and velocity stability.
Clean, audit-ready documentation and a fully current RAID log across every account.
WHAT WE OFFER
100% remote working with a distributed, delivery-focused team.
Exposure to diverse clients, domains, and technology stacks — broader in a year than most
product roles give in three.
Certification sponsorship and structured learning support.
Real ownership from day one — you run your accounts, not someone else's checklist.
Note: Adjust tool names and certification preferences to match your actual delivery stack before
publishing.

 DESCRIPTION: 
 Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Lead .NET Engineer with 6-12 years of software development experience and strong expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and high-quality enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET 8, ASP.NET Core, WPF, REST API development, and Entity Framework Core , along with experience in modern build, deployment, testing, and development practices. The candidate will be responsible for developing robust .NET-based applications and services, contributing to solution design, ensuring software quality and security, supporting modern engineering practices, and providing technical leadership and mentoring to development teams.
