Develop efficient data-access layers using Entity Framework Core . Define and promote application design principles, coding standards, and software engineering best practices. Develop reusable, modular, and maintainable application components and services. Ensure applications meet requirements for quality, performance, security, reliability, and maintainability . Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex application, API, integration, and deployment-related issues. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development and secure-coding standards. Develop and maintain automated unit and integration tests using tools such as xUnit . Use Swagger and Postman for API documentation, validation, and testing. Support containerized application development and deployment using Docker . Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and manage build artifacts through JFrog Artifactory . Collaborate with developers, technical leads, product owners, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and other stakeholders. Participate in technical design discussions, solution reviews, estimation, planning, and implementation activities. Work effectively within Agile Scrum and Kanban development environments. Use collaboration and work-management platforms such as Jira and Confluence . Mentor and coach development team members and provide technical guidance where required. Support teams in solving complex technical problems without compromising system quality or security. Adapt to changing priorities and contribute across multiple projects where required. Required Technical Skills 6-12 years of overall software development experience, with significant experience in .NET application development. Strong hands-on expertise in C# and .NET 8 . Strong experience with ASP.NET Core application and service development. Experience developing desktop applications using WPF . Strong experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs . Strong experience with Entity Framework Core for application persistence and data access. Good understanding of application architecture, object-oriented programming, and reusable software design. Strong understanding of application security and secure software development practices. Experience with containerization using Docker . Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions . Experience using JFrog Artifactory for artifact management. Experience with automated testing using xUnit . Experience with API testing and documentation tools such as Swagger and Postman . Experience with source control and modern software development practices. Experience working with Jira and Confluence for work management and team collaboration. Strong understanding of Agile Scrum and Kanban methodologies. Preferred Skills Experience developing services using gRPC . Experience working with PostgreSQL . Knowledge of web development technologies including PHP, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS . Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration. Experience using Helm for Kubernetes application packaging and deployment. Familiarity with collaboration and visualization tools such as Miro . Experience working across multiple projects and adapting to changing technical and business priorities. Exposure to modern cloud-native and distributed application environments. Behavioral Competencies Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong quality mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality and secure software. Proactive and self-sufficient, with the ability to complete tasks independently without continuous assistance. Ability to identify effective solutions without compromising system quality or security. Strong willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and development practices. Strong team-player mindset and ability to work effectively within collaborative development teams. Ability to adapt quickly when switching between projects or changing priorities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. title: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes Controller & Go Systems
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Kubernetes Platform (Golang) 
 Experience: 3+ years
 Team: Platform Engineering Tuner for K8s Role Overview CloudKeeper is building a Kubernetes optimization platform that keeps clusters running lean automatically — right-sizing workloads and managing nodes without manual intervention. Two capabilities sit at its core: A recommender that analyses historical workload usage and applies corrected requests/limits automatically. Automated node management — provisioning, consolidation, and bin-packing for efficient cluster utilisation. This is a hands-on Go controller-author role: CRDs, controllers, admission/mutating webhooks, informer and reconcile loops, and a time-series layer for percentile-based sizing. You'll work in a small engineering team building distributed systems that integrate deeply with the Kubernetes control plane. The work rewards someone who is genuinely curious about how Kubernetes behaves under the hood and who writes production-grade Go. Responsibilities Workload & Node Optimization Build the workload right-sizing recommender — pull historical usage from the metrics pipeline (metrics-server / Prometheus) and compute corrected requests / limits using percentile / histogram methods. Implement safe automatic application of those corrections to live workloads — staged rollout, guardrails, and rollback so a running workload is never destabilised. Build node-side optimization — provisioning, consolidation, and bin-packing — for efficient cluster utilisation. Kubernetes Platform Engineering Design and build controllers, operators, and CRDs in Go using controller-runtime / client-go — informer caches, reconcile loops, and the object lifecycle. Integrate deeply with the Kubernetes API to observe and act on cluster state at scale. Build the backend services and APIs (REST; gRPC where an agent/control-plane split calls for it) that the platform runs on. Architecture & Scale Design for multi-cluster operation at scale. Hold platform services to a high bar for reliability, performance, and security — especially because the platform acts on live customer clusters . Participate in architecture and feature design as the platform grows. Required Skills Strong, production Go — you've shipped and operated real services in it. Deep understanding of Kubernetes internals — the controller / reconcile model, the API machinery, and the object lifecycle, not just kubectl usage. Hands-on experience building operators / controllers / CRDs (controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or Operator SDK). Comfort with metrics / time-series data — ingesting and reasoning about historical resource usage (percentiles, histograms). Strong debugging and performance-optimization instincts. Preferred Skills gRPC and API design for distributed / agent-based systems. Familiarity with VPA, Karpenter, cluster-autoscaler, or the kube-scheduler internals — a real bonus if you've read their source. Hands-on experience with admission/mutating webhooks and their failure modes. Resource scheduling, autoscaling, bin-packing, or workload-placement systems. Interest in the cost/efficiency side — requests/limits economics, bin-packing efficiency, node cost. This is a cost-optimization product at heart. Multi-cluster / multi-cloud Kubernetes. Cloud-native security practices. IaC (Terraform) and CI/CD for platform tooling. What We Look For Controller-author instincts — at home in the reconcile / informer world, not just consuming the API. Safety and correctness when acting on live workloads — thinks in blast radius, staged rollout, and rollback before features. A bias for building things that run reliably without babysitting. Curiosity about how Kubernetes actually works under the hood. Comfort in a small, fast-moving team where the platform itself is still being built. Willingness to work on-site at our Noida office. Technology Stack Languages: Go Platform: Kubernetes — controller-runtime, client-go, CRDs, admission webhooks APIs: REST; gRPC where warranted Optimization: VPA-style right-sizing, Karpenter-based node management Data: time-series / metrics (metrics-server, Prometheus) Cloud: AWS (initial focus) Qualifications B.Tech / B.E / MCA in Computer Science, IT, or a related field. 5+ years building backend or infrastructure software. Strong experience with Kubernetes-based platforms or cloud-native systems.

title: Senior Infrastructure Architect (AI Enabled Hybrid Cloud)
description:
Innova Solutions are seeking a seasoned, Senior Infrastructure Architect to define, govern, and evolve a large-scale infrastructure estate supporting more than 1,500 compute instances across distributed cloud, on-premises, and hybrid IT environments. The architect will provide end-to-end technical leadership across compute, storage, backup, networking, security, observability, automation, and resilience. The role requires deep expertise in multi-homed network design and enterprise security frameworks. Demonstrable experience in AIOps to improve operational efficiency, service reliability, automate risk management and derive predictable business outcomes. Required Qualifications 15+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure architecture, engineering, transformation and operations, including responsibility for complex enterprise environments. Proven experience architecting and governing estates of 1,500+ compute instances across data centers, public cloud, private cloud, edge and hybrid platforms. Expert-level knowledge of hypervisors, virtualization, container platforms, storage, backup and recovery, networking, identity, security, observability, and disaster recovery and business continuity. Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least two major public cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure and AWS, including landing zones, connectivity, security controls, governance and cost management. Demonstrated expertise in multi-homed networking, routing, segmentation, firewalls, load balancing, DNS, SD-WAN, zero-trust design, and secure connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments. At least 3 years of experience with AI technologies, including 2+ years applying AIOps, machine learning, or intelligent automation in production infrastructure operations. Demonstrable experience modernizing NOC, SOC, TOC, or command-center operations through event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, automated remediation and operational copilots. Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, security frameworks, regulatory controls, risk management, and architecture governance. Experience leading architecture reviews, technical due diligence, platform standards, lifecycle roadmaps, and major transformation programs. Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation and technical documentation skills. Key Responsibilities Own the target-state architecture and multi-year modernization roadmap for enterprise infrastructure across data center, cloud, edge and hybrid IT environments. Define reference architectures, guardrails, design patterns, and technology standards for compute, storage, backup, network, identity, security, monitoring, and automation. Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, exceptions, implementation plans, migration waves, and production-readiness criteria. Partner with security teams to embed zero-trust principles, privileged-access controls, segmentation, encryption, vulnerability management, and policy compliance into platform designs. Guide engineering and operations teams during major incidents, recurring problem investigations, capacity events, security events, and complex performance issues. Evaluate vendors and emerging technologies, conduct proofs of concept, support commercial evaluations, and present recommendations to senior leadership. AI, AIOps, and Intelligent Automation Responsibilities Define the AI-enabled infrastructure operations strategy, use-case portfolio, reference architecture, governance model, and adoption roadmap. Design solutions for alert noise reduction, event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive capacity management, incident summarization, probable-cause analysis, and automated remediation. Integrate telemetry from infrastructure, applications, networks, security platforms, service management tools, and cloud-native services into unified operational intelligence workflows. Develop patterns for AI-assisted NOC, SOC, and TOC operations, including human-in-the-loop approvals, escalation controls, auditability, rollback, and measurable service outcomes. Apply generative AI and retrieval-augmented generation to operational knowledge, runbooks, architecture repositories, configuration data, and incident history while protecting sensitive information. Establish responsible AI controls covering data quality, privacy, security, access, explainability, model risk, hallucination management, monitoring, and regulatory compliance. Drive closed-loop automation using orchestration platforms, infrastructure-as-code, APIs, policy-as-code, and event-driven workflows. Define and monitor AI solution performance through accuracy, precision, automation success rate, false-positive rate, time saved, avoided incidents, and business-value measures. Partner with data, AI, security, service management, and platform engineering teams to productionize models and operational agents safely. Technical Competencies Cloud and platforms: Azure, AWS, cloud landing zones, virtualization, Kubernetes, containers, platform engineering, and hybrid-cloud management. Infrastructure: Windows and Linux, x86 compute, hyperconverged infrastructure, enterprise storage, data protection, backup, replication, and recovery. Networking: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VPN, SD-WAN, load balancing, proxies, network segmentation, and cloud connectivity. Security: Zero trust, IAM, PAM, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, endpoint controls, secure configuration, and compliance frameworks. Automation: Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, CI/CD, Git-based workflows, APIs, orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and policy-as-code. Observability and operations: Metrics, logs, traces, event management, discovery, CMDB, ITSM, service mapping, SRE practices, and operational analytics. AI and data: AIOps platforms, generative AI, machine learning concepts, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, model evaluation, and responsible AI controls. Architecture methods: Enterprise architecture frameworks, capability mapping, current-state and target-state design, roadmaps, dependency analysis, architecture decision records, and total-cost modeling. Preferred Qualifications Bachelors or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related discipline. Cloud architecture certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional. Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture, networking, security, Kubernetes, service management, FinOps, or AI. Experience of AIOps based Operational insights or proactive event and incident management including event correlation, auto-ticketing and self-healing will be highly relevant. Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry, with knowledge of audit, data protection, operational resilience, and third-party risk requirements. Experience supporting merger integration, data-center exits, large-scale migrations, platform rationalization, or global infrastructure transformation.

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a good foundation in data engineering principles, a keen analytical mindset, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.  Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store large volumes of data from various sources. Implement data workflows using ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure data quality and integrity.

Integrate data from multiple sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, into a unified data platform. Manage and optimize data storage solutions, ensuring efficient data retrieval and processing.

 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / ML Engineer with strong expertise in Python, statistics, machine learning, graph analytics, anomaly detection, and large-scale data processing . The role involves building advanced AI/ML and Data Science solutions on Telecom OSS data , including network alarms, events, configuration, performance counters, topology, tickets, logs, and security-related data. You will work on solutions for network reliability, proactive fault management, service assurance, operational efficiency, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and automated decision-making . 
 Key Responsibilities Analyze high-volume telecom event streams using statistical correlation and association techniques. Apply PMI/NPMI, Jaccard, Lift, and co-occurrence analysis to identify related events and suppress redundant alerts. title: Manager SAP S/4HANA Implementation
description:
Job Title Manager SAP S/4HANA 
 Purpose of the Role 
To support the successful implementation, rollout, and stabilization of SAP S/4HANA across the organization by coordinating with business users, implementation partners, and internal teams. The role ensures business requirements are translated into SAP solutions, project milestones are achieved on time, users are trained, and post-go-live support is effectively managed. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business Process Mapping 
 Take overall ownership of the SAP application landscape and act as the primary SAP point of contact for the organization. Manage day-to-day SAP incidents, problems, service requests, enhancements, and changes. Coordinate with SAP support partners, consultants, and internal IT/business teams for timely resolution of issues. Establish priorities for SAP incidents, enhancements, and change requests based on business impact. Monitor critical SAP processes and ensure business continuity. Identify recurring issues and drive root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. Maintain an SAP issue, risk, enhancement, and change backlog. Ensure SAP changes follow appropriate governance, testing, approval, and deployment processes. Continuously identify opportunities for SAP process and system improvements. 
 2. SAP S/4HANA upgrade program 
 Lead and coordinate the end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation/upgrade program. Act as the primary SAP lead between the business, internal IT, implementation partner, and other stakeholders. Support project planning, scope definition, resource planning, timelines, dependencies, and milestones. Coordinate SAP implementation partners and ensure deliverables meet agreed requirements, quality, and timelines. Track project progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and key decisions. Prepare regular project status reports and management dashboards. Ensure appropriate governance and escalation of critical project issues. Support SAP Activate methodology and project governance throughout the implementation lifecycle. Ensure successful transition from project implementation to BAU support. 3. Functional Coordination 
 Work closely with Finance, Procurement, Sales, Manufacturing, HR, Logistics, and Plant teams. Resolve functional issues during implementation. Coordinate functional consultants and subject matter experts. Facilitate workshops, requirement discussions, solution reviews, and issue-resolution meetings. Ensure cross-module impacts are identified and managed. Provide functional leadership without necessarily requiring deep hands-on expertise in every SAP module. 
 4. Testing & Validation 
 Prepare test scenarios and test cases. Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Track defects and ensure timely resolution. Validate system functionality before Go-Live. 
 5.Data Migration & Data Quality 
 Coordinate SAP master-data and transactional-data migration activities. Work with business teams to identify data owners and data-quality requirements. Coordinate data cleansing, validation, mapping, transformation, and reconciliation. Ensure legacy SAP data is appropriately assessed for migration, archival, reporting, or data-lake requirements. Ensure data accuracy and completeness prior to S/4HANA Go-Live. Establish appropriate data validation and reconciliation controls. 
 6. Change Management & Training 
 Prepare user manuals and SOPs. Conduct end-user training sessions. Support change management initiatives. Ensure smooth user adoption of SAP S/4HANA. 
 7. Go-Live Support 
 Support Go-Live planning and execution. Monitor critical business transactions. Coordinate issue resolution with SAP consultants. Ensure business continuity during rollout. 
 8. Post Go-Live Support 
 Monitor system performance. Coordinate enhancement requests. Track incident resolution. Ensure continuous process improvement. 
 9.SAP Data Lake & Enterprise Data Integration 
 Following completion of the S/4HANA program, support and coordinate the organization's Data Lake implementation , with SAP as a key source system. Define and coordinate requirements for integrating SAP S/4HANA data with the enterprise Data Lake. Support integration of historical/legacy SAP data and new S/4HANA data. Work with Data Engineering, BI, Analytics, and IT teams to define SAP data requirements. Identify relevant SAP tables, objects, master data, transactional data, and reporting requirements. Support mapping of SAP data structures to enterprise data models. Coordinate data extraction, transformation, integration, reconciliation, and validation requirements. Ensure historical SAP data remains accessible for reporting, analytics, audit, and business requirements. Support integration of data from other enterprise applications into the Data Lake. Experience building real-time AI applications on embedded Linux systems. Familiarity with multilingual or domain-specific language processing. Reproduce and document bugs/issues with clear steps and observations. Work with AI/ML engineers and developers to investigate issues and improve product quality. Good understanding of basic AI/ML and Generative AI concepts . Basic knowledge of Python . Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent attention to detail and a testing mindset. description:
Job Summary 
 Role: Automation Engineer - Mobile QE Location: Hyderabad Work Mode: Hybrid Experience: 4 Years 
 
 Role overview 
 We are seeking a Mobile QE - Automation Engineer with strong experience in testing and automating native iOS and Android applications . The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing and executing functional and non-functional test strategies to ensure the quality and stability of mobile application releases. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Appium, TestNG, mobile automation and API testing , along with the ability to maintain and execute automation test suites across iOS and Android platforms. You will work closely with development, product and QA teams to identify quality risks, automate critical test scenarios and ensure applications meet functional, performance, usability and accessibility requirements. 
 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 1. Mobile Application Testing 
 Design and execute functional test scenarios for native iOS and Android applications . Perform end-to-end testing across different mobile application workflows. Validate application functionality across supported devices, operating systems and screen sizes. Execute regression, smoke, sanity and integration testing for mobile releases. Identify, document and track defects through resolution. Ensure application releases meet defined quality standards. 
 
 2. Mobile Automation 
 Design, develop and maintain automated test suites for iOS and Android applications. Develop mobile automation scripts using Appium . Use TestNG for test execution, organization and reporting. Identify appropriate candidates for automation and continuously expand automation coverage. Maintain reusable automation frameworks and components. Troubleshoot automation failures and improve test stability. Integrate automated tests into the overall quality and release process. 
 
 3. API and Services Testing 
 Design and execute API test scenarios for mobile backend services. Validate API requests, responses, status codes, authentication and data integrity. Perform integration testing between mobile applications and backend services. Use appropriate tools to troubleshoot API and application issues. Ensure backend services support mobile application functionality reliably. 
 
 4. iOS and Android Testing 
 Perform application testing across both iOS and Android platforms . Work with Android SDK and Xcode for application testing and troubleshooting. Analyze device-specific issues and platform-specific application behavior. Validate application behavior across different OS versions and device configurations. Collaborate with developers to reproduce and troubleshoot mobile defects. 
 
 5. Non-functional and Accessibility Testing 
 Perform relevant non-functional testing for mobile applications. Validate application usability, reliability and performance. Conduct mobile accessibility testing against applicable accessibility standards. Identify accessibility issues related to navigation, controls, labels, contrast and user interaction. Support quality improvements across different user and device scenarios. 
 
 6. Device and Environment Management 
 Execute tests across physical devices, emulators and simulators. Work with device cloud platforms for broader device and OS coverage. Configure and maintain mobile test environments. Analyze device-specific failures and determine whether issues are application, platform or environment related. Maintain appropriate test-device coverage for critical application workflows. 
 
 7. Defect Management and Quality Reporting 
 Log and manage defects using Jira or similar defect-management tools. Provide clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots and supporting evidence. Collaborate with developers and product teams to clarify expected behavior. Retest fixes and manage defects through closure. Prepare test execution and automation status reports for stakeholders. Communicate release risks, quality concerns and test results clearly. 
 
 8. Test Strategy and Continuous Improvement 
 Contribute to mobile test strategy and automation planning. Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, execution efficiency and automation reliability. Review existing automation suites and recommend improvements. Establish reusable testing practices across mobile projects. Participate in QA process improvements and engineering best-practice initiatives. 
 
 Required technical skills and competencies: 
 4+ years of experience in mobile application testing and QA automation . Strong hands-on experience testing native iOS and Android applications . Strong experience with Appium for mobile automation. Experience with TestNG and automation framework development. Experience with mobile API/service testing. Good understanding of mobile application testing methodologies. Experience with Jira or similar defect-management tools. Working knowledge of Android SDK and Xcode. Experience testing applications across multiple devices and OS versions. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Good understanding of functional and non-functional testing. Ability to design effective test scenarios and automation coverage. 
 
 Must have skills: 
 Strong Mobile Automation Testing experience. Hands-on experience with Appium . Experience testing both iOS and Android applications. Experience with TestNG . Experience with API/service testing.

title: B2B Commerce Architect
description:
Role: B2B Commerce Architect Hire Type: FTE Location: Bangalore 
 
 Role overview 
 We are seeking a B2B Commerce Architect / Senior Salesforce Technical Architect to provide technical leadership across our complex Salesforce ecosystem, with a primary focus on Salesforce B2B Commerce and CPQ / Revenue Cloud . You will be responsible for designing and delivering scalable, secure and high-performing solutions that seamlessly unify the customers journey from product discovery and configuration to quote, approval and order fulfillment. This role requires deep Salesforce platform expertise, strong architectural capabilities, strategic thinking and exceptional communication skills. 
 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 1. Solution Architecture Design (40%) 
 Lead the end-to-end architecture for large-scale, complex implementations involving Salesforce B2B Commerce and CPQ/Revenue Cloud. Design holistic solutions that create a seamless flow between commerce storefronts, product catalogs, quoting engines and backend ERP/CRM systems. Develop comprehensive Technical Architecture Documents (TAD) and Solution Design Documents (SDD) covering complex business processes such as guided selling, multi-tier pricing, approval workflows and subscription billing. Architect solutions for high-volume transactions, data synchronization and performance optimization across the integrated landscape. Evaluate and govern the selection of AppExchange packages and custom solutions. 
 
 2. B2B Commerce CPQ/Revenue Cloud Leadership (30%) 
 Provide expert guidance on B2B Commerce platform capabilities, including data models, tax/payment integrations and custom storefront development. Architect complex product and pricing models in CPQ, including multi-attribute pricing, usage-based pricing and advanced discounting structures. Design solutions for quote-to-cash processes, integrating with contract management and subscription billing systems. Define migration and growth strategies for Commerce and CPQ platforms, ensuring they scale with business needs. Serve as the technical authority on best practices for B2B Commerce and CPQ. 
 
 3. Technical Strategy Governance (20%) 
 Establish and enforce technical standards, development best practices and security protocols across the Salesforce platform. Lead technical governance forums, including architecture review boards and code review sessions. Mentor and upskill developers and solution architects on advanced Commerce and CPQ concepts. Manage the technical roadmap and drive initiatives to reduce technical debt and improve platform health. 
 
 4. Stakeholder Collaboration Integration (10%) 
 Collaborate with business stakeholders, product managers and Sales/Marketing leadership to translate complex business requirements into a coherent technical vision. Architect and oversee critical integrations with ERP systems such as SAP and Oracle, CRM and other enterprise systems using middleware such as MuleSoft and APIs. Clearly articulate technical trade-offs, solution options and architectural decisions to both technical and executive audiences. 
 
 Required technical skills and competencies: 
 8+ years of hands-on experience in the Salesforce ecosystem, with at least 3+ years as a Technical Architect or Lead Architect on complex, integrated projects. Deep, proven experience architecting and implementing Salesforce B2B Commerce solutions. Strong understanding of B2B Commerce storefront architecture, cart and checkout flows and catalog management. Expert-level knowledge of the Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud data model, including Products, Price Rules, Quote Lines and Amendments. Strong experience designing complex pricing and quoting solutions. Current Salesforce Application Architect and/or System Architect certification. Technical Architect (CTA) certification or active pursuit of CTA is a strong advantage. B2B Commerce Cloud Digital Developer and Salesforce CPQ Specialist certifications are highly desirable. Strong expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce integration patterns. Strong understanding of REST, SOAP and event-driven integrations. Strong data architecture skills, including large data volumes and complex data migration strategies. Expertise in DevOps and CI/CD processes. 
 
 Must have skills: 
 Salesforce B2B Commerce. Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud. Salesforce Technical Architecture. B2B Commerce storefront, cart, checkout and catalog management. Complex CPQ product, pricing and quoting solutions. Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC). REST, SOAP and event-driven integration patterns. Data architecture and data migration. Enterprise Salesforce architecture and governance. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 8+ years of Salesforce experience with 3+ years in a Technical Architect / Lead Architect role. Immediate joining availability. 
 
 Good to have skills: 
 MuleSoft. Boomi. SAP / Oracle integrations. Copado. Gearset. Large Data Volume (LDV) architecture. Subscription billing and contract management integrations. Salesforce CTA certification or active CTA pursuit. B2B Commerce Cloud Digital Developer certification. Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification. 
 
 Desired attributes: 
 Exceptional leadership, communication and presentation skills. Strategic thinker with the ability to see the "big picture" while managing critical technical details. Strong client-facing and negotiation skills. Proven ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization. Strong architectural decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to mentor and guide technical teams effectively.

title: Business Analyst, Marketing-1
description:
What is the Role 
 This role focuses on driving business intelligence and performance optimization across regional marketing initiatives by leveraging existing enterprise data products and reports developed by our core internal team. Rather than building new reporting infrastructure, this individual will serve as the expert user of established dashboards-analyzing results, diagnosing anomalies, and translating existing data into strategic insights. This position partners closely with regional marketing leaders to review performance and conduct ad-hoc deep-dive analyses that support marketing effectiveness, campaign ROI, and strategic decision-making. 

 What You Will Be Doing 
 Analyze global and regional marketing results using existing core dashboards and reports to identify underlying performance trends, growth drivers, and shifting data patterns. Conduct ad-hoc deep-dive analyses using established data products to independently diagnose performance anomalies, tracking down the root causes of unexpected traffic spikes or pipeline drops. Partner directly with regional marketing teams to build deep local business context, scope analytical requests, and translate standard dashboard data into actionable performance insights. Synthesize complex datasets from existing reports into clear summaries, providing regional leadership with strategic recommendations rather than just surface-level data tracking. Bridge the gap between data and strategy by proactively guiding cross-functional marketing partners on how to interpret existing dashboards to inform daily budget and campaign decisions. Act as the expert user and champion of core reporting tools, funneling regional user requirements and data gaps back to the core internal dashboard-development team. Audit regional performance metrics to ensure lead flow metrics, multi-touch attribution models, and conversion velocity data are accurately interpreted by stakeholders. Communicate performance findings and diagnostic insights clearly to stakeholders across varying levels of technical and business fluency. 

 What You Bring 
 Solid business acumen with a deep understanding of B2B marketing funnels, lead lifecycles, and pipeline mechanics. Collaborative communication style with the confidence to facilitate stakeholder meetings, ask critical probing questions, and constructively challenge business assumptions. Advanced diagnostic outlook with a proven ability to interpret patterns or anomalies in existing reports and form testable hypotheses. Proactive and self-motivated problem-solver comfortable navigating ambiguous business requests and evolving regional execution models. Data storytelling capability with a track record of translating analytical charts into simple, high-impact business narratives. 3-5 years of experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence, strategy consulting, or a highly analytical marketing operations role. Proficient in dashboard interpretation skills, with deep experience navigating and extracting insights from enterprise BI tools (such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker). Analytical skills including intermediate Excel/Google Sheets proficiency to manipulate, pivot, and model data extracted from existing reporting systems. Hands-on experience navigating data models and pulling native reports within CRMs (Salesforce preferred) and major marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred).

title: QA Manual and Automation
description:
QUALITY ASSURANCE ENGINEER MANUAL & AUTOMATION 
 Company: Ramxora Private Limited (Ramxora.AI) 
 Parent Organization: Treez Enterprise Group 
 Experience: 23 Years 
 Job Type: Full-Time 
 Work Mode: On-Site 
 Location: Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 
 Working Days: 5 Days a Week 
 About Ramxora Private Limited 
 Ramxora Private Limited (Ramxora.AI), a division ofTreez Enterprise Group, is a technology- 
 driven organization focused on building scalable software products, AI-powered applications, 
 enterprise platforms, and next-generation digital solutions. 
 Our engineering teams work across AI/ML, LLM applications, RAG systems, SaaS 
 platforms, web applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software 
 products. 
 We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer Manual & Automation who can take 
 ownership of product quality throughout the complete Software Development Life Cycle 
 (SDLC). 
 JOB SUMMARY 
 We are seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer with 23 years of experience in both Manual 
 Testing and Test Automation. 
 The candidate will be responsible for understanding requirements, preparing test strategies and 
 test cases, executing functional and non-functional testing, identifying and tracking defects, 
 performing API testing, regression testing, integration testing, and developing/maintaining 
 automated test scripts. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and should be 
 comfortable testing web applications, REST APIs, backend services, databases, AI- 
 powered applications, and production systems. 
 The candidate must be capable of working closely with Developers, Team Leads, Project 
 Managers, Product Managers, DevOps Engineers, and other QA Engineers to ensure 
 high-quality releases. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Manual Testing 
 
 
 
 • Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance 
 criteria. 
 • Prepare detailed: 
 o Test scenarios 
 o Test cases 
 o Test data 
 o Test execution reports 
 o Regression test suites 
 o Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) 
 • Perform: 
 o Functional testing 
 o Integration testing 
 o System testing 
 o Regression testing 
 o Smoke testing 
 o Sanity testing 
 o Exploratory testing 
 o Compatibility testing 
 o Usability testing 
 o End-to-end testing 
 o User acceptance testing support 
 • Validate application workflows from both technical and end-user perspectives. 
 • Identify edge cases and negative scenarios before production deployment. 
 • Verify fixes and conduct regression testing after defect resolution. 
 2. Automation Testing 
 • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts. 
 • Automate repetitive and high-value test scenarios. 
 • Maintain automation frameworks and reusable test components. 
 • Perform automated regression testing. 
 • Identify suitable test cases for automation. 
 • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines where required. 
 • Analyze automation failures and distinguish between: 
 o Application defects 
 o Environment issues 
 o Test-script failures 
 o Infrastructure issues 
 • Maintain stable and reliable automation suites. 
 Automation Tools / Technologies 
 Experience with one or more of the following is preferred: 
 • Selenium 
 • Playwright 
 • Cypress 
 • PyTest 
 
 
 
 • Robot Framework 
 • Appium 
 • Java/Python/JavaScript/TypeScript-based automation 
 • REST API automation 
 • Postman/Newman 
 3. API Testing 
 • Perform testing of REST APIs and backend services. 
 • Validate: 
 o Request parameters 
 o Response payloads 
 o HTTP status codes 
 o Headers 
 o Authentication 
 o Authorization 
 o Error handling 
 o Response time 
 o Data consistency 
 • Create positive and negative API test scenarios. 
 • Test API integrations between frontend, backend, databases, and third-party services. 
 • Use tools such as Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Newman, or equivalent tools. 
 • Automate API test cases wherever appropriate. 
 4. Web Application Testing 
 • Test responsive web applications across different browsers and devices. 
 • Validate frontend functionality and backend integrations. 
 • Test: 
 o Login/authentication 
 o User roles and permissions 
 o Forms 
 o Search and filtering 
 o Dashboards 
 o Notifications 
 o File uploads/downloads 
 o Payment/integration workflows where applicable 
 o Session management 
 o Error messages 
 o Data validation 
 • Perform cross-browser testing using Chrome, Edge, Firefox, etc. 
 5. Database Testing 
 
 
 
 • Validate data flow between frontend, backend, APIs, and databases. 
 • Write basic to intermediate SQL queries for data validation. 
 • Verify: 
 o Data insertion 
 o Data updates 
 o Data deletion 
 o Data consistency 
 o Data relationships 
 o Transaction behaviour 
 • Perform backend data validation using databases such as: 
 o MySQL 
 o PostgreSQL 
 o MongoDB 
 o Other relational/NoSQL databases as applicable. 
 6. Bug Identification & Defect Management 
 • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects. 
 • Create detailed bug reports containing: 
 o Defect summary 
 o Steps to reproduce 
 o Expected result 
 o Actual result 
 o Environment 
 o Screenshots/logs 
 o Severity 
 o Priority 
 • Work with developers to reproduce and resolve defects. 
 • Perform defect verification after fixes. 
 • Track defects through their complete lifecycle. 
 • Identify recurring defects and recommend permanent corrective actions. 
 7. Regression & Release Testing 
 • Build and maintain regression test suites for every major product release. 
 • Execute pre-release validation. 
 • Perform smoke testing on new builds. 
 • Conduct release candidate testing before production deployment. 
 • Validate critical business workflows after deployments. 
 • Support production verification and post-deployment testing. 
 • Ensure that previously working functionality is not broken by new changes. 
 8. CI/CD & DevOps Collaboration 
 
 
 
 • Work closely with DevOps engineers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD 
 pipelines. 
 • Understand basic CI/CD concepts and deployment workflows. 
 • Execute tests in development, staging, and production-like environments. 
 • Analyze build and deployment failures from a QA perspective. 
 • Validate application health following deployments. 
 • Understand basic concepts of: 
 o Git 
 o GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket 
 o Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab CI 
 o Docker 
 o Cloud environments 
 o Logs and monitoring 
 9. AI / LLM Application Testing 
 Since Ramxora works on AI-powered applications, exposure to AI/ML/LLM testing will be 
 an advantage. 
 The candidate may be involved in testing: 
 • AI-powered web applications 
 • LLM-based applications 
 • Chatbots 
 • RAG applications 
 • AI APIs 
 • Prompt-based workflows 
 • AI-generated responses 
 • Document processing systems 
 • Search and retrieval systems 
 QA activities may include: 
 • Testing prompt-response behaviour. 
 • Validating response accuracy and relevance. 
 • Testing hallucination and incorrect-response scenarios. 
 • Testing different user prompts and edge cases. 
 • Validating RAG retrieval results. 
 • Testing API failures and fallback mechanisms. 
 • Testing response consistency. 
 • Testing latency and timeout scenarios. 
 • Validating incorrect, incomplete, malicious, or unexpected user inputs. 
 10. Production & Real-Time Issue Handling 
 The candidate should be capable of handling real-world production scenarios. 
 
 
 
 Responsibilities may include: 
 • Investigating production defects. 
 • Reproducing production issues in controlled environments. 
 • Analyzing application logs and API responses. 
 • Working with developers and DevOps to identify root causes. 
 • Performing emergency validation after production fixes. 
 • Conducting regression testing following critical fixes. 
 • Preparing defect/root-cause reports where required. 
 • Recommending preventive testing to avoid recurrence. 
 11. Security & Quality Validation 
 Basic understanding of application security is preferred. 
 The candidate should be familiar with testing scenarios related to: 
 • Authentication 
 • Authorization 
 • Role-based access control 
 • Session management 
 • Input validation 
 • API security 
 • Access restrictions 
 • Data exposure 
 • Basic OWASP vulnerabilities 
 Security testing experience is an added advantage. 
 12. Test Documentation & Reporting 
 Maintain professional QA documentation including: 
 • Test plans 
 • Test cases 
 • Test scenarios 
 • Test execution reports 
 • Regression reports 
 • Defect reports 
 • RTM 
 • Automation reports 
 • Release sign-off reports 
 • QA status reports 
 Provide clear daily/weekly QA updates to Team Leads and Project Managers. 
 
 
 
 REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS 
 Mandatory / Strongly Preferred 
 • 23 years of QA/testing experience. 
 • Strong Manual Testing knowledge. 
 • Practical Automation Testing experience. 
 • Selenium / Playwright / Cypress or equivalent. 
 • API testing using Postman or equivalent. 
 • Basic SQL knowledge. 
 • Regression, Smoke, Sanity, Functional and Integration Testing. 
 • Bug tracking and defect lifecycle management. 
 • Git/version control. 
 • Understanding of SDLC and STLC. 
 • Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology. 
 • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Good to Have 
 • Python/Java/JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 • PyTest. 
 • CI/CD. 
 • Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab CI. 
 • Docker. 
 • Cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure/GCP. 
 • Performance testing using JMeter or equivalent. 
 • Security testing. 
 • Mobile application testing. 
 • AI/ML/LLM/RAG application testing. 
 TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES 
 Manual Testing: 
 Test Case Management, Regression Testing, Functional Testing, Exploratory Testing 
 Automation: 
 Selenium / Playwright / Cypress / PyTest / Appium 
 API: 
 Postman / Newman / Swagger / REST APIs 
 Database: 
 MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB / SQL

 Git / GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket 
 
 
 
 CI/CD: 
 Jenkins / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI 
 Infrastructure: 
 Docker / Basic Cloud Knowledge 
 Bug Tracking: 
 Jira / Azure DevOps / Equivalent 
 Performance: 
 JMeter / Load Testing Tools advantage 
 REAL-TIME SCENARIO EXPECTATIONS 
 The candidate should be able to independently reason through scenarios such as: 
 1. Application crashes immediately after deployment. How will you investigate? 
 2. An API works in Postman but fails from the frontend. How will you identify the 
 issue? 
 3. A developer says "it works on my machine." How will you proceed? 
 4. A critical production bug is reported by a client. What steps will you follow? 
 5. A new feature is released two hours before production deployment. How will you 
 prioritize testing? 
 6. Automation tests are failing randomly. How will you identify whether the 
 problem is with the test or application? 
 7. A login API returns HTTP 200 but the user cannot log in. What would you 
 investigate? 
 8. An AI/LLM application provides incorrect answers for certain prompts. How 
 would you test and report the issue? 
 9. A bug fixed by a developer breaks another existing feature. How would you 
 identify it? 
 10. How would you decide which manual test cases should be automated? 
 SOFT SKILLS 
 • Strong analytical and logical thinking. 
 • Excellent attention to detail. 
 • Strong communication skills. 
 • Ability to communicate technical defects clearly. 
 • Good documentation skills. 
 • Ability to work independently and within a team. 
 • Ability to handle multiple projects and priorities. 
 • Strong ownership of assigned testing activities. 
 • Willingness to learn new technologies and testing methodologies. 
 • Ability to work under tight release timelines. 
 
 
 
 EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION 
 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software 
 Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 • Equivalent practical experience in software testing may also be considered. 
 WHAT WE EXPECT FROM THE CANDIDATE 
 The candidate should not be limited to executing predefined test cases. 
 We expect the QA Engineer to think like an end user, developer, security tester, and 
 product owner, identify hidden risks, challenge requirements where necessary, and 
 proactively prevent defects from reaching production. 
 The candidate should demonstrate strong ownership from requirement analysis test

 validation production support.

title: SDET
description:
Reports To: Principal QA Lead or Sr Engineering Manager QA & Standards Location: Remote (India) | Global team Team: Reporting/BI Engineering — fully embedded About insightsoftware 
 insightsoftware is a growing, dynamic computer software company that helps businesses achieve greater levels of financial intelligence across their organization with our world-class financial reporting solutions. At insightsoftware, you will learn and grow in a fast-paced, supportive environment that will take your career to the next level. We are looking for future Insighters who can demonstrate teamwork, results orientation, a growth mindset, disciplined execution, and a winning attitude to join our growing team! Job Description As a Senior Quality Engineer embedded in the Reporting/BI Engineering team, you will be the primary quality voice for a scrum team focused on building and enhancing the financial reporting and business intelligence capabilities of the Certent Equity Management (CEM) platform for a large, strategic enterprise client engagement. You will report into the QA & Standards organization while working day-to-day within the Reporting/BI scrum team, collaborating closely with the Lead Engineer, engineers, and product management throughout the delivery lifecycle. This is not a standard application-layer QA role. The Reporting/BI test surface is dominated by SQL correctness, data accuracy, query performance, and report output fidelity — not UI workflows. You will need to think in terms of data: whether the right rows came back, whether the aggregations are correct, whether hierarchical traversal produces the right results, whether a report output matches the source data at the financial detail level. Writing SQL to validate data is not optional here — it is the primary tool for most of your testing. The right candidate takes personal ownership of quality outcomes — not just identifying problems, but partnering with engineering to drive them to resolution. “No bugs made it to production on my watch” is not a goal, it’s a standard. This is a hybrid manual and automation role. SQL-based data validation and API test coverage are the priority automation surfaces; UI automation is secondary. AI will be a core part of how you work across every aspect of quality engineering. Responsibilities: Quality Ownership & Test Execution Own the quality of the Reporting/BI team’s deliverables — from requirements review through release — ensuring nothing ships without adequate test coverage across functional, data accuracy, performance, and non-functional scenarios. Define, document, and execute test plans and test cases for new reporting features, SQL changes, BI enhancements, and bug fixes — covering report output correctness, data transformation accuracy, edge cases, regression, security, and non-functional scenarios. Identify test conditions from user stories, reporting specifications, and requirements documents — including positive, negative, boundary, hierarchical data traversal, aggregation correctness, and null handling scenarios. Execute test cases, document results, track defects, and own them through to resolution — partnering with engineers and product management to ensure nothing falls through the cracks. Identifying a problem is the beginning, not the end. Participate actively in sprint ceremonies — planning, refinement, standups, demos, and retrospectives — as the quality voice of the team. Collaborate with the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager — QA & Standards to maintain consistent quality standards across scrum teams. SQL & Data Accuracy Validation Write Oracle SQL and PL/SQL queries to validate report output against source data — verifying row counts, field-level accuracy, aggregation correctness, financial calculations, and referential integrity. This is the primary testing tool for this team. Design and execute data accuracy test strategies for complex, non-flattened hierarchical data models — validating that reporting queries traverse hierarchies correctly and produce accurate results across all nodes and rollup levels. Validate SQL and PL/SQL changes — stored procedures, packages, views, and query modifications — ensuring correctness, expected performance characteristics, and no unintended side effects on existing report output. Identify and document data discrepancies clearly — providing engineers with precise SQL evidence that isolates where in the data pipeline a calculation or transformation is producing incorrect results. Validate query performance benchmarks as part of definition of done — confirming that new or modified queries meet the team’s performance standards and do not introduce regression in report responsiveness. Reporting & BI Output Testing Test end-to-end report output fidelity — validating that what is displayed in a report or BI dashboard accurately reflects the underlying data, with correct formatting, correct totals, correct filtering behavior, and correct drill-down results. Validate Logi Analytics (Logi Symphony) report and dashboard implementations — testing report rendering, parameter handling, data binding, conditional logic, and export output against expected data. Test report configuration and parameterization — verifying that user-selectable filters, date ranges, grouping options, and report variants produce correct, consistent results across all input combinations. Validate financial report output for accuracy and auditability — understanding that errors in financial reporting output for a regulated enterprise client carry compliance implications, and treating data correctness accordingly. Test report performance — validating that reports load within acceptable thresholds under representative data volumes, and flagging regressions in report responsiveness for investigation. AI-Augmented Testing Leverage AI tooling to generate test plans, test cases, edge cases, positive and negative scenarios, end-to-end scenarios, security scenarios, and test data sets — expanding coverage and accelerating test authoring. Use AI tooling to accelerate the authoring of SQL validation queries, data comparison scripts, and report output test cases. Continuously improve your use of AI tooling to raise the quality bar — using AI not just to work faster but to test more thoroughly than manual effort alone could achieve. Stay current on emerging AI tooling relevant to QA — test generation, intelligent triage, data synthesis — and bring forward-looking recommendations to the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager — QA & Standards. Automation Development & Maintenance Write and maintain automated test suites for the features and SQL changes you test — owning automation as an extension of your manual testing work. Prioritize SQL-based data validation automation and API test coverage as the primary automation surfaces for this team; UI automation is secondary. Make informed decisions on what to automate vs. what to test manually — balancing coverage value, maintenance cost, and delivery velocity. Contribute to the shared automation framework and test infrastructure alongside peer QA Engineers — including SQL assertion patterns, API test coverage, and CI/CD pipeline integration via Azure DevOps. Execute automated tests within CI/CD pipelines; triage failures to distinguish genuine defects from environmental noise. Continuously improve automation coverage, reliability, and triage efficiency within the Reporting/BI team. Security Testing Incorporate security testing into your standard test approach — including input validation, authentication and authorization boundary testing, data exposure risks, and injection vulnerabilities in report parameters and API inputs. Partner with engineers to identify security-sensitive areas of new reporting features and ensure appropriate security test coverage is included in test plans. Leverage AI tooling to generate security-focused test scenarios and edge cases that manual analysis alone might miss. Escalate identified security risks clearly and promptly to the scrum team, Principal QA Lead, and Sr Engineering Manager — QA & Standards. Collaboration & Communication Partner closely with the Lead Engineer and peer engineers to understand reporting implementations, SQL changes, and data model updates — flagging quality risks early and influencing design decisions that affect testability. Collaborate with the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager — QA & Standards on test strategy, coverage standards, and process improvements. Communicate defect status, test progress, data accuracy findings, and quality risks clearly to the scrum team and QA leadership. Support junior QA Engineers through peer review, knowledge sharing on SQL-based data validation techniques, and mentorship. Interface with client stakeholders as needed under the direction of the Lead Engineer — reporting issue clarification and defect evidence documentation. 
 Required: 6+ years of software quality engineering experience in enterprise SaaS environments. Demonstrated ownership mindset — a track record of driving defects to resolution rather than just logging them, and taking personal accountability for the quality of everything your team ships. Hands-on experience writing SQL to validate data accuracy at the database layer — row counts, field-level correctness, aggregation logic, and relational integrity. This is the primary required skill for this role; Oracle experience strongly preferred. Experience testing reporting or BI systems — validating report output fidelity, data transformation correctness, or analytical query results against source data. Strong manual testing expertise — ability to independently define test strategy, write thorough test plans and test cases, and execute across functional, data accuracy, and non-functional scenarios. Demonstrated experience using AI tooling to augment test authoring — test plan generation, test case generation, edge case identification, security scenario generation, or test data synthesis. Proficiency in C# and hands-on experience with .NET test frameworks (NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest) — proven ability to build and maintain automated test suites. Experience with security testing concepts and tooling — input validation, auth boundary testing, injection vulnerabilities, and familiarity with OWASP, Burp Suite, or similar. Experience with defect tracking and test management tooling — JIRA and Xray specifically, including test tagging, execution tracking, and result publishing. Experience working as an embedded QA engineer within agile/scrum teams — participating in sprint ceremonies and contributing to team delivery cadence. Experience working in global, distributed teams across multiple time zones. Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to write clear defect reports with SQL evidence, test documentation, and data accuracy findings. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience. Preferred Background in financial reporting, equity compensation, financial services, or adjacent regulated domains where report output accuracy and auditability are critical — strongly preferred. Direct hands-on experience with Logi Analytics (now Logi Symphony) or comparable enterprise BI/embedded analytics platforms — this is a significant differentiator. Deep Oracle SQL and PL/SQL proficiency — stored procedures, packages, views, execution plan analysis, and query performance tuning — at a level sufficient to independently investigate data discrepancies in complex relational data models. Experience validating hierarchical or tree-structured data models — understanding how non-flattened parent/child relationships affect aggregation, rollup, and drill-down correctness in reports. Familiarity with BI tooling beyond Logi — Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar — with the ability to validate report output and data binding against source data. Experience with Oracle read-optimization patterns — materialized views, result cache, analytical functions — sufficient to understand the performance implications of query changes under test. Familiarity with observability and logging platforms — particularly Datadog — to diagnose failing test cases by correlating test execution failures with application logs, traces, and error events. Familiarity with Azure DevOps Pipelines for test execution, environment management, and CI/CD integration. Familiarity with Azure cloud data services relevant to reporting — Azure SQL, Azure Analysis Services, or similar. Familiarity with modern test automation tooling — Playwright, Cypress, k6, SpecFlow, or similar.

ng-non-bindable> Description Xperi invents, develops and delivers technologies that create extraordinary experiences at home and on the go for millions of people around the world. Powering billions of consumer electronics, connected cars and digital content titles, we make entertainment more immersive, driving more intelligent and every interaction seamlessly personalized through our renowned consumer brands: DTS , HD Radio , and TiVo . Xperi (NYSE: XPER) is a publicly traded technology company headquartered in San Jose, CA with over 1800 employees across North America, Europe and Asia. Come join a thriving team where you can play an integral role in shaping the future of entertainment technology. The All In Media team at Xperi provides solutions to radio stations across the world. These include broadcast systems, mobile apps, integrations with Sonos, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and digital ad monetization solutions. Our studio broadcast system, Rapid, has recently won the NAB Product of the Year award, and is used to by hundreds of radio stations across the world. We have released over 500 apps, and dominate the UK, Irish Australian markets. We work with several major radio groups across the world, including the ABC, BBC, Bauer, Global Radio, Cumulus, MediaCo, New York Public Radio, Nova Entertainment, and SBS. About the role: Join a team that is dedicated to support and create the world class Network environment which is highly available and resilient. As Senior Network Engineer you ll play a role to support company wide network environments as part of Global IT team. Enjoy the opportunity to draw on your passion for problem-solving and simplifying tasks, as well as your technical skill set to make important contributions to the environment. You will be working very closely with other global team members to support the enterprise network and come up with world class network for our employees. This role independently supports the global design, implementation, and maintenance of private and public network infrastructure. Provides guidance and expertise to management and users on topics surrounding strategy and best practices. Solves complex problems and takes a new perspective on existing solutions. Exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Advanced individual contributor who works on highly complex problems, tasks, or projects. What you will get to do: Coordinates maintenance and upgrade of networks, including servers, routers, switches, firewalls, remote access systems, and network management systems. Accountable for appropriate monitoring of network connectivity and ensures high quality data transmission. Provides technical support to various departments and users with regards to LAN/MAN/WAN (local/metropolitan/wide area networks) and cloud-based networks. Serve as a liaison with network engineers, vendors, and other third-party providers in network operation and project activities. Participates in capacity planning, disaster recovery planning, and disaster recovery testing. Provides regular status, operational, incident, and change reports. Experience with Cloud computing platforms. (AWS) Who we are looking for: Must have: Expertise in Next generation Firewall Setup and Configuration In-depth knowledge on routing protocols TCP/IP, LACP, LLDP, VXLAN, BFD, OSPF, BGP, IPSEC Working experience with routing protocols, VPN encryption Technologies, modern switching platforms and firewalls including policy implementation. Expert in the configuration, design and management of network equipment including switches, routers, load balancers, and firewalls. Experience working with hardware platforms Juniper, and Cisco must. Advanced oral and written communication skills demonstrating ability to share and impart knowledge. 7+ years of experience in Enterprise and Data center Networking Nice to have: Working knowledge in SDWAN Experience with managing redundant data circuits DIA, SDWAN, Amazon Dx, Hands-on experience using monitoring tools, automation tools (Python, Terraform, Github) etc. Experience working with AWS, Azure and GCP networking. Experience in AI tools and technologies. What will make you successful: The ability to propose, design and develop solutions that scale Keen troubleshooting skills and bring back the business to normal state Excellent written and oral communication skills Good problem-solving skills Life @ Xperi: At Xperi, we value People, Customers, Performance and Innovation. We are dedicated to creating a workplace where all employees have a voice and sense of belonging, feel safe and valued, and are acknowledged for how their unique differences contribute to organizational culture and business outcomes. Our employees and their families are important to us, and our comprehensive pay, stock and benefits programs reflect that. Xperi supports personal well-being, builds financial security and enables employees to share our collective success. Rewards include: Competitive compensation (salary, equity and bonuses) and comprehensive benefits designed to foster work-life balance, care for your health, protect your finances and help you save and invest for the future. Generous paid time away from work, including flexible time off, holidays and sick time, health and wellness initiatives, and a charitable match program to help you give back to your community. Great perks, which vary by location and can be site-specific: employee discounts, transportation reimbursements, subsidized cafes and fitness facilities. A flexible, hybrid work environment combining the best of in-office collaboration and community-building along with the benefits of working from home.

title: Assistant Manager/Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform)
description:
Job Description: Assistant Manager/Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform) 
 Function: Supply Chain / Procurement - GBS Position location: Mumbai/Navi Mumbai
 
 Purpose of the Job The Assistant Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform) coordinates day-to-day Food Platform Administration activities and ensures accurate, timely and compliant execution of defined system transactions supporting the Australian Food Platform.
The role executes and coordinates master data administration, purchase order generation, system administration, documentation and reporting within Microsoft Dynamics AX and future Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. It ensures activities are completed in accordance with approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
The position supports operational coordination between GBS Administration and the Australian Food Platform. It does not make operational, culinary, commercial or client decisions. Any activity outside documented procedures must be escalated to the Manager and the Australian Food Platform for direction.
 
 
 Context and Main Issues - The GBS Food Platform Administration team provides structured transactional support to the Australian Food Platform through approved systems and documented procedures. Accuracy of master data, ordering outputs and system transactions is essential to reliable purchasing, inventory planning and Food Platform operations. The role operates in a highly controlled environment where compliance with SOPs, work instructions, SLAs, quality checks and audit requirements is mandatory. The jobholder must coordinate assigned transactional activities, maintain service performance and support effective communication between GBS Administration and Australia. Operational, culinary, commercial and client decisions remain with the Australian Food Platform; exceptions or unclear instructions must be escalated promptly. The role is expected to support standardization, process improvement, system changes and automation while preserving governance, data integrity and documented approval controls. 
 
 Key Responsibilities & Assignments -Service Delivery Coordination 
 Coordinate assigned Food Platform Administration activities to achieve agreed quality, productivity and SLA targets. Monitor daily work queues, priorities and completion status; provide first-level troubleshooting and escalate unresolved issues to the Manager. Work effectively with Australian stakeholders and the Manager to resolve operational issues and implement approved changes. 
 Purchase Order Generation 
 Oversee preparation of purchase requisition requests, future costing orders, recalculation orders and defrost orders in line with approved SOPs. Ensure purchase order files are exported, renamed and retained in accordance with naming conventions and audit requirements. Ensure order templates are created only when instructed, outputs are validated before release, and system errors are escalated immediately. 
 Master Data Administration 
 Ensure accurate creation and maintenance of approved ING and REC master data, including mandatory fields, nutritional information, preparation yields, cooking yields and REC attributes. Oversee approved ING-to-IT linking, item relationship validation and unit conversion creation and maintenance. Maintain version control and system accuracy. No master data change may be made without documented approval from the Australian Food Platform. 
 Data Quality Assurance 
 Apply documented quality checks, validate mandatory fields and complete required validation checklists. Identify and correct data-entry errors, maintain data integrity and audit history, and escalate missing, conflicting or inconsistent information. 
 System Administration Support 
 Oversee routine administration of Food Platform systems, including active trade agreement records, approved system updates and scheduled tasks. Maintain system documentation, follow release procedures and escalate technical issues through the approved support channels. 
 Documentation Management 
 Maintain controlled templates, electronic filing structures and document version control. Archive superseded documents and ensure records comply with approved document-control procedures. 
 Reporting 
 Prepare and distribute approved operational reports to nominated stakeholders within agreed timelines. Validate report completeness and accuracy, and escalate anomalies identified during reporting. 
 Process Compliance & Risk Control 
 Ensure all activities follow approved SOPs, work instructions, quality-management requirements and service levels. Record exceptions, maintain evidence of completed controls and escalate activities that fall outside documented procedures. 
 Continuous Improvement 
 Identify repetitive administrative issues and recommend improvements to documented procedures. Participate in process reviews and User Acceptance Testing, and support implementation of approved process, system and automation improvements. 
 
 Accountabilities -Service Delivery Excellence: 
 Consistent achievement of agreed SLAs, quality, productivity and stakeholder service expectations. 
 Master Data Accuracy & Integrity: 
 Accurate, current and controlled Food Platform master data supported by documented approvals and complete audit history. 
 Order Output Reliability: 
 Timely and accurate generation and validation of purchase order outputs with prompt escalation of errors and exceptions. 
 Process Compliance & Risk Management: 
 Full adherence to approved procedures, quality controls, document-control requirements and escalation protocols. 
 Operational Capability: 
 Reliable execution of assigned activities, effective workload coordination and continued development of role-specific operational capability. 
 Stakeholder Partnership: 
 Professional and transparent coordination with Australian Food Platform stakeholders, supported by disciplined follow-through and clear escalation. 
 Continuous Improvement: 
 Practical improvements that strengthen efficiency, standardisation, control and user experience without compromising governance. 
 
 Experience & Qualifications -Qualifications 
 Graduate in any discipline. A postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations or Business Administration is advantageous. 
 Experience - Essential 
 Demonstrated experience in transactional administration, supply operations, procurement operations or master data activities. Experience working within structured administrative processes and managing delivery against defined procedures, quality measures and service levels. Experience maintaining electronic master data and working within enterprise business systems. Experience using Microsoft Excel for data validation, analysis and operational reporting. Experience coordinating stakeholders, escalations, work priorities and service delivery. 
 Experience - Desirable 
 Experience using Microsoft Dynamics AX or another ERP platform. Experience supporting purchasing, inventory, food platform, hospitality or supply operations processes. Experience working within Shared Services, Global Business Services or a multinational environment. Exposure to process improvement, system testing, transition or change-management initiatives. 
 Technical / Hard Skills 
 Working knowledge of master data administration, purchase order processing, data-quality controls and audit requirements. Ability to interpret and consistently apply SOPs, work instructions, approval matrices and service-level requirements. Competence in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Teams, Word and SharePoint. Strong reporting, documentation, data-validation and issue-management capability. Ability to identify exceptions, assess operational impact and escalate through the appropriate governance channel. 
 Behavioral / Soft Skills 
 Strong coordination, collaboration and peer-support capability. Excellent communication, stakeholder-management and interpersonal skills. Confident and professional engagement with country and overseas stakeholders. High ownership, attention to detail and accountability for service quality and data accuracy. Ability to work independently within defined procedures, manage competing priorities and escalate ambiguity appropriately. Structured thinking, sound problem-solving ability and a continuous-improvement mindset. Collaborative, culturally sensitive and constructive approach, including the ability to challenge existing ways of working professionally. Strong time management and the ability to sustain accuracy across repetitive, high-volume transactional work.
