title: Lead Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
Job Summary 
 Role: Lead Product Designer. Experience: 6+ years. Location: Navi Mumbai. Work Mode: On-site. Employment Type: Full-time. Were looking for a Lead Product Designer who can stay hands-on while raising how design works across the team. Youll own product and UX/UI direction on complex, multi-platform projects end to end, from problem framing through polished delivery, while reviewing and mentoring other designers so the whole team ships faster and with more confidence. Youll also own a piece of our design infrastructure, whether thats the design system, documentation standards, or critique culture, and youll be the person clients and internal stakeholders trust to explain the "why" behind a decision. AI sits inside how you work day to day: youll use it to accelerate research, critique, and design operations, and youll help other designers do the same without cutting corners on quality. 
 
 What You Will Own 
 Lead product and UX/UI work from problem framing through delivery on complex projects, translating user, business, and client needs into flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces across web and mobile. Review, mentor, and unblock other designers, running critiques that raise team quality, confidence, and speed rather than just catching errors. Own or improve a system-level asset, such as the design system, documentation, QA standards, file hygiene, or a recurring design ritual, and be accountable for it getting measurably better. Use feedback, research inputs, and usability thinking to pressure-test design decisions before they ship. Present work to clients and internal stakeholders with clarity and a strong rationale, including when the recommendation is unpopular. Run first-pass research synthesis and heuristic audits with AI, then validate the output against real transcripts and sessions before it shapes a design decision. Use AI to accelerate documentation and critique prep, drafting design-system notes, rationale write-ups, and review agendas so more of the teams time goes to the actual design conversation. Balance multiple live projects and designers questions without becoming the bottleneck for either. 
 
 How AI Shows Up in This Role 
 Synthesizing first-pass themes from user research transcripts and support tickets before validating them against the raw sessions. Running a first-pass heuristic or UX audit on a flow, then using it as a starting point for your own review, not a substitute for it. Generating rapid wireframe and flow variants to explore a problem space before committing a direction to high fidelity. Drafting design-system documentation, component rationale, and handoff notes so engineering gets clearer specs faster. Building critique prompts and review checklists that other designers can reuse, turning a one-off AI trick into a team habit. 
 
 What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days 
 You independently own design direction on live projects without needing constant rescue. Other designers are visibly using your feedback, structure, or standards to work faster and with more confidence. One part of the design system, documentation, or QA workflow is noticeably stronger because of a contribution you made. Your design files, handoff clarity, and documentation make collaboration smoother across design, product, and engineering. Clients and stakeholders trust your communication and the rationale behind your calls. Youve demonstrated at least one repeatable AI-assisted workflow that improves speed without reducing design quality, and can show a teammate how to run it. 
 
 Who You Are 
 Youd rather fix the root cause than patch the symptom. You give feedback people can actually act on. You stay calm and clear when a client pushes back. You notice when a process is quietly wasting everyones time.

Founded in 2000, the firm is headquartered out of New Delhi and delves into both design and turnkey projects. Since its inception, VYOM has worked on diverse projects ranging from corporate offices, institutions, industrial, hospitality, and residential buildings to Master Plan of corporate setups and Design of Townships. VYOM has all the competencies and in-house resources such as mechanical, electrical, P.H.E, B.E.M, etc. to develop & deliver a project from conceptualization to completion. We are able to ensure quality and control costs benefits that we pass on to our clients because of the integrated approach. About the Role We are looking for an experienced and presentable Architect cum Coordinator with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience to join our team in Delhi. The ideal candidate should have a strong architectural background combined with excellent communication, coordination, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills . The candidate will be responsible for coordinating project-related matters and representing the organization in meetings with government officials, clients, consultants, and other key stakeholders . This is a client-facing coordination role and requires someone who is confident, professional, well-spoken, and capable of effectively communicating project progress and technical information. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with government departments, government officials, clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders on project-related matters. Attend meetings with government officials and authorities and represent the organization professionally. Prepare and deliver project updates, presentations, progress reports, and status updates during meetings. Clearly communicate project progress, key milestones, issues, requirements, and timelines to government officials and stakeholders. Follow up with relevant departments and authorities on approvals, submissions, documentation, and project-related requirements. Track project progress and ensure that important actions and commitments discussed during meetings are followed through. Prepare meeting agendas, minutes of meetings (MoMs), presentations, and follow-up action trackers. Review architectural drawings and project documentation to understand project requirements and provide appropriate technical inputs during coordination meetings. Liaise with consultants and project teams to resolve coordination issues and ensure smooth project execution. Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and ensure timely responses to project-related queries. Assist senior management in preparing project presentations, reports, and documentation for government/client meetings. Conduct site visits when required to understand project progress and coordinate with the site/project team. Maintain proper records of meetings, submissions, approvals, correspondence, and project updates. Ensure professional representation of the company during external meetings and stakeholder interactions. Required Qualifications & Experience B.Arch. (Bachelor of Architecture) from a recognized institution Mandatory. Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience . Strong experience in architectural/project coordination . Experience dealing with government departments/officials, authorities, clients, or institutional stakeholders will be highly preferred. Strong understanding of architectural drawings, construction processes, and project documentation. Candidates should be Delhi/NCR based . Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills . Strong presentation and interpersonal skills. Confident and professional personality. Ability to independently attend and conduct meetings with government officials and senior stakeholders . Strong coordination and follow-up skills. Ability to explain technical/project information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Good knowledge of MS Office – Word, Excel and PowerPoint . Ability to prepare professional presentations and project status reports. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and follow up on several project-related matters simultaneously. Professional appearance and excellent professional etiquette. Preferred Experience Candidates with experience in: Government / PSU projects Public infrastructure projects Institutional projects Large-scale commercial or residential projects Architectural consultancy Project management consultancy Coordination with government authorities and statutory bodies will be preferred. Key Competencies Architecture | Project Coordination | Government Liaison | Stakeholder Management | Communication | Presentation | Project Reporting | Meeting Management | Documentation | Follow-up | Client Coordination Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate should be a mature, confident and highly presentable Architect who can independently represent the organization in meetings with government officials and senior stakeholders. Only female candidates based in Delhi/NCR with a B.Arch. qualification and minimum 10 years of relevant experience will be considered. description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. At Greenlight, were here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. Thats why we get out of bed every morning. 
 We are seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to join our growing security team. This role will be critical in ensuring the security of our products across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) and provide support on different security initiatives. You will work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed security best practices from design through to deployment. You will play a critical role in shaping our security posture, embedding security into our development lifecycle, and protecting our customers data. Technologies we use: Backend: Node.js, Kotlin, Java, Go Frontend: React, Redux, Swift, Kotlin REST, gRPC, graphQL AWS MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis Kubernetes, Ambassador, Helm, Rancher What you will be doing: Support in executing a comprehensive product security strategy that aligns with the companys goals and risk appetite. You will work hands on across code, infrastructure, and CI/CD to create agents, services and pipelines that detect, prevent and remediate risks leveraging AI where it adds value. Design, build and operate security automation for the SDLC (code scanning, dependency risk management, secrets detection, policy-as-code) integrated into CI/CD. Perform Manual Design and Implementation Reviews of Greenlight products and services from a security perspective. Establish and enforce secure development standards (i.e. API security, Security patterns, IaC, etc.) and best practices across the organization. Serve as SME on the practical security of our AI and LLM ecosystem. Lead threat modeling exercises for novel AI systems applying advanced security and privacy best practices. Leverage automations and tools to continuously test, fuzz and validate products and platform components for security issues. Perform Penetration testing and retesting to validate fixes. Responsible for triaging findings from security researchers and leading incident response for PSIRT. OnCall support for incident response and lead product-related security events and vulnerabilities. Partner with engineering, product, and platform teams to embed security by design patterns, drive threat modeling and land pragmatic guardrails that unblock developers. Provide guidance and education to developers that help prevent the authoring of vulnerabilities. Partner closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to prioritize and remediate security vulnerabilities in a timely and efficient manner. Develop and maintain software supply chain protections including SBOM generation/verification, artifact signing/attestation, and provenance enforcement. Build automation for static and dynamic analysis and frameworks that enable Greenlight to scale consistently across all our products. Use data and telemetry to measure control effectiveness, build dashboards and alerts that turn signals into action. Document runbacks and API, mentor engineers and champion secure engineering practices. Foster a culture of security awareness and ownership across the Engineering and Product organizations. Stay current with the latest security threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices to continuously evolve our security controls and processes. What you should bring 5+ years of experience finding security vulnerabilities, security code reviews and knowledge of secure code development for the technology stack at Greenlight. 2-4 years experience with the threat modeling process and ability to find design problems based on technical architecture and data flow diagrams. Experience with exploiting common security vulnerabilities Deep technical knowledge of web and mobile application security, common vulnerabilities, secure coding practices, common exploit mitigations and secure architecture patterns. Experience integrating or building AI-powered tools to assist with vulnerability detection, code review or threat modeling. Experience creating software that enables security processes especially those leveraging AI/ML for automation or augmentation. End to end experience on implementing and managing tools for Product Security (i.e. API Security, Mobile Protection, SAST, runtime scanning, etc.) Experience with software development and automation that enables security processes. Deep technical knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and relevant tools for web and mobile applications. Hands-on experience with security tools for SAST, DAST, IAST, and penetration testing. Fuzzing skills are good to have. Skilled in scripting, automation and exploit writing. Strong understanding of cloud security principles in AWS environments. Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong product sense for rapid iteration and refinement based on data, combined with a collaborative mindset to work closely with engineers, product managers, and security analysts in a fast-paced environment. Nice to have: Strong at abstraction turning bespoke engagements into reusable patterns and reference implementation. Security assessment of IoT hardware/firmware Contribution to security community including public research, bug bounty, presentations, blogs, etc Experience at Fintech or similar regulated companies Startup Agility and stay curious mindset Who we are: It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. About Alation Alation is the creator of AIOS - the intelligence operating system for enterprises that cannot afford to get AI wrong. When software breaks, it throws an error. When an AI agent breaks, it produces a confident, wrong answer - and most organizations have no system to catch it before that answer drives a decision. AIOS keeps data, context, and agents in sync in one open, governed, self-improving system, so every decision an agent makes holds up. Having pioneered the data catalog market, Alation is trusted by over 600 enterprises worldwide - including 40% of the Fortune 500 - to power their most critical data and AI initiatives. The problems we tackle are complex, high-impact, and deeply technical. This is not a slow-moving environment. We build fast, ship real things, learn from customers, and iterate relentlessly. About the Role AIOS doesnt work without connectivity. Agents fail when bad data reaches them, when context is stale, or when the environment shifts underneath them - and the defense against all three starts with rich, current metadata flowing in from the systems where enterprise data actually lives. Connectors are how AIOS sees the enterprise. Thats this teams job, and its getting harder and more interesting as the data and AI landscape shifts under everyones feet. Were looking for a Senior Product Manager to own this problem end to end . Youll inherit a portfolio of 80+ integrations spanning the modern and legacy data stack, and a mandate to define what connectivity means in an agentic world - new systems, new types of sources (including the agents and AI tools that are themselves becoming metadata sources), new extraction techniques, and AI applied wherever it genuinely moves the needle. Overview:   TekWissen is a global workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world. The below client is a global company with shared ideals and a deep sense of family. From our earliest days as a pioneer of modern transportation, we have sought to make the world a better place one that benefits lives, communities and the planet 
 Job Title: Software Product Management Senior Specialist Location: Chennai Work Type: Hybrid (4 Days work From Office) 
 Position Description: The Timekeeping Modernization Product Group delivers and supports critical systems for managing time, absence, and workforce management functions essential for paying the client's hourly and salaried employees. The objective is to modernize these systems, reduce technology complexity, and simplify business processes. In this role, you'll serve as the Jira subject-matter expert and delivery support specialist for the Timekeeping Modernization Program, working with Product Management leadership to support implementation of Workforce Software (WFS). You'll maintain the program's Jira environment — dashboards, boards, and workflows giving leadership real-time visibility into status, risk, and deadlines — bridging complex labor requirements and technical payroll capabilities. You'll use advanced Jira administration skills (plus SharePoint, MS Teams, Microsoft 365) to track scope, risks, and issues, focusing on due date tracking, follow-up, and escalation support. Strong attention to detail is needed to synthesize complex information into dashboard-ready updates while supporting strategic planning and stakeholder alignment. Key Responsibilities: Jira Administration, Dashboards & Deadline Management Support configuration and improvement of Jira projects, boards, workflows, and custom fields. Build executive- and team-level dashboards, filters, and reports for status, due dates, and at-risk deliverables. Maintain deadline tracking across epics, stories, and tasks, identifying slippage risk proactively. Support escalation workflows, routing at-risk deadlines through governance channels (L1/L2/L3). Configure automation rules (SLA reminders, due-date notifications, auto-escalation). Maintain traceability between epics/sagas and stories/tasks with clear owners, due dates, and status. Release Planning & Program Execution Coordinate deliverables supporting timely delivery of WFS configuration. Support delivery planning, including risk, issue, and change management tracked through Jira. Develop project/release plans outlining scope, timing, and ownership. Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure data flow between WFS, HRIS, and Payroll, including cutover plans. Provide Gantt charts, burndowns, and timeline visualizations for governance use. Participate in daily stand-ups using Jira as the source of truth. Follow change control protocol for upgrades and configuration shifts. Communication Assign actions, owners, and due dates on cross-project dependencies (vendor management, integrations, data migration), escalating proactively when at risk. Build relationships with stakeholders and Business Owners to ensure plans and deadlines are understood and resolved. Strategic Support & Product Management Partner with Product Management leadership to translate strategic objectives into Jira-tracked plans and support solution validation. Support communication of product vision, strategy, and roadmaps. Collaborate with Product Managers to define OKRs aligned with business goals. Help prioritize and manage the product backlog across WFS, HRIS, and Payroll. Facilitate discussions translating strategic ideas into measurable requirements. Continuous Improvement Support best practices in Jira administration, improving dashboards, workflows, and reporting. Support Agile methodologies for sprint and release execution. Assist in Agile ceremony artifact creation within Jira. Participate in roadmap discussions and requirements prioritization. Support prioritization of deliverables in the Jira backlog. Validate that sagas/epics are broken into clear, testable stories or tasks with accurate due dates. Skills Required: IT Support, Business Process Analysis, Business Transformation, Business Strategy, Data Analysis, IT Strategy, Business Requirements, Business Process Support, Business Analysis, Business Process Improvement, IT Solutions, Business Analytics, Program Manage PM's & Projects, Project Management, Jira, Release Management Experience Required: Senior Specialist Exp.: 8+ years as Product/Delivery Mgr Experience Preferred: Direct experience or certification with WorkForce Software (WFS) (e.g., PT101, PT102) or other timekeeping systems. Background in automotive, logistics, or high-volume industrial environments. Education Required: Bachelor's Degree Education Preferred: Master's Degree TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.

title: Transition Manager
description:
1. ROLE PURPOSE The TMO SME is accountable for the end-to-end planning, governance, and execution of vendor transitions across Global IT contracts, beginning with the AMS portfolio overseeing knowledge transfer (KT), structured readiness testing (SRT), cutover, hypercare and adoption — ensuring transitions are delivered on time, on budget and with minimal disruption to business operations. The role serves as the primary escalation point between business/function stakeholders and the extended TMO team, driving consistent execution of transition strategy and governance across all active waves, and ensuring a sustainable, well-governed handover into steady-state operations. 1.1 Enterprise Transition Execution Own end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale, multi-wave transitions across towers, vendors and geographies within the Global IT portfolio. Develop and oversee the Master Transition Plan, covering scope, timelines, dependencies, financials, milestones, risks, regulatory requirements and mitigation actions. Drive on-time, on-budget delivery of each transition wave while adhering to compliance, quality and audit requirements. Ensure consistent execution of transition strategy and methodology across the multiple waves. 1.2 Stakeholder & Governance Management Serve as the primary escalation point between business/function stakeholders and the extended TMP team, ensuring timely decision-making and issue resolution. Drive alignment with global standards, governance frameworks and enterprise decision-making forums (Steering Committee, Governance Council). Coordinate gate sign-off approvals, ensuring gate criteria are met before wave progression. 1.3 Risk, Stabilization & Operational Readiness Oversee the transition risk management framework with a strong focus on compliance, business continuity, and sustainable knowledge/capability transfer to incoming vendor teams. Ensure operational readiness through structured readiness testing. Define and lead the hypercare approach — success criteria, monitoring cadence and exit conditions — following each wave's go-live. Ensure smooth transition to steady-state operations with established SLAs and performance baselines, in coordination with the VMO Governance tower. 1.4 Organisational Change & Adoption Lead the change management strategy for each transition wave, including stakeholder engagement, communications and adoption planning across global teams. Ensure effective knowledge transfer and sustained adoption of compliant processes, systems and ways of working by incoming AMS vendor teams. 2. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS 8+ years of progressive experience in transition management, shared services, or Global Business Services (GBS) / Global Capability Centre (GCC) environments. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Proven track record leading complex, large-scale, multi-wave transitions simultaneously across multiple functions/towers and geographies. Experience building and leading a global transition team/function Functional knowledge across one or more relevant domains (e.g., IT AMS, R&D, commercial, supply chain, corporate functions). Proven experience planning, coordinating and managing organisational change across business units, functions and markets. Working knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and monthly variance reporting for transition costs. 3. KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Technical Competencies Strong understanding of transition methodologies and global operating models. Demonstrated expertise in transition planning and execution — knowledge transfer (KT), structured readiness testing (SRT), cutover, hypercare and adoption. Functional and end-to-end process expertise in one or more areas. Experience establishing methods, frameworks and tools, including use of technology and AI. Solid financial and commercial acumen — able to explain assumptions, manage transition costs and drive economic value. Behavioural Competencies Ability to influence cross-functional partners and stakeholders in a highly matrixed, global organisation. Ability to operate effectively in complex, ambiguous environments to drive alignment and execution across diverse teams.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
SUMMARY 
 Job Summary 
 We are seeking a technically strong Senior Technical Project Manager to drive delivery of complex, technology-heavy projects for our retail-focused client portfolio. This role is weighted toward technical ownership and hands-on execution the ideal candidate is someone who can dig into code, architecture, and infrastructure decisions directly, not just track status. Deep working knowledge of Python, .NET, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) is essential, along with practical experience implementing modern deployment strategies (CI/CD, blue-green, canary releases) and a solid understanding of retail industry systems such as omnichannel commerce, POS, supply chain, and customer engagement platforms. 
 The Senior Technical Project Manager will be hands-on in reviewing architecture and code-level decisions, troubleshooting technical blockers, validating deployment pipelines, and ensuring solutions are technically sound using project management skills as a means to keep technical delivery on track, rather than as the core focus of the role. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the technical delivery of projects end-to-end from solution design review through deployment for retail client engagements. 
 Get hands-on with Python and .NET codebases where needed: reviewing code quality, debugging issues, validating designs, and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices. 
 Evaluate and make recommendations on cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP compute, storage, networking, managed services, and cost optimization. 
 Design, implement, and troubleshoot deployment strategies and pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), blue-green/canary releases, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM). 
 Perform technical risk assessments and gap analyses on architecture, integrations, and non-functional requirements (scalability, performance, security). 
 Translate business and functional requirements into detailed technical specifications and solution designs. 
 Set up and maintain project-level technical tracking (sprint boards, technical backlogs) using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools, with a focus on technical accuracy over administrative reporting. 
 Serve as the technical point of contact for client engineering counterparts, resolving technical queries and unblocking implementation issues directly. 
 Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud service offerings (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) based on technical fit, scalability, and cost including proof-of-concept work where needed. 
 Embed DevSecOps practices into the SDLC security scanning, compliance checks, and governance gates within CI/CD pipelines. 
 Apply retail domain knowledge to solution design for e-commerce platforms, POS integration, inventory/order management, supply chain systems, and customer data platforms. 
 Contribute technical estimations, architecture diagrams, and solution approaches for proposals and pre-sales efforts. 
 Evaluate and pilot AI/automation tooling (agentic coding tools, LLM Ops, AI guardrails) to improve engineering efficiency and delivery quality. 
 Produce and maintain technical documentation architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, integration specs, and technical decision logs. 
 Coordinate lightweight project logistics (timelines, dependencies, status updates) only to the extent needed to keep technical delivery unblocked this is not a resourcing/staff-management role. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Experience 
 12+ years of overall IT/engineering experience, with substantial hands-on time writing, reviewing, or architecting Python and/or .NET applications. 
 Strong, current working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) including compute (EC2/App Services/Compute Engine), storage, networking, serverless (Lambda/Azure Functions), and managed database services gained through direct implementation, not just oversight. 
 Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies : Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI; containerization (Docker, Kubernetes); blue-green/canary releases; infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates). 
 Prior technical delivery experience within the retail domain e-commerce, POS, order management, supply chain, merchandising, or customer loyalty platforms strongly preferred. 
 Experience integrating and evaluating different cloud service offerings (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) for fit, scalability, and cost. 
 Working knowledge of monitoring/observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch, Grafana) and hands-on incident/troubleshooting experience. 
 Practical exposure to AI/ML-driven tooling or automation frameworks in SDLC processes (e.g., agentic coding tools, LLM Ops, AI guardrails) is a strong plus. 
 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery is expected, 
 Skills 
 Strong, practical command of Python and/or .NET : able to read, review, and reason about code, APIs, microservices, and integration patterns directly rather than through a manager's summary. 
 Solid grasp of cloud architecture across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models, with the ability to independently evaluate trade-offs and design options. 
 Deep understanding of software deployment and release management rollback strategies, zero-downtime deployments, and pipeline debugging. 
 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills comfortable digging into logs, configs, and system behavior to diagnose root causes. 
 Ability to produce clear technical documentation (architecture diagrams, runbooks, technical specs) independently. 
 Working knowledge of security and compliance considerations relevant to retail/e-commerce (PCI-DSS, data privacy). 
 Clear technical communication skills for engaging with engineering teams and client technical counterparts this role is not focused on executive stakeholder management or team leadership. 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 Relevant certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe Agilist, AWS/Azure/GCP certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are highly desirable. 
 
 Preferred Attributes 
 Prior consulting or IT services experience serving retail/fashion clients. 
 Experience with tooling strategy and SDLC process tracking. 
 Comfortable being the most technically hands-on person in the room prototyping, debugging, or reviewing designs directly rather than delegating. 
 A proactive, self-directed mindset with the ability to operate independently on technical problems in fast-paced, client-facing environments.

title: Senior Civil Engineer
description:
Only Male Candidates from Pune, PCMC will be considered. Apllicants other than Pune (out of Pune city) will not be considered. 
 
 Position Senior Civil Engineer Department Projects / Construction Reporting To Site In-Charge / Project Manager Location PCMC & Nearby Areas, Pune Employment Type Full-Time 


 Preferred candidate locations - Ravet/Pimple Gurav/Bhosari/Chakan/Punawale/Moshi/Alandi/Charholi/PCMC and nearby areas only. 
 1. Job Purpose The Senior Civil Engineer will be responsible for assisting in the planning, execution, supervision, and monitoring of civil construction activities at project sites. The role requires strong knowledge of civil engineering principles, practical site execution skills, quality awareness, and the ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, vendors, and internal teams. 
 The candidate will ensure that construction work is executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, project schedules, and company requirements. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Site Supervision & Execution Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities at the assigned project site. Monitor construction activities including excavation, PCC, RCC, reinforcement, shuttering, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, flooring, tiling, painting, and other finishing works. Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and instructions from senior engineers. Check the availability and proper utilization of manpower, materials, tools, machinery, and equipment. Coordinate with contractors and subcontractors to ensure timely completion of assigned activities. Monitor the progress of work and report delays, site issues, and constraints to the reporting manager. Ensure proper sequencing of construction activities to avoid unnecessary delays and rework. B. Drawing & Technical Understanding Read and understand structural, architectural, civil, and service-related drawings. Verify dimensions, levels, alignments, locations, and other details before execution. Coordinate with senior engineers and consultants in case of discrepancies or missing information in drawings. Ensure that construction is carried out according to the latest approved drawings. Maintain proper records of drawings, revisions, instructions, and site-related documents. Assist in preparing basic quantity calculations and measurements from drawings. C. Quality Control Ensure that construction work complies with approved specifications and required quality standards. Check reinforcement, shuttering, concrete, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, and finishing work before proceeding to the next stage. Assist in checking the quality of incoming construction materials. Coordinate with the quality-control team for inspections and testing. Ensure proper curing of concrete and masonry work. Identify defective or substandard work and immediately report it to the concerned senior. Monitor rectification and ensure that rejected or defective work is corrected properly. Minimize material wastage and prevent unnecessary rework. D. Quantity & Measurement Assist in taking measurements of completed work executed by contractors. Prepare and maintain measurement records for civil works. Assist in checking contractor bills against actual site measurements. Verify quantities of materials consumed at the site. Assist in preparing basic BOQ quantities and material requirements. Maintain records of concrete, steel, cement, sand, blocks, tiles, and other construction materials. Monitor material consumption against approved quantities and identify unusual wastage. E. Material Management Coordinate with the stores and purchase departments regarding material requirements. Check materials received at site for quantity and basic quality requirements. Ensure materials are used appropriately and wastage is controlled. Inform the senior engineer about upcoming material requirements to avoid work stoppage. F. Contractor & Labour Coordination Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, supervisors, and skilled/unskilled workers. Allocate daily work activities as instructed by senior engineers. Monitor labour productivity and work progress. Maintain discipline and proper coordination among site workers. Report manpower shortages and productivity issues to the reporting manager. Ensure workers understand the required quality and execution standards. Coordinate with contractors for timely completion of assigned targets. 
 G. Safety Compliance Follow and promote all safety rules and procedures at the construction site. Ensure workers use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Immediately report unsafe working conditions, accidents, near misses, and hazards. Ensure proper housekeeping and safe movement of workers and materials. Coordinate with the safety team to address site safety observations. Never compromise safety for speed or project deadlines. H. Daily Reporting & Documentation Prepare daily progress reports as required by the reporting manager. Record manpower deployment, material consumption, work progress, and major site activities. Maintain site photographs and progress documentation. Report any technical, manpower, material, quality, or coordination issues promptly. Maintain proper records of inspections, measurements, checklists, and site instructions. Assist senior engineers in preparing weekly and monthly project progress reports. 3. Coordination Responsibilities The Senior Civil Engineer will regularly coordinate with: Senior Civil Engineers Site In-Charge / Project Manager Architects Structural Consultants MEP Teams Quality Control Team Safety Team Purchase Department Stores Department Contractors & Subcontractors Vendors and Suppliers The candidate must maintain professional communication and ensure that instructions received from senior management are properly implemented at site. 
 4. Required Qualifications Education: B.E. / B.Tech./Diploma in Civil Engineering. Candidates with relevant site experience will be preferred. 
 Experience: 5-7 years of relevant experience in residential and commercial construction is preferred. 5. Required Technical Skills The candidate should have knowledge of: Civil construction practices RCC and structural work Reinforcement and shuttering Masonry and plastering Waterproofing Flooring and finishing works Quantity estimation and measurement Reading architectural and structural drawings Basic knowledge of AutoCAD MS Excel and MS Office Basic understanding of construction materials Quality control procedures Site safety practices
 
 6. Key Skills & Competencies Strong site supervision skills Good communication and coordination abilities Basic technical and problem-solving skills Ability to read and understand drawings Good numerical and measurement skills Attention to detail Ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously Teamwork and coordination Time management Willingness to work at construction sites Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines Positive attitude and willingness to learn 
 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Timely completion of assigned work Quality of executed work Reduction in rework and material wastage Accuracy of measurements and documentation Contractor and labour coordination Compliance with drawings and specifications Safety compliance Daily/weekly reporting accuracy Productivity and utilization of resources Adherence to project schedules 8. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a technically sound, hardworking, responsible, and career-oriented Civil Engineer who is willing to work at construction sites and learn practical aspects of project execution. The candidate must have a hands-on approach, good observation skills, and the ability to identify site-level problems and escalate them appropriately. Strong discipline, punctuality, professional conduct, and willingness to take responsibility will be highly valued. 9. Working Conditions The position is primarily site-based. The candidate may be required to travel to project locations within PCMC and nearby areas. The role involves regular interaction with contractors, labourers, vendors, consultants, and project teams. Working hours may vary depending on project requirements and critical construction activities. 10. Overall Responsibility The Senior Civil Engineer will play an important role in ensuring that assigned construction activities are completed on time, within required quality standards, with minimum wastage, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, safety requirements, and company policies. The position offers an opportunity to develop strong practical knowledge in construction execution, project coordination, quantity management, quality control, and overall site management while working under experienced senior engineering and project-management professionals .

title: AI Automation & Technology Manager
description:
Job Summary Teachwell Institute & Teachwell Overseas is looking for a hands-on AI Automation & Technology Manager to become the company's first dedicated technology resource and help us build an AI-enabled education and counselling ecosystem. The candidate will be responsible for understanding existing business processes, identifying opportunities for automation and building practical technology solutions using AI, APIs, Google Workspace, workflow automation and web technologies. This is a hands-on builder role , not a traditional IT support role. The candidate will work directly with the management team to convert manual processes into automated digital workflows, dashboards and internal tools. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. AI & Business Process Automation Study existing business processes across counselling, admissions, test preparation, study abroad, marketing and operations. Identify repetitive manual tasks that can be automated using AI and workflow automation. Design and implement automated workflows. Integrate AI tools with internal business processes. Build AI-assisted systems for counselling, reporting, lead management and student operations. Reduce dependency on manual data entry and repetitive ChatGPT prompting. 2. Google Forms Sheets AI Dashboard A major responsibility will be converting existing Google Form-based processes into structured technology workflows. The candidate should be able to build systems such as: Google Form Google Sheet Data Processing AI Analysis Report Counsellor Dashboard Parent/Student Output The candidate will: Build and maintain Google Forms. Structure Google Sheets as databases/data sources. Develop Google Apps Script automations. Connect Google Workspace with external APIs. Automate report generation. Create dashboards and internal interfaces. Develop systems that can eventually replace manual spreadsheet-based workflows. 3. AI APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT The candidate should have experience working with modern AI tools and APIs. Responsibilities may include: OpenAI APIs Claude APIs Gemini APIs AI agents LLM workflows Prompt engineering Structured JSON outputs Retrieval/database-based AI systems AI-powered report generation AI-powered counselling assistants AI-based internal tools The candidate should understand that AI should be integrated into real business workflows , not merely used for content generation. 4. WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT & MAINTENANCE Teachwell currently has a Node.js-based website/application ecosystem , and we want to reduce dependency on external developers for routine changes. The candidate will: Maintain existing Node.js applications. Make minor website/application changes independently. Fix bugs and troubleshoot technical issues. Add new pages, forms and functionality. Integrate APIs and third-party services. Maintain website performance and security. Manage Git/GitHub repositories and deployment workflows. Coordinate with external developers when specialised support is required. Node.js experience is therefore highly desirable. 5. INTERNAL DASHBOARD DEVELOPMENT The candidate will gradually help Teachwell move from spreadsheets and disconnected tools towards an integrated internal dashboard. Potential modules may include: Student database Lead management Counselling dashboard Application tracking University database Student profile management Admission Saathi dashboard Test preparation leads Study abroad applications Counsellor task management Application deadlines Reports and analytics AI-generated recommendations The candidate will work with management to define requirements and convert them into practical technology solutions. 6. API & SYSTEM INTEGRATIONS The candidate should be comfortable connecting different platforms through APIs. Examples include: Google Forms 
 Google Sheets

 CRM 
 WhatsApp 
 Email 
 AI APIs 
 Website 
 Database 
 Dashboard Responsibilities: API integration Webhooks Authentication Data transfer Error handling Automation triggers Third-party integrations 7. CRM & LEAD AUTOMATION Teachwell uses CRM-based workflows for managing leads and student enquiries. The candidate will work with the operations and counselling teams to: Automate lead movement. Create automated notifications. Connect forms with CRM. Automate counsellor assignments. Build follow-up workflows. Integrate CRM with AI tools. Create management dashboards. Reduce duplicate data entry. 8. DATA & DATABASE MANAGEMENT The candidate should understand basic database architecture and data structures. Preferred knowledge: PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB Database design Data relationships JSON REST APIs Data validation Authentication Basic security practices The candidate should be able to design data structures that can scale as Teachwell's student database grows. 9. DOCUMENTATION & SYSTEM OWNERSHIP Since this will initially be a one-person technology function, the candidate must document everything they build. Responsibilities include: Maintain technical documentation. Maintain API documentation. Maintain workflow diagrams. Maintain database documentation. Maintain deployment information. Maintain Git repositories. Create SOPs for internal technology processes. Ensure the company does not become dependent on one external developer. 10. WORK DIRECTLY WITH MANAGEMENT This position will work closely with the Founder/Management. The candidate should be comfortable receiving a requirement such as: "Currently my counsellor fills this Google Form. Then she copies the information into ChatGPT, researches universities and prepares a report. I want this entire process automated."
 The candidate should be able to: Understand Analyse Design Build Test Deploy Improve without requiring a detailed technical specification for every small task. title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
description:
Job Description About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas. This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side - expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders - and you want the pager for it - you will feel at home. You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed - escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced. What you ll do Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss. Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse. Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse - partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it. Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production. Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. Own observability for what you build - meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. Full stack engineering and technical leadership Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents - including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. Contribute to the analytics front end - dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools - with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. Qualifications Experience and education requirements The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition. Requirement Mandatory minimum 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems 3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 3+ years On-call and production ownership Bachelor s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field Required A master s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. Required qualifications Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system. Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. Desired qualifications Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store - sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. Client-side instrumentation - web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. AI skills Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 - it applies to how you build and to what you build. Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other - catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. Integrating LLM APIs into production features - and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components - retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

title: Junior Electrical Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 City Greens is a fast-growing AgriTech startup building automation solutions for Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA). We build and deploy electrical and IoT-based automation systems at farms and greenhouses across India, and we need a hands-on electrical engineer to help us install, commission, and support them. Onsite field-heavy Bengaluru, with frequent travel. 
 
 Role overview 
 This is a field-first electrical role. You will spend a significant portion of your time at customer sites installing electrical systems, commissioning panels, and ensuring everything runs correctly before you leave. Back at the lab, you will build and test electrical panels for upcoming deployments. If you are comfortable with wires, tools, and travel and you take pride in clean, safe electrical work this role is for you. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Site electrical installation: Travel to customer farms and greenhouses to install and commission electrical systems power distribution, wiring, earthing, device mounting, and cable management. Verify installations are safe and functional before handover. Electrical panel fabrication: Build electrical panels at our lab MCBs, relays, contactors, terminal blocks, power supply units, cable routing, and labelling. Panels must meet safety standards and be field-ready before dispatch. Prototype support: Assist the hardware team with electrical assembly of prototypes wiring, power connections, enclosure work, and bench testing. You handle the electrical side; the engineering team handles the electronics. On-site support troubleshooting: Respond to field issues at customer sites. Diagnose electrical faults, carry out repairs, and restore systems. This may require short-notice travel. 
 
 Requirements 
 Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience in Electrical Engineering People who are comfortable with physical work running cables, building panels, working on-site Candidates who are willing and able to travel frequently, including to semi-urban or rural farm locations Individuals who take pride in safe, clean, reliable electrical work Self-starters who can work independently at a customer site without hand-holding 
 
 Key skills traits 
 AC/DC circuits switchgear: MCBs, relays, contactors, fuses, terminal blocks read and follow electrical wiring diagrams and schematics crimping, cable lugs, multimeters, cable trays electrical safety practices Willingness to travel frequently this is non-negotiable 
 
 Nice to have 
 Exposure to industrial electrical systems or automation panels Experience with solar power systems or battery backups Prior site installation or commissioning experience Basic familiarity with low-voltage DC systems (12V / 24V)
